title.zh: Marvell FY2027 Q2 10-Q：对代工与测试封装伙伴的无条件采购承诺由 $2,756.8M 升至 $8,518.9M，增量集中在 FY2028-FY2030
title.en: Marvell FY2027 Q2 10-Q: unconditional purchase commitments to foundries and test and assembly partners rise from $2,756.8M to $8,518.9M, with the increase concentrated in fiscal 2028-2030

detail.zh: 据 Marvell Technology, Inc.（NASDAQ: MRVL）截至 2026-08-01 季度、于 2026-08-28 提交的 Form 10-Q（accession 0001835632-26-000025，2026-08-28 16:04 ET 受理）附注 9「承诺与或有事项」：截至 2026-08-01，对晶圆代工厂与测试封装伙伴的未来无条件采购承诺合计 **$8,518.9M**；而上一份 Form 10-Q（accession 0001835632-26-000019，2026-05-28 提交）披露截至 2026-05-02 为 **$2,756.8M**，FY2026 年报 Form 10-K（accession 0001835632-26-000011，2026-03-11 提交）披露截至 2026-01-31 为 **$2,665.8M**。即该承诺簿在此前两个资产负债表日基本持平，随后单季增加 $5,762.1M、约 +209%。上一季申报已在期后事项中披露公司签署长期晶圆与基板产能协议（分别覆盖至 FY2030 / FY2033）并承诺支付合计 $870.0M 的 deposits；本季 10-Q 是首次在资产负债表时点的采购承诺表中量化扩张后的期限结构。增量几乎全部落在远期年度而非当年：相对 2026-05-02，FY2028 由 $174.4M 增至 $2,125.4M（+$1,951.0M）、FY2029 由 $68.4M 增至 $2,178.3M（+$2,109.9M）、FY2030 由 $66.3M 增至 $2,201.8M（+$2,135.5M）；FY2027 剩余部分随季度推进由 $2,265.2M 降至 $1,829.3M，FY2031 为 $66.0M，「其后」维持 $118.1M 不变。同表中技术服务与授权费由 $709.3M 降至 $666.3M。单独披露的资本支出承诺由截至 2026-05-02 的 $185.5M 升至截至 2026-08-01 的 $351.6M。证据限制，必须与上述数字一并阅读。（1）这是取自两份申报的两个资产负债表时点快照，不是已宣布的订单、中标或产能协议；发行人未就此发布任何公告。（2）「无条件」是发行人自己的表格标题，并非不可撤销的主张：同一附注写明，未结采购订单允许取消，但须支付截至取消日已发生的全部成本与费用，某些情况下还可能产生额外费用、损失已预付款项，或丧失已预留产能的优先权。（3）该申报把晶圆代工与后段产能合并列为单一未拆分列「Purchase Commitments to Foundries and Test and Assembly Partners」，因此无法把增量中的任何部分归属于先进封装、组装或测试而与晶圆供应区分，本条目也不作此拆分。（4）申报未具名任何代工厂或 OSAT 对手方，未披露晶圆或数量、制程节点、价格，也未披露承诺背后的任何客户。（5）该增幅不是收购口径造成的：Celestial AI 与 XConn 两笔收购均在截至 2026-05-02 的季度内完成，故 $2,756.8M 的基数已并表两者；两张表的列标题完全一致，且三份申报均把资本支出承诺在表外单独披露，故为同口径比较。（6）这是设计方的供应侧产能预留，不构成已承诺的客户采购、backlog 或可确认收入；发行人未把这些承诺与任何具体项目建立关联。
detail.en: Per Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL) Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-08-01, filed 2026-08-28 (accession 0001835632-26-000025, accepted 2026-08-28 16:04 ET), Note 9 'Commitments and Contingencies': future unconditional purchase commitments to foundries and test and assembly partners total **$8,518.9M** as of 2026-08-01, against **$2,756.8M** as of 2026-05-02 in the immediately preceding Form 10-Q (accession 0001835632-26-000019, filed 2026-05-28) and **$2,665.8M** as of 2026-01-31 in the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001835632-26-000011, filed 2026-03-11). The book was therefore roughly flat across the two prior balance-sheet dates and then rose by $5,762.1M, or about 209%, in a single quarter. The prior-quarter filing had already disclosed, as a subsequent event, long-term wafer and substrate capacity agreements through fiscal 2030 and fiscal 2033 plus $870.0M of deposits; the Q2 10-Q is the first balance-sheet-date purchase-commitment table to quantify the expanded maturity profile. The increase sits almost entirely in the out-years rather than the current year: against 2026-05-02, fiscal 2028 rises $174.4M to $2,125.4M (+$1,951.0M), fiscal 2029 rises $68.4M to $2,178.3M (+$2,109.9M) and fiscal 2030 rises $66.3M to $2,201.8M (+$2,135.5M), while the remainder of fiscal 2027 declines $2,265.2M to $1,829.3M as the quarter elapsed, fiscal 2031 is $66.0M and 'thereafter' is unchanged at $118.1M. In the same table, technology services and license fees fall from $709.3M to $666.3M. Separately disclosed commitments for capital expenditures rise from $185.5M as of 2026-05-02 to $351.6M as of 2026-08-01. Evidence limits, which must be read alongside the figures above. (1) These are two balance-sheet snapshots from two filings, not an announced order, award or capacity agreement; the issuer announced nothing. (2) 'Unconditional' is the issuer's own table caption and is not a non-cancellability claim: the same note states that cancellation of outstanding purchase orders is allowed but requires payment of all costs and expenses incurred through the date of cancellation, and in some cases may result in incremental fees, loss of amounts paid in advance, or loss of priority to reserved capacity. (3) The filing reports foundry and back-end capacity in a single undifferentiated column, 'Purchase Commitments to Foundries and Test and Assembly Partners', so no portion of the increase can be attributed to advanced packaging, assembly or test as distinct from wafer supply, and no split is asserted here. (4) The filing names no foundry or OSAT counterparty, discloses no wafer or unit volumes, no node, no pricing and no customer behind the commitments. (5) The increase is not acquisition arithmetic: Marvell completed both the Celestial AI and XConn acquisitions during the quarter ended 2026-05-02, so the $2,756.8M base already consolidated them. The two tables carry identical column headings and in all three filings capital-expenditure commitments are disclosed separately from the table, so the comparison is like-for-like. (6) This is a supplier-side capacity reservation by the designer and is not evidence of committed customer purchases, backlog or recognized revenue; the issuer draws no link between these commitments and any specific program.

title.zh: Marvell FY2027 Q2 数据中心收入同比 +46% 加速，但公司把 Custom 业务的显著加速定在 FY2027 下半年
title.en: Marvell FY2027 Q2 data-center revenue accelerates to +46% year over year, while the company dates the significant Custom acceleration to the second half of fiscal 2027

detail.zh: 据 Marvell Technology, Inc.（NASDAQ: MRVL）2026-08-27 提交的 Form 8-K（事项 2.02／9.01，accession 0001835632-26-000022，2026-08-27 16:05 ET 受理）及其附件 99.1 新闻稿《Marvell Technology, Inc. Reports Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results》：截至 2026-08-01 的 FY2027 Q2 净收入 $2,739.3M（同比 +37%、环比 +13%），高于公司 2026-05-27 指引中点 $39.0M。按发行人的 end-market 表：Data center 收入 $2,171.5M（同比 **+46%**、环比 +18%），占总收入 79%；Communications and other 收入 $567.8M（同比 +10%、环比 **-3%**）。对照发行人上一季同表，FY2027 Q1（截至 2026-05-02）Data center 收入 $1,832.7M、同比 +27%、环比 +11%，因此数据中心同比增速在 FY2027 前两个季度由 27% 升至 46%。GAAP 毛利率 53.1%、non-GAAP 毛利率 58.9%；GAAP 净利润 $308.0M（摊薄每股 $0.33，摊薄股数 921.2M），non-GAAP 净利润 $865.9M（摊薄每股 $0.94）；经营活动现金流 $605.5M。FY2027 Q3 指引：净收入 $3.150B ±5%，GAAP 毛利率 52.9%-53.9%、non-GAAP 毛利率 57.5%-58.5%，non-GAAP 摊薄每股收益 $1.10 ±$0.05。证据边界：董事长兼 CEO Matt Murphy 在新闻稿中称公司「再次上调 FY2027 与 FY2028 的收入展望」，但该新闻稿**未给出任何 FY2027 或 FY2028 的收入数字**，本条不代填、也不据此重算任何倍数；他同时把 Data Center 的强度归因于 Connectivity，并把 Custom 业务的「显著加速」明确定在 **FY2027 下半年**，故本季不构成任一具名 hyperscaler 定制项目的放量证据；新闻稿未按客户或按 Custom／Connectivity 拆分收入，也未披露订单、backlog 或采购承诺金额。本条不对 2026-08-18 披露的 Google 采购挂钩权证作任何推断——该权证的档位自 FY2027 Q3 起才按采购解锁，且本新闻稿全文未提及该权证。
detail.en: Per Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL) Form 8-K filed 2026-08-27 (Items 2.02 and 9.01, accession 0001835632-26-000022, accepted 2026-08-27 16:05 ET) and its Exhibit 99.1 press release, 'Marvell Technology, Inc. Reports Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results': FY2027 Q2 net revenue for the quarter ended 2026-08-01 was $2,739.3M (+37% year over year, +13% sequentially), $39.0M above the midpoint of the guidance the company gave on 2026-05-27. Per the issuer's end-market table, Data center revenue was $2,171.5M (**+46%** year over year, +18% sequentially), or 79% of total revenue; Communications and other revenue was $567.8M (+10% year over year, **-3%** sequentially). Against the same table in the issuer's prior quarter, FY2027 Q1 (ended 2026-05-02) Data center revenue was $1,832.7M, +27% year over year and +11% sequentially, so the data-center year-over-year growth rate rose from 27% to 46% across the first two quarters of fiscal 2027. GAAP gross margin was 53.1% and non-GAAP gross margin 58.9%; GAAP net income was $308.0M ($0.33 per diluted share on 921.2M diluted shares) and non-GAAP net income $865.9M ($0.94 per diluted share); cash flow from operations was $605.5M. FY2027 Q3 outlook: net revenue $3.150B +/- 5%, GAAP gross margin 52.9%-53.9%, non-GAAP gross margin 57.5%-58.5%, and non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.10 +/- $0.05. Evidence limits: Chairman and CEO Matt Murphy states in the release that the company is 'again raising our revenue outlook for both fiscal 2027 and fiscal 2028,' but the release **gives no FY2027 or FY2028 revenue figure**; no figure is supplied here and no multiple is recomputed from it. He also attributes the Data Center strength to Connectivity and dates the 'significant acceleration' in the Custom business to the **second half of fiscal 2027**, so this quarter is not ramp evidence for any named hyperscaler custom program. The release does not split revenue by customer or between Custom and Connectivity, and discloses no order, backlog or purchase-commitment amount. This entry infers nothing about the purchase-linked Google warrant disclosed 2026-08-18: its tranches only begin vesting on purchases from FY2027 Q3, and the release does not mention the warrant at all.

title.zh: SK 海力士为印第安纳州 HBM 先进封装厂动工，投资逾 $4B，量产目标 2029 下半年
title.en: SK hynix breaks ground on its Indiana HBM advanced-packaging fab, over $4B of investment, with mass production targeted for the second half of 2029

detail.zh: 据 SK hynix Inc.（KRX: 000660）官方新闻室 2026-08-28（首尔）发布的新闻稿《SK hynix Holds Groundbreaking Ceremony for HBM Production Base in Indiana》：公司于当地时间 **2026-08-27** 在印第安纳州西拉法叶普渡大学 Holloway Gymnasium 举行了 AI 内存**先进封装**产线的动工仪式。发行人披露：该印第安纳厂总预期投资**逾 $4B**，计划**2028 年 10 月**洁净室启用、**2029 年下半年**开始下一代 HBM 量产，商业运营期预计约 1,000 名员工。运营框架与韩国生产紧密衔接——韩国制造的晶圆运至印第安纳完成先进封装与测试后，以 Made in USA 产品供应美国客户；产线旁将建「先进封装研发测试台」。公司同时称正考虑逾 100 家材料、零部件与设备供应商，预计在建设与后续商业运营期间创造约 7,000 个直接与间接岗位，并与普渡大学就下一代先进封装技术研发签署谅解备忘录。证据边界：本条记录的是**动工与计划**，不是已交付产能——发行人给出的量产时点在 2029 年下半年，因此这笔先进封装产能对当前周期的后段瓶颈**不构成近期缓解**。发行人**未披露**任何具名客户、HBM 位元产能、晶圆或封装月产能、设备订单或分年资本开支节奏；出席的美国参议员 Todd Young 称其曾通过《芯片与科学法案》协助促成该投资，但该新闻稿未披露任何联邦补助金额或拨付条件。上述岗位与供应商数量为发行人自述的预期值。
detail.en: Per the SK hynix Inc. (KRX: 000660) newsroom release 'SK hynix Holds Groundbreaking Ceremony for HBM Production Base in Indiana,' datelined Seoul, August 28, 2026: the company held a groundbreaking ceremony for an **advanced-packaging** production facility for AI memory on **2026-08-27 local time** at Holloway Gymnasium, Purdue University, in West Lafayette, Indiana. The issuer discloses a total expected investment of **over $4 billion** in the Indiana fab, a cleanroom scheduled to open by **October 2028** and mass production of next-generation HBM beginning in the **second half of 2029**, with roughly 1,000 personnel during anticipated commercial operations. The operating framework is integrated with Korean production: wafers made by SK hynix in Korea are to be delivered to Indiana for advanced packaging and testing before Made in USA products are supplied to US customers, and an 'Advanced Packaging R&D Testbed' is to be built alongside the production lines. The company also states that more than 100 companies are being considered as suppliers of materials, components and equipment, that approximately 7,000 direct and indirect jobs are expected during construction and subsequent commercial operations, and that it signed a memorandum of understanding with Purdue University on next-generation advanced-packaging R&D. Evidence limits: this entry records a **groundbreaking and a plan**, not delivered capacity. The issuer's own mass-production date is the second half of 2029, so this packaging capacity provides **no near-term relief** to the current cycle's back-end constraint. The issuer discloses **no** named customer, no HBM bit capacity, no monthly wafer or packaging capacity, no equipment orders and no year-by-year capital-expenditure schedule. US Senator Todd Young, who attended, says he helped make the investment possible through the CHIPS and Science Act, but the release discloses no federal award amount or disbursement condition. The job and supplier counts above are the issuer's own stated expectations.

title.zh: 铠侠与闪迪公布逾 $31B 日本投资计划（以政府支持为前提），铠侠同日启动北上 Fab3 场地前期工作
title.en: Kioxia and Sandisk announce over $31B of planned Japan investment contingent on government support, and Kioxia starts site work for Fab3 at Kitakami the same day

detail.zh: 据 Kioxia Holdings Corporation（TSE Prime: 285A）2026-08-27 向东京证券交易所 TDnet 提交的适时披露《Notice Regarding Investment Plan with Sandisk Corporation》及所附联合新闻稿：铠侠公司（Kioxia Holdings 并表子公司）与 Sandisk Corporation（NASDAQ: SNDK）宣布在日本合计**逾 $31B（约 5 万亿日元）、至 2032 年**的预期重大投资，发行人明确写明**以政府支持为前提（contingent upon government support）**。投资用于四日市工厂与北上工厂及相关基础设施、技术的持续建设；双方各自表示致力于推动「多年期位元增长」与稳定供应。发行人同时提及该合资关系过去 25 年在日本已投入逾 $50B（约 9 万亿日元），并称双方已于 2026 年 1 月将四日市工厂的合资框架延长至 2034 年 12 月。同日铠侠另发新闻稿《Kioxia to Expand 3D Flash Memory Production Capacity with the New Fab3 at Kitakami Plant》：公司已**开始北上工厂（岩手县）Fab3 的场地前期准备及相关工作**，厂址位于 Fab2 以南，**目标 2029 财年投产**。证据边界：这是**计划与前期工作，不是已核准的设备资本开支**——发行人在同一份新闻稿中写明 Fab3 的「建设时间表与设备投资的详细计划将根据市场趋势确定」，且「Fab3 的投资计划以政府支持为前提」。发行人**未披露**投资的分年节奏、四日市与北上之间的分配、位元产出、制程节点、设备订单或任何政府补助的金额与条件；「多年期位元增长」为定性表述，未附数量。截至本轮扫描窗口收盘（2026-08-27 19:02 ET），Sandisk 尚未就此事项提交 Form 8-K，因此此处引用的权威文件是铠侠的 TDnet 适时披露。
detail.en: Per the Tokyo Stock Exchange TDnet timely disclosure 'Notice Regarding Investment Plan with Sandisk Corporation,' filed by Kioxia Holdings Corporation (TSE Prime: 285A) on 2026-08-27, and the joint press release attached to it: Kioxia Corporation, a consolidated subsidiary of Kioxia Holdings, and Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK) announced anticipated significant investments in Japan totaling **over $31 billion (approximately 5 trillion yen) through 2032**, which the issuer states explicitly are **contingent upon government support**. The investments are to support the ongoing buildout of the Yokkaichi Plant and the Kitakami Plant along with related infrastructure and technology; each company says it has committed to drive meaningful, multi-year bit growth and to ensure stable supply. The issuer also notes the joint venture has invested over $50 billion (approximately 9 trillion yen) in Japan over the past 25 years, and that in January the two extended the Yokkaichi joint-venture framework through December 2034. The same day Kioxia separately released 'Kioxia to Expand 3D Flash Memory Production Capacity with the New Fab3 at Kitakami Plant': the company **has commenced site preparation and other related work** for Fab3 at the Kitakami Plant in Iwate Prefecture, on land south of Fab2, **targeting operations to commence in fiscal 2029**. Evidence limits: this is a **plan and preparatory work, not approved equipment capital expenditure**. In the same release the issuer states that 'detailed plans for Fab3 regarding construction schedule and equipment investments will be determined based on market trends' and that 'investment plans for Fab3 are contingent upon government support.' The issuer discloses **no** year-by-year spending profile, no split between Yokkaichi and Kitakami, no bit output, no process node, no equipment orders, and no amount or condition for any government support; 'multi-year bit growth' is a qualitative statement carrying no quantity. As of this scan window's close (2026-08-27 19:02 ET) Sandisk had filed no Form 8-K on the matter, so the authoritative document cited here is Kioxia's TDnet timely disclosure.

title.zh: NVIDIA 供应与产能采购承诺由 $119B 升至 $279B，公司称主要用于采购内存
title.en: NVIDIA supply-and-capacity purchase commitments rise from $119B to $279B, which the company attributes primarily to memory procurement

detail.zh: 据 NVIDIA 截至 2026-07-26 季度的 Form 10-Q（accession 0001045810-26-000075，2026-08-26 16:36 ET 提交）与同日 Form 8-K（事项 2.02）附件 99.2 CFO Commentary：采购义务表中的「supply and capacity」一项由上一季度的 $119B 升至截至 2026-07-26 的 $279B。10-Q 表述为「primarily memory and manufacturing facilities」，CFO Commentary 表述为「primarily related to the procurement of memory」。该表按财年分布为 2027 财年剩余期 $92B、2028 财年 $87B、2029 财年 $88B、2030 财年 $6B、2031 财年 $5B、2032 财年及以后 $1B；采购义务总表合计 $366B（另含 cloud service agreements $29B、尚未起租的数据中心租约 $25B、股权投资 $25B、资本开支 $8B）。同期 Q2 FY2027 营收 $96,221M（同比 +106%、环比 +18%），Data Center 营收 $89.0B（同比 +117%、环比 +18%），GAAP 与 non-GAAP 毛利率均为 75.0%；存货由上季 $25.8B 升至 $31.6B，CFO Commentary 称系为第三季度导入 Vera Rubin 作准备。Q3 FY2027 指引营收 $108.0B±2%，且明确不假设任何来自中国的 Data Center compute 收入。证据边界：发行人明示这些协议在正式下单前「in certain instances」可取消、可重排或可按业务需要调整，因此该金额是买方侧的承诺口径，既不是任何具名供应商已确认的订单或收入，也未按供应商、产品或节点披露构成；本条不推断任何内存厂商的出货量、定价或产能分配。同一份 10-Q 首次将 Form of Residual Value Guaranty 作为附件 10.1 提交，但其部分条款依 Regulation S-K Item 601(b)(10) 作删节处理、部分附表依 601(a)(5) 省略。
detail.en: Per NVIDIA's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026 (accession 0001045810-26-000075, accepted 2026-08-26 16:36 ET) and the Exhibit 99.2 CFO Commentary to the same day's Form 8-K (Item 2.02): the "supply and capacity" line of the purchase-obligations table rose from $119 billion in the prior quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026. The 10-Q describes these commitments as "primarily memory and manufacturing facilities"; the CFO Commentary describes the increase as "primarily related to the procurement of memory." The table distributes as $92B for the remainder of fiscal 2027, $87B in fiscal 2028, $88B in fiscal 2029, $6B in fiscal 2030, $5B in fiscal 2031 and $1B in fiscal 2032 and thereafter; total purchase obligations are $366B, also comprising $29B of cloud service agreements, $25B of data-center leases not commenced, $25B of equity investments and $8B of capital expenditures. In the same quarter, Q2 FY2027 revenue was $96,221M (+106% year over year, +18% sequentially) and Data Center revenue was $89.0B (+117% year over year, +18% sequentially), with GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins both 75.0%; inventory rose from $25.8B sequentially to $31.6B, which the CFO Commentary attributes to preparing for the introduction of Vera Rubin in the third quarter. The Q3 FY2027 outlook is $108.0B of revenue plus or minus 2% and assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China. Evidence limits: the issuer states these supplier agreements may in certain instances be cancelable, rescheduled or adjustable for its business needs before firm orders are placed, so the figure is a buyer-side commitment caliber rather than orders or revenue confirmed by any named supplier, and no breakdown by supplier, product or node is disclosed; nothing here infers any memory maker's shipment volume, pricing or capacity allocation. The same 10-Q filed the Form of Residual Value Guaranty as Exhibit 10.1 for the first time, with certain terms redacted under Regulation S-K Item 601(b)(10) and certain schedules omitted under Item 601(a)(5).

title.zh: Synopsys Q3 FY2026：Design Automation 同比 +53%、backlog $10.9B，但 Design IP 前九个月仍同比 -1%
title.en: Synopsys Q3 FY2026: Design Automation up 53% year over year with $10.9B backlog, while nine-month Design IP is still down 1%

detail.zh: 据 Synopsys 2026-08-26 提交的 Form 8-K（事项 2.02，accession 0001193125-26-368620）附件 99.1 新闻稿与同日 Form 10-Q（accession 0000883241-26-000025，季度截至 2026-07-31）：Q3 FY2026 营收 $2,476.8M（上年同期 $1,739.7M，同比 +42%），其中 Design Automation $2,003.0M（同比 +53%）、Design IP $473.8M（同比 +11%）。按前九个月口径，Design Automation $5,826.6M（同比 +69%），而 Design IP $1,335.0M（上年同期 $1,344.7M，同比 **-1%**）。截至 2026-07-31 的合同未履约义务（backlog）为 $10.9B，其中包含 $1.9B 不可撤销 FSA 承诺；剔除不可撤销 FSA 后约 49% 预计在未来 12 个月确认为收入。GAAP 每股摊薄收益 $2.84、non-GAAP $3.91。公司将 FY2026 全年营收指引上调至 $9,690-9,740M、non-GAAP 每股收益指引上调至 $15.04-15.10，并将全年经营现金流指引给到约 $2,800M、自由现金流约 $2,600M、资本开支约 $225M；前九个月实际经营活动净现金流为 $2,298.6M。全年营收指引含约 $2.98B 预期 Ansys 收入；Ansys 在 Q3 贡献 $622.2M、前九个月贡献 $2.2B。口径提示：同比增幅包含 Ansys 完整期间与上年同期部分期间的对比，不是有机增长口径。Design IP 方面，公司已于 2026-06-01 将原属该分部的 Processor IP Solutions 业务以现金对价 $443.3M 出售给 GlobalFoundries（税前处置收益 $425.4M，扣除 $44.9M 相关费用后净额 $380.5M），公司称此为 Design IP 分部资源向高增长机会再配置的一部分，且未按终止经营列示；10-Q 另载明第三季度 2025 年实施并其后撤销的部分 BIS 对华限制曾对公司在华业务、含 Design IP 分部产生负面影响。全年指引前提为出口管制与美国政府实体清单限制不再发生进一步变化。此外，公司 2026-08-26 提交 Form 8-K/A（事项 2.05，accession 0001193125-26-368858）披露董事会于 2026-08-21 批准上调 2025-11-09 重组计划的税前费用估计区间至 $425M-$500M，主要为遣散与一次性离职福利及全球厂址策略下的部分场地关闭；该文件未将上述重组与 Ansys 整合相联系，本条亦不作此归因。
detail.en: Per Exhibit 99.1 to Synopsys' Form 8-K filed August 26, 2026 (Item 2.02, accession 0001193125-26-368620) and the Form 10-Q filed the same day (accession 0000883241-26-000025, quarter ended July 31, 2026): Q3 FY2026 revenue was $2,476.8M versus $1,739.7M a year earlier (+42%), comprising Design Automation of $2,003.0M (+53% year over year) and Design IP of $473.8M (+11% year over year). On a nine-month basis Design Automation was $5,826.6M (+69%) while Design IP was $1,335.0M versus $1,344.7M a year earlier, **down 1%**. Contracted but unsatisfied performance obligations (backlog) were $10.9B as of July 31, 2026, including $1.9B of non-cancellable FSA commitments; excluding non-cancellable FSA, about 49% is expected to be recognized as revenue over the next twelve months. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.84 and non-GAAP diluted EPS $3.91. The company raised full-year FY2026 revenue guidance to $9,690-9,740M and non-GAAP EPS guidance to $15.04-15.10, and set full-year operating cash flow guidance at about $2,800M, free cash flow at about $2,600M and capital expenditures at about $225M; actual nine-month net cash provided by operating activities was $2,298.6M. Full-year revenue guidance includes about $2.98B of expected Ansys revenue, and Ansys contributed $622.2M in the quarter and $2.2B over nine months. Caliber note: the year-over-year growth rates compare a full period of Ansys against a partial prior-year period and are not an organic-growth caliber. Within Design IP, the company completed the sale of its Processor IP Solutions business to GlobalFoundries on June 1, 2026 for total cash consideration of $443.3M, recognizing a $425.4M pre-tax gain and a $380.5M net pre-tax gain after $44.9M of divestiture-related expenses; the company describes this as part of reallocating Design IP resources to its highest-growth opportunities and did not present it as discontinued operations. The 10-Q separately states that China export-control restrictions, including certain BIS restrictions imposed in the third quarter of 2025 and subsequently rescinded, negatively impacted its business in China including in the Design IP segment. Full-year targets assume no further changes to export control restrictions or the current U.S. government Entity List restrictions. Separately, the company's Form 8-K/A filed August 26, 2026 (Item 2.05, accession 0001193125-26-368858) discloses that on August 21, 2026 the Board approved updated pre-tax charge estimates for the restructuring plan approved on November 9, 2025, now ranging from $425M to $500M, consisting primarily of severance and other one-time termination benefits and costs such as certain site closures under its global site strategy; that filing does not connect the restructuring to the Ansys integration and this entry does not impute such a connection.

title.zh: Nebius 可转债发行完成交割，选择权全额行使后原始本金合计升至 57.5 亿美元
title.en: Nebius closes its convertible notes offering at US$5.75B of original principal after the options are exercised in full

detail.zh: 据 Nebius Group 2026-08-24 提交的 Form 6-K 及其附件 99.1 新闻稿（accession 0001104659-26-100347，新闻稿标注阿姆斯特丹 2026-08-24）：此前于 2026-08-19 定价的两档可转换优先票据私募发行已完成交割。初始购买人全额行使增购选择权，额外认购 2030 档 4.50 亿美元与 2034 档 3.00 亿美元，故 0.50% 票息 2030 年到期档原始本金总额为 34.5 亿美元、4.50% 票息 2034 年到期档为 23.0 亿美元，合计 57.5 亿美元；新闻稿标题将该数字表述为「总募资毛额约 57.5 亿美元」，正文表述为「原始本金总额」。公司同日与 U.S. Bank Trust Company, N.A. 签署两份日期为 2026-08-24 的契约。募集资金用途表述与定价时相同，在数据中心建设与扩建、全栈 AI 云投资、数据中心版图扩张、含 GPU 在内的关键部件采购之外并列一般公司用途。证据限制：本次新闻稿未披露净募资金额（定价新闻稿对选择权全额行使情形的估计为约 56.8 亿美元，属当时估计而非本次披露）；发行人未在本次披露中重述其 2026 年资本开支「>90% 已锁定」的覆盖比例；以约 1,580 万股 A 类普通股换取 2029 与 2031 两档存量可转债各 4.00 亿美元原始本金的换股安排与定价时公布一致，不是本次新增披露。本条只记录交割这一事实本身，不据此重算估值、稀释或净现金，`nebius-2026:funding-durability` 维持 unclear。
detail.en: Per Nebius Group's Form 6-K furnished 2026-08-24 and its Exhibit 99.1 press release (accession 0001104659-26-100347; release dated Amsterdam, August 24, 2026): the two-series private offering of convertible senior notes priced on 2026-08-19 has closed. The initial purchasers exercised their options in full, purchasing an additional US$450M of the 2030 Notes and US$300M of the 2034 Notes, so the aggregate original principal amount is US$3.45B for the 0.50% notes due 2030 and US$2.3B for the 4.50% notes due 2034, US$5.75B in total. The release headlines that figure as aggregate gross proceeds of approximately US$5.75B and states it in the body as total aggregate original principal amount. Two indentures dated August 24, 2026 were entered into with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association as trustee. Use-of-proceeds language is unchanged from pricing and still lists general corporate purposes alongside data-center construction and build-out, full-stack AI cloud investment, footprint expansion and procurement of key components including GPUs. Evidence limits: this release discloses no net-proceeds figure (the pricing release estimated about US$5.68B for the full-exercise case, which is that release's estimate rather than a disclosure made here); the issuer does not restate its ">90% secured" coverage of 2026 capex in this disclosure; and the exchange of approximately 15.8M Class A ordinary shares for US$400M of original principal of each of the 2029 and 2031 series is unchanged from pricing and is not newly disclosed here. This entry records the fact of closing only; valuation, dilution and net cash are not recomputed and `nebius-2026:funding-durability` remains unclear.

title.zh: 金盘科技 2026 半年报：数据中心新签订单 38.69 亿元（同比 +336.25%）、在手订单 50.92 亿元，同期经营活动现金流净额转负至 -0.24 亿元
title.en: Jinpan Technology H1 2026: data-center new orders of RMB 3.869B (up 336.25% YoY) and RMB 5.092B of data-center backlog, while net operating cash flow turned negative at RMB -23.76M

detail.zh: 据海南金盘智能科技股份有限公司 2026-08-21 在上交所披露的《2026 年半年度报告》（未经审计，报告期截至 2026-06-30）：营业收入 35.56 亿元（同比 +12.73%）、归母净利 3.03 亿元（+14.23%）、毛利率 27.41%（+1.53 个百分点）；新签订单 74.93 亿元（+69.31%）、期末在手订单 106.97 亿元（+41.87%）。其中数据中心新签订单 38.69 亿元（+336.25%）、收入 12.65 亿元（+122.57%）、在手订单 50.92 亿元（+179.07%）；海外新签订单 41.90 亿元（+270.69%）、收入 14.81 亿元（+68.30%）、在手订单 62.39 亿元（+122.65%）。同期经营活动现金流净额为 -23,762,688.51 元，上年同期 +234,788,194.63 元，同比 -110.12%；发行人归因于订单增长带来的提前备货、原材料锁价预付款及新能源电站项目材料设备付款，并提示营运资金缺口扩大。证据限制：订单和在手订单是发行人口径，报告没有披露交付排期、客户名称或可撤销条款，不能视为确认收入或锁定产能；数据中心与海外口径可能重叠，不可相加。报告仅披露 10kV/2.4MW SST 样机完成设计生产、13.8kV 北美样机送测及研发投入，没有披露 SST 商业订单或确认收入，不能把未披露推断为零。应收及合同资产较期初 +5.91%，与收入同比口径不可直接比较。毛利率改善包含金额未披露的美国关税退款冲减成本，无法拆分其贡献。
detail.en: Per Hainan Jinpan Smart Technology's 2026 Semi-Annual Report disclosed through the SSE on 2026-08-21 (unaudited, period ended 2026-06-30), revenue was RMB 3.556B (+12.73% YoY), parent net profit RMB 303M (+14.23%) and gross margin 27.41% (+1.53 points). New orders were RMB 7.493B (+69.31%) and period-end backlog RMB 10.697B (+41.87%). Data-center new orders were RMB 3.869B (+336.25%), revenue RMB 1.265B (+122.57%) and backlog RMB 5.092B (+179.07%); overseas new orders were RMB 4.190B (+270.69%), revenue RMB 1.481B (+68.30%) and backlog RMB 6.239B (+122.65%). Net operating cash flow was RMB -23.76M versus RMB +234.79M a year earlier, down 110.12%; the issuer attributes the swing to advance stocking against higher backlog, raw-material price-lock prepayments and power-station project equipment payments, and says it widened the working-capital gap. Evidence limits: order figures are issuer-defined, with no delivery schedules, named customers or cancellation terms; data-center and overseas categories may overlap and cannot be added. The filing discloses only a completed 10kV/2.4MW SST prototype, a 13.8kV North America prototype sent for testing and R&D spending; it does not disclose SST commercial orders or recognized revenue, and absence of disclosure is not evidence of zero. Receivables plus contract assets rose 5.91% from period start, which is not comparable with year-over-year revenue growth. An undisclosed U.S. tariff refund reduced cost, so its gross-margin contribution cannot be separated.

title.zh: Nebius 可转债定价并上调规模至 50 亿美元：2030 档票息 0.50%、2034 档 4.50%，预计净募资约 49.4 亿美元，2026-08-24 交割
title.en: Nebius prices and upsizes its convertible offering to US$5.0B: 0.50% 2030 notes and 4.50% 2034 notes, estimated net proceeds about US$4.94B, settlement expected 2026-08-24

detail.zh: 据 Nebius Group N.V. 于 2026-08-20 提交的 Form 6-K 及其附件 99.1 新闻稿（新闻稿标注发布日为 2026-08-19）：公司宣布其可转换优先票据私募发行已完成定价，原始本金总额由此前公告的 45.0 亿美元上调至 50.0 亿美元，分两档——30.0 亿美元 0.50% 票息、2030 年 2 月 15 日到期；20.0 亿美元 4.50% 票息、2034 年 2 月 15 日到期，依 Rule 144A 面向合格机构买家发行。发行预计于 2026-08-24 交割，以惯常交割条件为前提。公司另授予初始购买人在票据首次发行日起 13 天内额外购买至多 4.50 亿美元（2030 档）与 3.00 亿美元（2034 档）的选择权。公司估计本次发行净募资约 49.4 亿美元（若初始购买人全额行使选择权则约 56.8 亿美元），系扣除初始购买人折扣、佣金及预计发行费用后的口径。2030 档初始转换率为每 1,000 美元原始本金 3.1902 股 A 类普通股，对应初始转换价约 313.46 美元，较 2026-08-19 纳斯达克收盘价 223.90 美元溢价约 40.0%；2034 档初始转换率为 3.0802 股，对应初始转换价约 324.65 美元，溢价约 45.0%。票据到期应付原始本金加按契约增值表计算的增值额，2030 档增值至原始本金的 110%、2034 档增值至 125%；计入到期增值额后，发行人披露的有效转换价为 2030 档约 344.81 美元（有效溢价约 54.0%）、2034 档约 405.82 美元（有效溢价约 81.3%）。募集资金用途按发行人原文：为业务持续增长提供资金，包括数据中心建设与扩建相关支出、发展全栈 AI 云的投资、数据中心版图扩张、含 GPU 在内的关键部件采购，以及一般公司用途。公司同时与少数 2029 年 2.00% 及 2031 年 3.00% 存量可转债持有人达成换股协议，以合计约 1,580 万股 A 类普通股换取 4.00 亿美元 2029 年票据与 4.00 亿美元 2031 年票据的原始本金，换股交易亦预计于 2026-08-24 前后交割；发行人明确本次票据发行的完成不以换股交易的完成为前提。证据限制：交割尚未发生，仍以惯常交割条件为前提；4.50 亿与 3.00 亿美元为初始购买人选择权而非已发行金额；发行人未在本新闻稿中重述其「2026 年资本开支 >90% 已锁定」的口径，故本条不构成对该覆盖率的重新验证；发行人亦未披露本次发行的到期收益率，上述票息、增值比例与有效转换价均按发行人原文记录，未据以推算综合资金成本。本条不重算估值、企业价值、稀释或净现金头寸。
detail.en: Per the Form 6-K furnished by Nebius Group N.V. on 2026-08-20 and its Exhibit 99.1 press release (the release is dated 2026-08-19): the company announced the pricing of its private offering of convertible senior notes, upsized from the previously announced US$4.50B to US$5.00B aggregate original principal amount, in two series — US$3.00B of 0.50% notes due February 15, 2030 and US$2.00B of 4.50% notes due February 15, 2034 — offered to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A. The issuance and sale are expected to settle on August 24, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. The company also granted the initial purchasers an option, exercisable within 13 days of first issuance, to buy up to an additional US$450M of 2030 notes and US$300M of 2034 notes. The company estimates net proceeds of approximately US$4.94B (or approximately US$5.68B if the initial purchasers fully exercise their option), after deducting initial purchasers' discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses. The initial conversion rate for the 2030 notes is 3.1902 Class A ordinary shares per US$1,000 of original principal, an initial conversion price of about US$313.46, a premium of approximately 40.0% over the US$223.90 last reported Nasdaq sale price on August 19, 2026; the 2034 notes convert at 3.0802 shares, an initial conversion price of about US$324.65, a premium of approximately 45.0%. The notes are repayable at maturity at original principal plus an accreted amount per an indenture accretion schedule, reaching 110% of original principal for the 2030 notes and 125% for the 2034 notes; taking that accretion into account, the issuer discloses effective conversion prices of about US$344.81 for the 2030 notes (an effective premium of approximately 54.0%) and about US$405.82 for the 2034 notes (approximately 81.3%). Use of proceeds, in the issuer's own words, is to finance the continuing growth of its business, including expenditures related to the construction and build-out of its data centers, investments to develop its full-stack AI cloud, the expansion of its data center footprint, the procurement of key components (including GPUs), and general corporate purposes. Concurrently the company entered into exchange agreements with a limited number of holders of its 2.00% 2029 and 3.00% 2031 convertibles, exchanging US$400M of original principal of the 2029 notes and US$400M of the 2031 notes for an aggregate of approximately 15.8 million Class A ordinary shares, with those exchanges also expected to settle on or about August 24, 2026; the issuer states the notes offering is not contingent on completion of the exchanges. Evidence limits: settlement has not yet occurred and remains subject to customary closing conditions; the US$450M and US$300M are initial-purchaser options, not issued amounts; the issuer does not restate its '>90% secured' 2026 capex caliber in this release, so this entry is not a re-verification of that coverage ratio; and the issuer discloses no yield to maturity, so the coupons, accretion percentages and effective conversion prices above are recorded as the issuer states them and are not used here to derive an all-in cost of capital. This entry does not recompute valuation, enterprise value, dilution or the net cash position.

title.zh: Nebius 宣布拟私募发行 45 亿美元可转换优先票据，募集资金用途明确点名数据中心建设与 GPU 等关键部件采购
title.en: Nebius announces a proposed US$4.50B private placement of convertible senior notes, with use of proceeds explicitly naming data-center construction and procurement of key components including GPUs

detail.zh: 据 Nebius Group N.V.（NASDAQ: NBIS）于 2026-08-19 提交的 Form 6-K 及其附件 99.1 新闻稿（新闻稿日期 2026 年 8 月 19 日，阿姆斯特丹）。（1）发行规模与结构：公司宣布拟发行原始本金总额 45.0 亿美元的可转换优先票据，分两档——2030 年到期 27.5 亿美元、2034 年到期 17.5 亿美元；面向合格机构买家、依据 1933 年证券法 Rule 144A 私募。公司预计另授予初始购买人一项选择权，可在票据首次发行日起（含当日）13 天内额外购买至多 3.75 亿美元的 2030 年票据与至多 3.00 亿美元的 2034 年票据。（2）募集资金用途，按发行人原文：为业务持续增长提供资金，包括与其数据中心建设与扩建相关的支出、发展全栈 AI 云的投资、数据中心版图扩张、关键部件（包括 GPU）的采购，以及一般公司用途。（3）票据条款：优先无担保债务，按原始本金半年付息；2030 年票据于 2030-02-15、2034 年票据于 2034-02-15 到期，届时应付金额为原始本金加按契约所载增值表计算的增值额（合称 Accreted Principal Amount），该增值表使其在到期日达到相对原始本金的一定溢价；但行使转换权时，转换率与转换价按原始本金而非增值后本金计算。转换结算由公司选择以现金、A 类普通股或两者组合支付（受荷兰税法相关条件限制）。2030 年票据在 2028-02-21 前、2034 年票据在 2028-08-21 前不可赎回（特定税法变更除外）。（4）同步换股安排：公司预期在票据定价的同时，与其 2029 年到期 2.00% 可转债及/或 2031 年到期 3.00% 可转债的少数持有人，通过单独的私下协商交易签署换股协议，以 A 类普通股（面值 0.01 欧元）交换部分存量可转债；各笔条款逐一协商。（5）证据限制，必须与上述事实一并阅读：这是一份**拟发行公告**，发行以市场及其他条件为前提；新闻稿未披露票息、转换价、转换溢价或增值表数值，故本次发行的资金成本无法从一手源计算。3.75 亿与 3.00 亿美元为初始购买人的**选择权**，非已发行金额。换股交易不构成本次发行的前提条件，新闻稿明确表示无法保证其完成、亦无法确定最终换股规模。募集资金用途在点名数据中心建设、版图扩张与含 GPU 的关键部件采购之外，同时并列了『一般公司用途』，因此并非全额专款专用。本条目不换算任何倍数、企业价值或产能数字。
detail.en: Per Nebius Group N.V. (NASDAQ: NBIS) Form 6-K furnished 2026-08-19 and its Exhibit 99.1 press release dated August 19, 2026 (Amsterdam). (1) Size and structure: the company announced its intention to offer US$4.50B aggregate original principal amount of convertible senior notes in two series — US$2.75B due 2030 and US$1.75B due 2034 — in a private offering to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A of the Securities Act of 1933. The company also expects to grant the initial purchasers an option, for settlement within 13 days from and including the first issuance date, to purchase up to an additional US$375M of 2030 Notes and up to an additional US$300M of 2034 Notes. (2) Use of proceeds, in the issuer's own words: to finance the continuing growth of its business, including expenditures related to the construction and build-out of its data centers, investments to develop its full-stack AI cloud, the expansion of its data center footprint and the procurement of key components (including GPUs), and for general corporate purposes. (3) Note terms: senior unsecured obligations bearing interest semi-annually in arrears on the original principal amount; the 2030 Notes mature 2030-02-15 and the 2034 Notes 2034-02-15, when the original principal plus an accreted amount (together the Accreted Principal Amount) is payable, calculated per an accretion schedule to be included in the respective indenture such that it reaches a premium to original principal at maturity — but for conversion purposes the conversion rate and price are based on original principal, not the Accreted Principal Amount. Conversions settle in cash, Class A shares, or a combination at the company's election, subject to conditions related to Dutch tax law. The notes are not redeemable before 2028-02-21 (2030 Notes) and 2028-08-21 (2034 Notes), except on certain tax-law changes. (4) Concurrent exchanges: concurrently with pricing, the company expects to enter into separately and privately negotiated exchange agreements with a limited number of holders of its 2.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2029 and/or 3.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, exchanging a portion of those existing notes for Class A ordinary shares (par value EUR 0.01), on individually negotiated terms. (5) Evidence limits, which must be read alongside the facts above: this is a **proposed** offering, subject to market and other conditions. The release discloses no coupon, conversion price, conversion premium or accretion-schedule figure, so the cost of capital of this offering cannot be computed from the primary source. The US$375M and US$300M amounts are initial-purchaser **options**, not issued amounts. The exchange transactions are not a condition of the offering, and the release states there can be no assurance any will be completed or what aggregate principal, if any, will be exchanged. Beyond naming data-center construction, footprint expansion and procurement of key components including GPUs, the use-of-proceeds language also lists 'general corporate purposes' alongside them, so proceeds are not fully earmarked. This entry computes no multiple, enterprise value or capacity figure.

title.zh: Marvell 8-K：向 Google 发行至多 5,897.0907 万股、行权价 $206.58 的采购挂钩权证，绝大部分份额按每 5 亿美元 Custom Products 收入解锁一档，且系于 Google 的『可自由裁量』采购
title.en: Marvell 8-K: warrant to Google for up to 58,970,907 shares at a $206.58 exercise price, with the bulk vesting one tranche per US$500M of Custom Products revenue and tied to Google's 'discretionary' purchases

detail.zh: 据 Marvell Technology, Inc.（NASDAQ: MRVL）于 2026-08-19 提交、最早事项日期为 2026-08-18 的 Form 8-K（事项 1.01、3.02、9.01）。（1）商业协议：8-K 披露公司与 Google LLC 已于 **2026 年 7 月 29 日** 就公司为 Google 开发定制半导体产品（Custom Products）签署商业协议——协议签署日早于本次披露，本条目登记的新增披露是权证及其解锁机制。8-K 表述该扩大后的合作『涵盖依附于 TPU 生态的一整套定制硅项目』，具体列举 AI 推理加速器、存储控制器、网络接口控制器、内存接口控制器与近内存计算。（2）权证：作为该合作的一部分，公司于 2026-08-18 向 Google 发行权证，可购买公司普通股合计至多 58,970,907 股，行权价每股 $206.58。（3）解锁机制：其中 1,360,867 股（Time-Based Warrant Shares）自商业协议与权证签署后第一年内按季等额解锁；**其余份额按 Google 及其关联方（或代其）自公司 2027 财年第三季度起至 2033 财年结束期间的『可自由裁量』（discretionary）采购解锁，共 240 个等额档位，每 5 亿美元 Custom Products 收入解锁一档**。行权价与股数受惯常调整条款约束。（4）其他条款：权证自发行日起至 2033-08-18 可全部或部分行权；除转让予受控关联方外，未经公司同意不得转让；权证股份可自由交易，但受证券法、特定交易量限制约束，Time-Based 部分另受一定锁定限制；Google 就权证股份享有惯常登记权。权证及其股份依 1933 年证券法第 4(a)(2) 条豁免登记发行。（5）证据限制，必须与上述事实一并阅读：**8-K 未披露任何收入、订单、backlog 或采购承诺金额**，解锁档位所依附的采购被发行人自身明确定性为『可自由裁量』，因此不构成已承诺的客户采购或可确认收入；本条目不将档位机制换算为任何合计金额。8-K 亦未披露公司对该权证的会计处理（例如是否作为冲减收入列示），故该问题仍未解决。附件 4.1（权证协议）的部分证物与附表已依 Regulation S-K 第 601(a)(5) 条省略。
detail.en: Per Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL) Form 8-K filed 2026-08-19 with a date of earliest event reported of 2026-08-18 (Items 1.01, 3.02, 9.01). (1) Commercial agreement: the 8-K discloses that the company and Google LLC entered into a commercial agreement relating to the company's development of custom semiconductor products ('Custom Products') for Google on **July 29, 2026** — the agreement predates this disclosure, and what this entry logs as newly disclosed is the warrant and its vesting mechanics. The 8-K describes the expanded partnership as spanning 'a comprehensive range of custom silicon programs that attach to the TPU ecosystem,' specifically naming AI inference accelerators, storage controllers, network interface controllers, memory interface controllers, and near-memory compute. (2) Warrant: in connection with the collaboration, on 2026-08-18 the company issued Google a warrant to purchase up to an aggregate of 58,970,907 shares of its common stock at an exercise price of $206.58 per share. (3) Vesting: 1,360,867 of those shares (the Time-Based Warrant Shares) vest in equal quarterly installments during the first year following execution of the commercial agreement and the warrant; **the remaining shares vest based on 'discretionary' purchases by or on behalf of Google and its affiliates from the company's third quarter of fiscal 2027 through the end of fiscal year 2033, in 240 equal tranches, with one tranche vesting for each US$500 million in Custom Products revenue**. Exercise price and share count are subject to customary adjustments. (4) Other terms: the warrant is exercisable in whole or in part after issuance until 2033-08-18; it may not be transferred other than to controlled affiliates without the company's consent; the warrant shares are freely tradeable subject to securities laws, specified trading-volume restrictions and, for the Time-Based Warrant Shares, certain lock-up limitations; Google has customary registration rights over the warrant shares. The warrant and shares are issued in reliance on the Section 4(a)(2) exemption of the Securities Act of 1933. (5) Evidence limits, which must be read alongside the facts above: **the 8-K discloses no revenue, order, backlog or purchase-commitment amount**, and the purchases the tranches attach to are characterised by the issuer itself as 'discretionary', so they are not committed customer purchases or recognized revenue; this entry does not convert the tranche mechanics into any aggregate figure. The 8-K also does not disclose the company's accounting treatment of the warrant (for example whether it is presented as contra-revenue), so that question is unresolved. Certain exhibits and schedules to Exhibit 4.1 (the Warrant Agreement) have been omitted under Regulation S-K Item 601(a)(5).

title.zh: NVIDIA 8-K：就俄亥俄 PORTS-Pike 园区约 4.25 GW IT 负荷租约签署剩余价值担保，付款义务累计上限 1,050 亿美元，承租方为 OpenAI 关联方；另投资 SB Energy 15 亿美元
title.en: NVIDIA 8-K: residual value guaranties on leases for ~4.25 GW of IT load at Ohio's PORTS-Pike campus, payment obligation capped at US$105B cumulatively, with an OpenAI affiliate as tenant; plus a US$1.5B investment in SB Energy

detail.zh: 据 NVIDIA 于 2026-08-17 提交的 Form 8-K（事项 1.01、2.03、7.01）及其附件 99.1 新闻稿。（1）交易结构：NVIDIA 与 SB Energy Corp. 就俄亥俄州 Pike County 的 PORTS Technology Campus（PORTS-Pike，由已退役的 Portsmouth 气体扩散厂及周边土地改造而来）达成多年期合作，取得土地、电力与厂房外壳（land, power and shell，LPS）产能，用于独家承载 NVIDIA 计算；SB Energy 建设、持有并运营该数据中心，承租方为 OpenAI Group PBC 的关联方，租期 20 年。（2）NVIDIA 的义务：NVIDIA 与作为出租方的 SB Energy 签署多项剩余价值担保（residual value guaranties），对应合计约 4.25 GW IT 负荷的租约；单项担保一般于对应租约起租时生效。NVIDIA 就其初始承诺项下的义务设有累计上限 1,050 亿美元。付款义务须满足特定条件，包括出租方就相关场地达成租约项下的 ready-for-service 条件，预计自 2028 年起。（3）触发与救济：触发事件为 OpenAI 破产导致租约违约、或 OpenAI 未按租约付款；届时 NVIDIA 支付租约担保最低价值与通过替代租约或出售所回收金额之间的差额，并可选择承接租约、要求出租方另行出租、启动出售程序、允许租约终止，或在支付特定项目协议成本的前提下将上述救济推迟最多一年。（4）终止条件：担保义务于以下最早发生者终止——对应租约起租满 20 年、OpenAI 依约终止租约、OpenAI 取得令人满意的信用评级、以及其他惯常终止事件。OpenAI 已同意就 NVIDIA 实际支付的全部金额向其偿付并作出赔偿。（5）扩产选择权：NVIDIA 可自行决定另行提供信用支持以取得额外产能，8-K 表述为约 3.8 GW，新闻稿表述为剩余 3.75 IT-GW，两者合计对应新闻稿所称 OpenAI 作为客户的 8 IT-GW。（6）新闻稿另行披露：OpenAI 将使用该约 4.25 IT-GW 产能部署 NVIDIA 全栈 DSX AI factory 平台；NVIDIA 将向 SB Energy 投资 15 亿美元，与既有股东 SoftBank Group 及 OpenAI 并列；SB Energy 与 SoftBank 将建设至少 10 GW 新增发电、对应 8 IT-GW AI factory 产能，并通过与 AEP Ohio 的合作投入至少 42 亿美元新建区域电网基础设施；园区跨越私有与联邦土地，与 AEP Ohio、美国能源部及美国商务部合作开发，规划产能预计自 2028 年起分阶段投运；社区福利基金由 SB Energy 原定的 4,000 万美元加上 OpenAI 增量的 4,000 万美元，构成 8,000 万美元的初始规模。证据边界：剩余价值担保属于或有义务，不是采购订单、不是收入、也不是 NVIDIA 的资本开支承诺；1,050 亿美元是 NVIDIA 付款敞口的累计上限，不代表已发生或预期发生的支出。8-K 仅说明各项协议通常在相应租约起租时生效，且付款仍须满足包括 ready-for-service 在内的条件（预计自 2028 年起）；文件没有披露已发生触发事件。约 3.8 GW／3.75 IT-GW 的追加产能是 NVIDIA 可自行决定行使的选择权，文件未载明已行使。文件未披露任何 GPU 采购承诺金额、订单价值或交付排期，因此不能据此推断收入、出货或积压订单。OpenAI 的偿付与赔偿承诺来自财务报表不公开的非上市交易对手；文件把「OpenAI 取得令人满意的信用评级」列为终止条件之一，但未载明其当前评级或评级机构。10 GW 发电与 42 亿美元电网投资为 SB Energy 与 SoftBank 的计划金额，不是 NVIDIA 的义务，也不构成已执行的施工或已确认的电网交付。协议文本尚未公开，8-K 载明其格式将作为附件随截至 2026-07-26 季度的 Form 10-Q 提交，届时方可核对完整条款。新闻稿对 15 亿美元 SB Energy 投资未披露交割条件或时间表。本条不含投资建议、评级、价格目标或估值判断。
detail.en: Per NVIDIA's Form 8-K filed 2026-08-17 (Items 1.01, 2.03 and 7.01) and its Exhibit 99.1 press release. (1) Structure: NVIDIA entered a multi-year partnership with SB Energy Corp. covering the PORTS Technology Campus (PORTS-Pike) in Pike County, Ohio — a redevelopment of the decommissioned Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant and surrounding land — securing land, power and shell (LPS) capacity to exclusively host NVIDIA compute. SB Energy will build, own and operate the data center, and an affiliate of OpenAI Group PBC is the tenant under a 20-year lease. (2) NVIDIA's obligation: NVIDIA entered multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy as Lessor, relating to leases for approximately 4.25 gigawatts of IT load in the aggregate; an Agreement generally becomes effective upon commencement of the applicable lease. NVIDIA's aggregate payment obligation is cumulatively capped at US$105 billion for its initial commitment under the Agreements. Payment obligations are subject to specified conditions, including the Lessor satisfying applicable ready-for-service conditions under the lease, expected beginning in 2028. (3) Triggers and remedies: a Trigger Event is OpenAI's insolvency resulting in a lease default, or OpenAI's failure to make lease payments. NVIDIA would then pay the shortfall between the guaranteed minimum value of a lease and amounts recovered through a replacement lease or sale, and may elect to assume the lease, require the Lessor to seek to relet, initiate a sale process, allow termination, or defer these remedies for up to one year while paying specified project agreement costs. (4) Termination: obligations end on the earliest of the 20th anniversary of the applicable lease commencement, OpenAI terminating the lease in accordance with its terms, OpenAI achieving a satisfactory credit rating, and other customary termination events. OpenAI has agreed to reimburse and indemnify NVIDIA for any and all amounts actually paid. (5) Expansion option: NVIDIA may in its sole discretion provide credit support to secure additional capacity — stated as approximately 3.8 GW in the 8-K and as the remaining 3.75 IT-GW in the press release, together corresponding to the 8 IT-GW for which the release names OpenAI as customer. (6) Additional press-release disclosures: OpenAI will use the approximately 4.25 IT-GW to deploy NVIDIA's full-stack DSX AI factory platform; NVIDIA will invest US$1.5B in SB Energy, joining existing investors SoftBank Group and OpenAI; SB Energy and SoftBank will build at least 10 GW of new energy generation, which results in 8 IT-GW of AI factory capacity, and invest at least US$4.2B in new regional grid infrastructure through a partnership with AEP Ohio; the campus spans private and federal land and is being developed in collaboration with AEP Ohio, the U.S. Department of Energy and the U.S. Department of Commerce, with planned capacity expected to come online in phases beginning in 2028; the community benefits fund totals US$80M initially, being SB Energy's originally announced US$40M plus an incremental US$40M from OpenAI. Evidence limits: residual value guaranties are contingent obligations — they are not purchase orders, not revenue, and not an NVIDIA capital-expenditure commitment; the US$105B figure is a cumulative cap on NVIDIA's payment exposure, not spending incurred or expected. The 8-K says an Agreement generally becomes effective on the applicable lease commencement and payment remains subject to conditions including ready-for-service, expected from 2028; it does not disclose that a Trigger Event has occurred. The approximately 3.8 GW / 3.75 IT-GW of additional capacity is an option exercisable at NVIDIA's sole discretion, and the filing does not state that it has been exercised. The filing discloses no GPU purchase-commitment amount, order value or delivery schedule, so no revenue, shipment or backlog inference can be drawn from it. OpenAI's reimbursement and indemnity is a contractual promise from a private counterparty whose financial statements are not public; the guaranty lists OpenAI achieving a satisfactory credit rating as one termination condition but discloses neither its current rating nor a rating agency. The 10 GW of generation and US$4.2B of grid investment are SB Energy and SoftBank plan figures, not NVIDIA obligations, and constitute neither executed construction nor confirmed grid delivery. The agreement text is not yet public: the 8-K states the form of the Agreements will be filed as an exhibit to NVIDIA's Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended 2026-07-26, which is when full terms can be checked. The press release discloses no closing conditions or timetable for the US$1.5B SB Energy investment. This entry contains no investment advice, rating, price target or valuation judgement.

title.zh: Coherent FY2026 Form 10-K：首披分部利润，Datacenter & Communications 分部利润 $1,330M（+47%）；两家客户各占收入 10% 以上；合并合同负债降至 $63M
title.en: Coherent FY2026 Form 10-K: first segment-profit disclosure, Datacenter & Communications segment profit $1,330M (+47%); two customers each above 10% of revenue; consolidated contract liabilities down to $63M

detail.zh: 据 Coherent 于 2026-08-14 提交的 FY2026 Form 10-K（财年截至 2026-06-30）。本条只记录 10-K 相对 2026-08-12 新闻稿 Exhibit 99.1 的新增披露，不重复该新闻稿已记录的事实（已见 signal coherent-q4-fy2026-datacom-mix-fcf）：逐项核对后，分部利润、合同负债、客户集中度三项在新闻稿中不存在、仅见于 10-K；存货（$2,581.0M 对上年 $1,437.6M）不计为新增，新闻稿资产负债表已载有。（1）分部利润，为 2025-07-01 起采用双分部结构后首次披露：Datacenter & Communications 收入 $5,275M（+40%），分部利润 $1,330M（+47%，上财年 $904M）；Industrial 收入 $1,844M（-10%），分部利润 $423M（+4%，上财年 $407M）。据此计算 Datacenter & Communications 分部利润率约 25.2%，上年同期约 24.1%。（2）客户集中度：公司称 fiscal 2026 有两家客户各自贡献超过 10% 的收入，未指名。（3）合同负债：2026-06-30 为 $63M（其他应计负债 $48M＋其他负债 $15M）；上年度合计 $72M 系由已披露的其他应计负债 $63M 加其他负债 $9M 推导，与现金流量表 -$9,307 千美元的变动相互印证。财年内确认了 $51M 上年度合同负债余额对应的收入。（4）NVIDIA 协议条款：10-K 将 2026-03-02 协议描述为非排他性，含数十亿美元级采购承诺与未来产能访问权；另行进行的 $2B NVIDIA 投资记载为普通股私募配售，所得款项用于研发、未来产能与运营。证据边界：分部利润是公司自定义口径，不含股份薪酬、并购与整合费用、无形资产摊销与减值、重组费用及未分摊的公司层面研发／市场／管理费用，位置在毛利率之下，不能等同于分部毛利率；公司仍不公布分部毛利率。合同负债为合并口径，其下降不能证明不存在 NVIDIA 预付款，其他客户余额可形成抵销；且截至财年末该协议仅约四个月，文件本身把相关权利描述为未来权利。10-K 全文未披露经营性 backlog（无形资产表中的 “Backlog and Other” 为已摊销完毕的收购形成无形资产，非订单口径）。两家 10% 以上客户未指名，收入无法归属到该协议。分部利润率为依公司已披露数字所作计算，两年均按重述后口径列示。本条不含投资建议、评级、价格目标或估值判断。
detail.en: Per Coherent's FY2026 Form 10-K, filed 2026-08-14 for the fiscal year ended 2026-06-30. This entry records only what the 10-K adds relative to the 2026-08-12 earnings release Exhibit 99.1, and does not repeat facts already logged from that release (see signal coherent-q4-fy2026-datacom-mix-fcf). Checked item by item against that exhibit: segment profit, contract liabilities and customer concentration are absent from it and present only in the 10-K; inventories ($2,581.0M against $1,437.6M) are not counted as new, because the release's balance sheet already carried them. (1) Segment profit, disclosed for the first time under the two-segment structure adopted 2025-07-01: Datacenter & Communications revenue $5,275M (+40%) with segment profit $1,330M (+47%) against $904M; Industrial revenue $1,844M (-10%) with segment profit $423M (+4%) against $407M. On those figures the Datacenter & Communications segment profit margin is about 25.2% against about 24.1% a year earlier. (2) Customer concentration: the company states that two customers each contributed more than 10% of revenue during fiscal 2026, and does not name them. (3) Contract liabilities: $63M at 2026-06-30 ($48M within other accrued liabilities plus $15M within other liabilities). The prior-year total of $72M is derived from the two disclosed components ($63M within other accrued liabilities plus $9M within other liabilities) and reconciles to the cash-flow statement's -$9,307 thousand change. Revenue of $51M was recognized during the year from the opening contract-liability balance. (4) NVIDIA agreement terms: the 10-K describes the 2026-03-02 agreement as non-exclusive, carrying a multi-billion-dollar purchase commitment together with future access and capacity rights, and records the separate $2B NVIDIA investment as a private placement of common stock whose proceeds support research and development, future capacity and operations. Evidence limits: segment profit is a company-defined measure excluding share-based compensation, acquisition and integration costs, intangible amortization and impairment, restructuring, and unallocated corporate research and development, marketing and general and administrative expenses; it sits below the gross-margin line and is not a segment gross margin, which the company still does not publish. Contract liabilities are a consolidated line, so the decline does not establish that no NVIDIA prepayment exists, because other customers' balances can offset it; and the agreement was roughly four months old at fiscal year-end against rights the filing itself describes as future. The 10-K discloses no operational backlog anywhere — the 'Backlog and Other' line in the intangible-asset table is a fully amortized acquisition-derived intangible, not an order measure. The two customers above 10% are unnamed, so no revenue is attributable to the agreement. The segment profit margins are computed from the company's disclosed figures, with both years stated on the recast basis. This entry contains no investment advice, rating, price target or valuation judgement.

title.zh: Coherent FY2026 Q4：数据中心与通信收入 $1,615.0M（同比 +58.6%），合并 GAAP 毛利率升至 38.5%，但全财年自由现金流为负
title.en: Coherent FY2026 Q4: datacenter & communications revenue $1,615.0M (+58.6% YoY) with consolidated GAAP gross margin up to 38.5%, against a negative full-year free cash flow

detail.zh: 据 Coherent 于 2026-08-12 发布、随 8-K（Item 2.02 / 7.01）作为 Exhibit 99.1 提交的 FY2026 第四财季与全年业绩（财年截至 2026-06-30）：第四财季收入 $2,045.5M，环比 +13.3%、同比 +33.8%；GAAP 毛利率 38.5%（环比 +82bps、同比 +277bps），non-GAAP 毛利率 40.2%（同比 +215bps）；GAAP 摊薄每股收益 $1.19（同比 +$2.02），non-GAAP 摊薄每股收益 $1.74（同比 +$0.74）。分部收入：Datacenter & Communications 第四财季 $1,615.0M，对上一财季 $1,361.6M 为环比 +18.6%，对去年同期 $1,018.3M 为同比 +58.6%；全财年 $5,274.6M 对上财年 $3,755.2M；Industrial 第四财季 $430.5M，低于去年同期 $511.1M，全财年 $1,843.6M 低于上财年 $2,054.9M。合并全财年收入 $7,118.2M，对上财年 $5,810.1M 为 +22.5%，全财年 GAAP 毛利率 37.5%（+233bps）。现金流按新闻稿 Table 4（仅披露全财年、未披露单季）：FY2026 经营活动净现金流入 $79.5M，对上财年 $633.6M；购置物业、厂房及设备 $1,102.9M，对上财年 $440.8M。以经营现金流减资本开支计，FY2026 自由现金流为约 -$1,023.4M，对上财年约 +$192.8M。FY2027 第一财季指引：收入 $2.2-2.4B，non-GAAP 毛利率 39.5%-41.5%，non-GAAP 每股收益 $1.85-2.05。管理层将增长归因于 AI 数据中心架构从铜连接向光连接迁移。证据边界：毛利率仅按合并口径披露，公司未公布分部毛利率，因此“数据中心通信收入增长未稀释毛利率”只在合并层面成立，且合并毛利率扩张与 Industrial 收入下滑同时发生；新闻稿与投资者材料均未披露单季自由现金流、未按季拆分资本开支、未披露 backlog 或购买承诺金额，全文未提及 NVIDIA 或任何客户的长期采购协议转化情况；指引为 non-GAAP 且未提供 GAAP 对账。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per Coherent's fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter and full-year results issued 2026-08-12 and furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to its 8-K under Items 2.02 and 7.01, for the fiscal year ended 2026-06-30: fourth-quarter revenue was $2,045.5M, up 13.3% sequentially and 33.8% year over year; GAAP gross margin was 38.5%, up 82 basis points sequentially and 277 basis points year over year, and non-GAAP gross margin was 40.2%, up 215 basis points year over year; GAAP diluted EPS was $1.19, up $2.02 year over year, and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.74, up $0.74. By segment, Datacenter & Communications revenue was $1,615.0M in the fourth quarter against $1,361.6M in the prior quarter, up 18.6% sequentially, and against $1,018.3M a year earlier, up 58.6% year over year; the full year was $5,274.6M against $3,755.2M. Industrial revenue was $430.5M in the fourth quarter, below the $511.1M reported a year earlier, and $1,843.6M for the full year against $2,054.9M. Consolidated full-year revenue was $7,118.2M against $5,810.1M, up 22.5%, at a full-year GAAP gross margin of 37.5%, up 233 basis points. On cash flow, Table 4 of the release discloses full-year figures only and no quarterly split: fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $79.5M against $633.6M in fiscal 2025, while additions to property, plant and equipment were $1,102.9M against $440.8M. Computed as operating cash flow less additions to property, plant and equipment, fiscal 2026 free cash flow was approximately -$1,023.4M against approximately +$192.8M in fiscal 2025. First-quarter fiscal 2027 guidance is revenue of $2.2 billion to $2.4 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of 39.5% to 41.5%, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.85 to $2.05. Management attributes the growth to AI datacenter architectures transitioning from copper to optical connectivity. Evidence limits: gross margin is disclosed on a consolidated basis only and the company publishes no segment gross margin, so the proposition that datacenter communications growth did not dilute gross margin holds at the consolidated level only, and that consolidated expansion coincided with a decline in Industrial revenue; neither the release nor the investor presentation discloses quarterly free cash flow, a quarterly capital-expenditure split, backlog, or purchase-commitment amounts, and neither mentions NVIDIA or the conversion of any customer long-term purchase agreement; guidance is stated on a non-GAAP basis with no GAAP reconciliation provided. This entry carries no investment advice, rating or price target.

title.zh: Nebius Q2 2026：收入 $582.3M（同比 +454%），调整后 EBITDA 转正至 $236.2M，单季资本开支 $5,657.4M，现金 $8,042.1M 对非流动债务 $8,499.0M
title.en: Nebius Q2 2026: revenue $582.3M (+454% YoY) with adjusted EBITDA turning positive at $236.2M, quarterly capex of $5,657.4M, and cash of $8,042.1M against non-current debt of $8,499.0M

detail.zh: 据 Nebius Group N.V. 于 2026-08-12 提交的两份 6-K（新闻稿 Exhibit 99.1，以及经营与财务回顾及未经审计简明合并财务报表），期间截至 2026-06-30：持续经营收入 Q2 为 $582.3M，去年同期 $105.1M，同比 +454%；H1 为 $981.3M，去年同期 $156.0M。按 H1 减 Q2 推算，Q1 2026 收入为 $399.0M。调整后 EBITDA Q2 为 $236.2M，去年同期为 -$21.0M；H1 为 $365.7M，去年同期 -$74.7M。持续经营净利润／亏损 Q2 为 -$190.4M（去年同期 +$502.5M）；H1 为 +$430.8M（去年同期 +$398.2M）。调整后净亏损 Q2 -$33.2M（去年同期 -$91.5M）。经营成本合计 Q2 $758.2M，占收入 130%（去年同期 206%）；其中折旧摊销 $259.7M（占收入 45%，去年同期 72%）、股份支付合计 $102.5M。现金流：持续经营经营活动净现金流入 Q2 $2,246.1M、H1 $4,504.1M（去年同期分别为 -$167.7M、-$352.0M）；购置物业设备与无形资产 Q2 $5,657.4M、H1 $8,130.3M（去年同期 -$510.6M、-$1,054.5M）；H1 融资活动净流入 $9,160.4M，主要为可转债发行总额 $4,337.5M、库存股出售 $2,846.7M 与预付权证发行 $2,000.0M。资产负债表：现金及等价物 $8,042.1M；非流动债务 $8,499.0M（2025 年末 $4,103.2M）；非流动递延收入 $4,995.8M（$1,302.0M）；物业与设备净额 $13,045.2M（$5,553.3M）；总资产 $27,961.5M（$12,430.6M）。Q2 利息支出 $119.1M（去年同期 $4.8M）。公司在流动性章节把“战略客户合约项下收到的预付款”与股债融资、NVIDIA 投资并列为主要流动性来源。截至 2026-06-30 已发行在外股份 271,855,218 股。证据边界：季度经营现金流入 $2,246.1M 约为同期收入的 3.9 倍，只可能主要由客户预付款与递延收入构成（非流动递延收入同期增加约 $3,693.8M），不得读作经营性盈利转正；两份 6-K 均未披露 ARR、backlog、利用率或任何客户层面的收入占比，也未披露微软或 Meta 的当期收入贡献；净利润的期间波动包含权益证券重估等非现金项目；Avride 与 TripleTen 合并在同一套报表内，未按分部披露 AI 云的独立盈利能力。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per two Forms 6-K furnished by Nebius Group N.V. on 2026-08-12, comprising the results release as Exhibit 99.1 and the operating and financial review with unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, for the period ended 2026-06-30: revenue from continuing operations was $582.3M in the second quarter against $105.1M a year earlier, up 454%, and $981.3M for the first half against $156.0M. Deducting the second quarter from the first half implies first-quarter 2026 revenue of $399.0M. Adjusted EBITDA was $236.2M in the second quarter against -$21.0M a year earlier, and $365.7M for the first half against -$74.7M. Net income or loss from continuing operations was -$190.4M in the second quarter against +$502.5M a year earlier, and +$430.8M for the first half against +$398.2M. Adjusted net loss was -$33.2M in the second quarter against -$91.5M. Total operating costs and expenses were $758.2M in the second quarter, or 130% of revenue against 206% a year earlier, including depreciation and amortization of $259.7M at 45% of revenue against 72%, and total share-based compensation of $102.5M. On cash flow, net cash provided by operating activities from continuing operations was $2,246.1M in the second quarter and $4,504.1M in the first half, against -$167.7M and -$352.0M a year earlier, while purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets were $5,657.4M in the second quarter and $8,130.3M in the first half, against $510.6M and $1,054.5M. First-half net cash provided by financing activities was $9,160.4M, principally $4,337.5M of gross convertible-note proceeds, $2,846.7M from the sale of treasury shares and $2,000.0M from the issuance of prefunded warrants. Balance sheet: cash and cash equivalents were $8,042.1M; non-current debt was $8,499.0M against $4,103.2M at 2025 year end; non-current deferred revenue was $4,995.8M against $1,302.0M; property and equipment net was $13,045.2M against $5,553.3M; and total assets were $27,961.5M against $12,430.6M. Second-quarter interest expense was $119.1M against $4.8M a year earlier. In its liquidity discussion the company lists advances received under strategic customer contracts alongside equity and debt financing and an investment from NVIDIA Corporation as principal sources of liquidity. Shares issued and outstanding at 2026-06-30 were 271,855,218. Evidence limits: quarterly operating cash inflow of $2,246.1M is roughly 3.9 times the quarter's revenue and can only be composed largely of customer prepayments and deferred revenue, with non-current deferred revenue rising about $3,693.8M over the same period, and it must not be read as operations turning profitable; neither 6-K discloses ARR, backlog, utilization, or any customer-level share of revenue, and neither quantifies Microsoft's or Meta's contribution in the period; period-to-period swings in net income include non-cash items such as equity-securities revaluation; and Avride and TripleTen are consolidated in the same statements, so standalone AI-cloud profitability is not disclosed by segment. This entry carries no investment advice, rating or price target.

title.zh: CoreWeave Q2 2026：收入 $2,575M（同比 +112%），RPO $103.7B，前三大客户降至 36%/26%/10%，总有息负债升至 $35.6B
title.en: CoreWeave Q2 2026: revenue $2,575M (+112% YoY), RPO $103.7B, top-three customers down to 36% / 26% / 10%, total indebtedness up to $35.6B

detail.zh: 据 CoreWeave 2026-08-11 发布的 Q2 2026 业绩新闻稿（8-K Item 2.02）与 2026-08-12 提交的 10-Q（期间截至 2026-06-30）：季度收入 $2,575M，去年同期 $1,212M，同比 +112%（10-Q 说明该增幅约 93% 来自既有客户扩容）；上季度收入为 $2,078M（H1 $4,653M 减 Q2）。经营亏损 -$49M（去年同期 +$19M），净亏损 -$626M（去年同期 -$290M），利息净支出 $640M（去年同期 $267M）；调整后 EBITDA $1,510M、利润率 59%（去年同期 $753M、62%）。新闻稿列示的公司口径 revenue backlog 于 2026-06-30 约为 $1,040 亿，并在脚注中说明该数字不含 Q3 初新增的逾 $250 亿净新增客户承诺。10-Q 口径的未履约履约义务（RPO）为 $103.7B，其中 41% 预计在截至 2028-06-30 的头 24 个月内确认为收入、39% 在第 25 至 48 个月、其余在第 49 至 78 个月。客户集中度按 10-Q 披露：2026 年二季度前三大客户分别占收入 36%、26%、10%，无其他客户达到 10%；2025 年二季度为单一客户占 71%。10-Q 另披露 2026 年三季度前签署的客户承诺：OpenAI 自 2025 年 9 月起承诺最高约 $6.5B（至 2031-05-31），Meta 自 2026 年 3 月起初始承诺最高约 $21.0B。资产负债表：总资产 $77,070M（2025 年末 $49,302M），物业与设备净额 $46,736M（$30,557M），经营租赁使用权资产 $16,595M（$8,231M），现金及等价物 $5,524M（$3,127M），递延收入合计 $9.7B（$8.2B）。10-Q 明确表述 2026-06-30 总有息负债为 $35.6B，另有 $10.0B 未提取额度；债务本金到期表为 2026 年剩余 $4,413M、2027 年 $6,184M、2028 年 $4,416M、2029 年 $2,421M、2030 年 $3,221M、其后 $14,896M，合计 $35,551M；经营租赁负债 $16.3B。运营指标：新闻稿称季内 active power 增加近 500MW 至 1.5GW，contracted power 增至约 3.7GW。融资口径需注意区分：新闻稿“$3.1 billion term loan”高亮项对应 2026 年 5 月订立的 DDTL 5.0 额度（SOFR+4.50%，2026 年 11 月起按月摊还至 2031 年 5 月），并非 2026-08-07 事件日的 $2.6B DDTL 5.5 额度（已于 2026-08-07 信号单独记录）；10-Q 后续事项披露 DDTL 5.5 于交割后已提取 $1.2B，该点更新了原信号“已签署但未提取”的表述。证据边界：backlog 为公司自定义口径且明确包含估计金额，与 RPO 不是同一口径；RPO 的确认进度仅按三段区间披露，无法映射到精确的 24 个月现金流；债务本金按自然年度而非 24 个月窗口披露；两份文件均未披露 GPU 租赁 ASP、利用率、单客户合约的毛利率或 GPU 折旧年限敏感性；逾 $250 亿“Q3 初净新增承诺”未计入 backlog，也未按客户拆分。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per CoreWeave's Q2 2026 results release issued 2026-08-11 (8-K Item 2.02) and its Form 10-Q filed 2026-08-12 for the period ended 2026-06-30: quarterly revenue was $2,575M against $1,212M a year earlier, up 112% year over year, and the 10-Q attributes approximately 93% of that increase to expansion within the existing customer base; the prior quarter was $2,078M (H1 $4,653M less Q2). Operating loss was -$49M against +$19M a year earlier, net loss -$626M against -$290M, and interest expense net $640M against $267M; adjusted EBITDA was $1,510M at a 59% margin against $753M at 62%. The release states company-defined revenue backlog of approximately $104 billion as of 2026-06-30 and its footnote states that this figure does not include more than $25 billion of net new customer commitments added in early Q3. The 10-Q reports unsatisfied remaining performance obligations (RPO) of $103.7 billion, of which 41% is expected to be recognized as revenue over the initial 24 months ending 2028-06-30, 39% between months 25 and 48, and the remainder between months 49 and 78. On customer concentration, the 10-Q discloses that the top three customers were 36%, 26% and 10% of revenue for the three months ended 2026-06-30 with no other customer at 10% or more, against a single top customer at 71% for the three months ended 2025-06-30. The 10-Q also describes committed contracts signed before Q3: OpenAI committed to pay up to approximately $6.5 billion through 2031-05-31 under a September 2025 order form, and Meta initially committed to pay up to approximately $21.0 billion under a March 2026 order form. Balance sheet: total assets $77,070M (2025 year end $49,302M), property and equipment net $46,736M ($30,557M), operating lease right-of-use assets $16,595M ($8,231M), cash and cash equivalents $5,524M ($3,127M), and deferred revenue of $9.7 billion ($8.2 billion). The 10-Q states total indebtedness of $35.6 billion as of 2026-06-30 with $10.0 billion of undrawn availability; scheduled principal payments are $4,413M for the remainder of 2026, $6,184M in 2027, $4,416M in 2028, $2,421M in 2029, $3,221M in 2030 and $14,896M thereafter, totalling $35,551M, alongside operating lease liabilities of $16.3 billion. Operationally, the release says active power grew by nearly 500MW during the quarter to reach 1.5GW and total contracted power grew to approximately 3.7GW. One financing distinction matters: the release's '$3.1 billion term loan' highlight corresponds to the DDTL 5.0 Facility entered in May 2026 (SOFR plus 4.50%, amortising monthly from November 2026 with expected final payment in May 2031), and is not the $2.6 billion DDTL 5.5 Facility dated 2026-08-07 that was logged as a separate signal; the 10-Q's subsequent-events disclosure adds that $1.2 billion has been drawn under DDTL 5.5 since closing, which updates that earlier signal's description of it as a signed but undrawn commitment. Evidence limits: revenue backlog is a company-defined measure that expressly includes estimated amounts and is not the same caliber as RPO; the RPO recognition schedule is disclosed only in three coarse bands and cannot be mapped to precise 24-month cash flows; debt principal is disclosed by calendar year rather than over a 24-month window; neither document discloses GPU rental ASPs, utilization, per-contract gross margin, or any GPU-useful-life sensitivity; and the more than $25 billion of early-Q3 net new commitments is excluded from backlog and is not broken out by customer. This entry carries no investment advice, rating or price target.

title.zh: 台积电董事会核准约 US$29,442.50M 资本支出预算，用途重新纳入先进封装，环比低于 5 月的 US$31,284.30M
title.en: TSMC board approves capital appropriations of approximately US$29,442.50M with advanced packaging back in the stated purposes, below the US$31,284.30M approved in May

detail.zh: 据台积电 2026-08-11 提交的 6-K《TSMC Board of Directors Meeting Resolutions》：董事会为配合基于市场需求预测与技术发展蓝图的长期产能规划，核准约 US$29,442.50 百万的资本支出预算，用途主要包括：1) 先进制程产能的建置与升级；2) 先进封装、成熟及／或特殊制程产能的建置与升级；3) 晶圆厂建造与厂务系统安装。与同一系列的历次董事会决议对照（均取自台积电 6-K 原文）：2026-05-12 核准约 US$31,284.30M，用途仅列先进制程产能建置与晶圆厂建造，未列先进封装；2026-02-10 核准约 US$44,962.00M，用途含先进封装；2025-11-11 核准约 US$14,981.60M，用途含先进封装及 2026 年研发资本支出、维持性资本支出与资本化租赁资产。本次金额较 2026-05-12 低约 5.9%，而先进封装重新出现在用途清单中。同一次董事会另核准 2026 年第二季每股 NT$7.0 现金股利，并核准与 Sony Semiconductor Solutions 成立影像感测器合资公司、认购股份不超过 2,820 亿日圆（该合资案由 Sony 控股并合并报表，产品为智慧型手机影像感测器，预计 2029 年量产，不属于 AI 基础设施链，本条不据此记录任何链上读数）。证据边界：资本支出预算是董事会授权额度，不是当期资本支出、不是已下达的设备订单、也不是任何设备供应商的 bookings 或 backlog；公告未披露授权的执行期间、按用途的金额拆分、按厂区的分配，也未点名任何设备或 EDA 供应商；这些授权跨越多年，逐次相加不构成年度资本支出；公告亦未单独披露先进封装的排产或产能数字，这正是 advanced-packaging-ownership 规则所指的披露缺口。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per TSMC's Form 6-K furnished 2026-08-11 titled TSMC Board of Directors Meeting Resolutions: to meet long-term capacity plans based on market demand forecasts and TSMC's technology development roadmap, the board approved capital appropriations of approximately US$29,442.50 million for purposes mainly including 1) installation and upgrade of advanced technology capacity, 2) installation and upgrade of advanced packaging, mature and/or specialty technology capacity, and 3) fab construction and installation of fab facility systems. Against the same series of board resolutions, all taken from TSMC's own 6-K text: 2026-05-12 approved approximately US$31,284.30M for purposes listing only installation of advanced technology capacity and fab construction, with no advanced packaging; 2026-02-10 approved approximately US$44,962.00M including advanced packaging; and 2025-11-11 approved approximately US$14,981.60M including advanced packaging together with 2026 R&D capital investments, sustaining capital expenditures and capitalized leased assets. The current amount is about 5.9% below the 2026-05-12 approval, while advanced packaging reappears in the stated purposes. The same board meeting also approved a NT$7.0 per share cash dividend for the second quarter of 2026 and approved forming a joint venture with Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation for next-generation image sensors, subscribing for shares of not more than 282 billion Japanese yen; that joint venture is controlled and consolidated by Sony, produces smartphone image sensors, and is expected to begin volume production in 2029, so it sits outside the AI-infrastructure chain and no chain reading is recorded from it here. Evidence limits: capital appropriations are a board authorization, not capital expenditure in any period, not equipment orders placed, and not bookings or backlog at any equipment supplier; the announcement discloses no execution period for the authorization, no split of the amount by stated purpose, and no allocation by site, and names no equipment or EDA supplier; these authorizations span multiple years and successive approvals must not be summed into an annual capital-expenditure figure; and the announcement discloses no standalone advanced-packaging bookings or capacity figure, which is precisely the disclosure gap the advanced-packaging-ownership rule describes. This entry carries no investment advice, rating or price target.

title.zh: Almonty Q2 2026：欧洲 APT 报价升至约 US$3,087/MTU，收入同比 +498% 至 C$43.0M；公司整体 WO3 销量环比减少 21.1%，并受发货确认时点影响
title.en: Almonty Q2 2026: European APT quotations reach about US$3,087/MTU and revenue rises 498% year over year to C$43.0M; company-wide WO3 sales volume falls 21.1% sequentially with shipment-recognition timing also in the comparison

detail.zh: 据 Almonty Industries 日期为 2026-08-11、于 2026-08-12 随 Form 6-K 提交的 Q2 2026 业绩新闻稿（Exhibit 99.1）与 MD&A（Exhibit 99.3），期间截至 2026-06-30，金额除另注明外均为加元千元：季度收入 C$42,989，去年同期 C$7,192，同比 +498%；矿业经营利润 C$26,103（去年同期 -C$944）；期间净利润 C$181,797（去年同期 -C$58,209）；调整后 EBITDA（非 IFRS）C$17,564（去年同期 -C$4,761）；基本／摊薄每股收益 C$0.64／C$0.62。MD&A 披露 Q2 收入 C$42,989 对 Q1 C$25,400，同时公司整体 WO3 MTU 销量环比减少 21.1%；但文件也说明部分 3 月发货在 4 月收货并于二季度确认，2026-03-31 递延收入 C$3,442 千元包含该影响。因此环比收入变化同时受报价、实现价与确认时点影响，不能纯归因于价格；公司整体销量也不是 Sangdong 的季度产量或爬坡达成率。Metal Bulletin 欧洲 APT 周报价自 2025 年 1 月 US$330/MTU 升至 2026 年 6 月底 US$3,075/MTU，平均中间价自 2026 年 1 月初 US$862.5/MTU 升至 2026-08-07 约 US$3,087/MTU。Sangdong 一期仍处试车与爬坡，公司称完全投产后目标处理量约每年 640,000 吨，二期规划最高 1,200,000 吨。2026-07-14，公司与 Global Tungsten & Powders LLC 修订 Sangdong 一期长期承购协议：期限延长六年、合约总量提高 40%、全部合约量价格提高约 6.3%。2026-06-09 完成 2.25% 可转换优先票据发行，总收益 US$800M；2026-06-30 现金 C$1.2B。证据边界：净利润与调整后 EBITDA 相差一个数量级，本条不据净利润推断经营性盈利；APT 是第三方市场报价，不是 Almonty 未披露的本季实现价；未披露 Sangdong 绝对产量、季度爬坡目标或达成率；GTP 修订案未披露绝对量与单价。本条未改变估值、立场或价格目标。
detail.en: Per Almonty Industries' Q2 2026 results release and MD&A, both dated August 11 and furnished as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.3 to a Form 6-K filed August 12, 2026 for the period ended June 30, with amounts in thousands of Canadian dollars unless noted: quarterly revenue was C$42,989 versus C$7,192 a year earlier (+498%); mining income was C$26,103 versus a C$944 loss; net income was C$181,797 versus a C$58,209 loss; adjusted EBITDA, a non-IFRS measure, was C$17,564 versus negative C$4,761; and basic / diluted EPS were C$0.64 / C$0.62. The MD&A reports Q2 revenue of C$42,989 versus C$25,400 in Q1 and a 21.1% sequential decline in company-wide WO3 MTUs sold. It also says some March shipments were received and recognized in April, with C$3,442 thousand of deferred revenue at March 31 including that timing effect. Sequential revenue therefore reflects quoted prices, realized pricing and recognition timing and cannot be attributed purely to price; company-wide sales volume is also not Sangdong quarterly production or ramp attainment. The Metal Bulletin European APT weekly quotation rose from US$330/MTU in January 2025 to US$3,075/MTU at June 2026 month-end, while the average mid-price rose from US$862.5/MTU in early January 2026 to about US$3,087/MTU on August 7. Sangdong Phase I remains in commissioning and ramp-up, with targeted throughput of about 640,000 tonnes per year at full operation and up to 1.2 million tonnes under the Phase II plan. On July 14, Almonty amended the long-term Sangdong Phase I offtake with Global Tungsten & Powders LLC to extend the term six years, increase contracted volume 40% and improve pricing about 6.3%. The company closed US$800M of 2.25% convertible senior notes on June 9 and held C$1.2B of cash at June 30. Evidence limits: net income and adjusted EBITDA differ by an order of magnitude, so this entry infers no operating profitability from net income; APT is a third-party market quotation, not Almonty's undisclosed realized price; absolute Sangdong production, a quarterly ramp target and attainment are not disclosed; and absolute GTP volume and unit price are not disclosed. No valuation, stance or price target is changed.

title.zh: SK 海力士董事会核准约 54 兆韩元新建龙仁 Y2 与清州 M17 厂，洁净室分别 2029 年 6 月与 2028 年 12 月开启，设备安装明确按需求分阶段进行
title.en: SK hynix board approves approximately KRW 54 trillion for the new Yongin Y2 and Cheongju M17 fabs, with cleanrooms targeted for June 2029 and December 2028 and equipment installation explicitly phased to demand

detail.zh: 据 SK 海力士 2026-08-07 发布的官方新闻稿（issuer newsroom，标题为 SK hynix Invests 54 Trillion Won in Yongin Y2 and Cheongju M17 to Secure Mid-to-Long-Term Production Base for AI Memory Demand）：公司董事会核准合计约 54 兆韩元的投资，其中龙仁“Y2”厂 35.2 兆韩元、清州“M17”厂 19.1 兆韩元。龙仁 Y2 是龙仁半导体丛集规划四座厂中的第二座，定位为 DRAM 生产基地，总楼地板面积 341,000 坪（约 1,130,000 平方公尺），预计 2027 年 7 月动土、2029 年 6 月开启首座洁净室，用于生产 HBM 与次世代 DRAM，投资期依序延续至 2031 年 10 月；第一座厂 Y1 的首座洁净室目标为 2027 年 2 月。清州 M17 为 NAND 基地，总面积 206,000 坪（约 680,000 平方公尺），预计 2027 年 2 月动土、2028 年 12 月开启首座洁净室，投资期至 2031 年 4 月。公司说明本次决策是对其去年 6 月公布的中长期投资策略的执行，母计划为龙仁半导体丛集 600 兆韩元、清州生产基地扩建 100 兆韩元，并已将龙仁丛集四厂全部完工目标由 2045 年提前 12 年至 2033 年。龙仁丛集支撑至 Y2 运转所需的第一期电力与用水基础设施进度约 99%。需求依据：公司引用市场研究机构 Omdia 的预估，DRAM 与 NAND 需求自去年起至 2030 年维持约 19% 的年复合成长率，并称 NAND 需求由 AI 服务全面扩张带动的企业级 SSD 以及 AI 推论的 KV cache 储存需求推升。证据边界（关键）：公司明确表述“厂房按母时程建造，而洁净室扩充与设备安装将依需求趋势分阶段进行，以最大化资本效率”，因此这 54 兆韩元是已核准的多年期厂房建设与基础设施投资，不是已下达的设备订单，也不构成任何半导体设备或 EDA 供应商的 bookings、backlog 或当期资本支出；新闻稿未披露分年投资金额、未披露晶圆产能（wafer starts）目标、未拆分洁净室各期规模、未点名任何设备供应商，也未量化 HBM 与一般 DRAM 的产能配比；19% 需求成长为第三方机构预估而非公司自身指引；本条未使用任何交易所或监管申报作为来源，仅以发行人官方新闻稿为准。本条为跨窗口补登：事件日为 2026-08-07，在此前的扫描窗口内未被记录。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per SK hynix's official newsroom release dated 2026-08-07, titled 'SK hynix Invests 54 Trillion Won in Yongin Y2 and Cheongju M17 to Secure Mid-to-Long-Term Production Base for AI Memory Demand': the company's board approved a total investment of approximately KRW 54 trillion, comprising KRW 35.2 trillion for the Yongin 'Y2' fab and KRW 19.1 trillion for the Cheongju 'M17' fab. Yongin Y2 is the second of four fabs planned for the Yongin Semiconductor Cluster and will serve as a DRAM production base spanning 341,000 pyeong of total floor area, approximately 1,130,000 square metres; construction is scheduled to break ground in July 2027 targeting the opening of its first cleanroom in June 2029 to produce high-bandwidth memory and other next-generation DRAM, with the investment running sequentially through October 2031. Construction of the first fab, Y1, is targeting an initial cleanroom opening in February 2027. Cheongju M17 is a NAND base covering 206,000 pyeong, approximately 680,000 square metres, breaking ground in February 2027 with a first cleanroom targeted for December 2028 and an investment period running through April 2031. The company describes the decision as execution of the mid-to-long-term investment strategy it announced last June, under a master plan to invest KRW 600 trillion in the Yongin Semiconductor Cluster and KRW 100 trillion to expand the Cheongju production base, and states it has advanced the completion date for all four Yongin fabs by 12 years, from 2045 to 2033. Phase 1 power and water infrastructure required up through Y2 operation is described as approximately 99% complete. On demand, the company cites market research firm Omdia projecting that both DRAM and NAND demand will maintain a 19% compound annual growth rate from last year through 2030, and attributes surging NAND demand to enterprise SSDs driven by the expansion of AI services and to key-value cache storage in AI inference. Evidence limits, and this is the load-bearing one: the company states explicitly that fabs will be constructed according to the master schedule whereas cleanroom expansions and equipment installation will take place sequentially in line with demand trends to maximize capital efficiency. The KRW 54 trillion is therefore an approved multi-year building and infrastructure programme, not equipment orders placed, and it does not constitute bookings, backlog or in-period capital expenditure at any semiconductor-equipment or EDA supplier. The release discloses no annual phasing of the amounts, no wafer-start capacity target, no sizing of individual cleanroom phases, names no equipment supplier, and does not quantify the split between HBM and commodity DRAM capacity; the 19% demand growth figure is a third-party estimate rather than company guidance. No exchange or regulatory filing was used as a source for this entry, which rests on the issuer's official newsroom release alone. This is a cross-window backfill: the event date is 2026-08-07 and it was not recorded in the scan window that contained it. This entry carries no investment advice, rating or price target.

title.zh: 台湾 7 月月度营收：台积电 NT$467,580M（环比 +5.6%、同比 +44.7%），日月光投控 ATM NT$47,524M（环比 +9.3%、同比 +49.5%），封测端同步确认代工端
title.en: Taiwan July 2026 monthly revenue: TSMC NT$467,580M (+5.6% MoM, +44.7% YoY) and ASE Technology ATM NT$47,524M (+9.3% MoM, +49.5% YoY), with the OSAT leg confirming the foundry leg

detail.zh: 据台积电与日月光投控于 2026-08-10 分别提交的 6-K：台积电 2026 年 7 月合并营收 NT$467,580M，较 6 月 NT$442,680M 增长 5.6%，较 2025 年 7 月 NT$323,166M 增长 44.7%；1 至 7 月累计 NT$2,872,064M，同比增长 37.0%。日月光投控 7 月合并营收 NT$73,784M（6 月 NT$65,783M，环比 +12.2%；2025 年 7 月 NT$51,542M，同比 +43.2%），以美元计 US$2,309M（环比 +10.4%、同比 +30.6%）；其中封测（ATM）营收 NT$47,524M（6 月 NT$43,485M，环比 +9.3%；2025 年 7 月 NT$31,783M，同比 +49.5%），以美元计 US$1,487M（环比 +7.6%、同比 +36.4%）。本条按链层读数而非单公司读数记录：同一日、同一披露制度下，代工端与第三方封测端的月度营收同步走强，因此 advanced-packaging-chokepoint 的分歧分支（代工/HBM/ASIC 需求走强但 OSAT 与先进封装产能不予确认）本月未出现。证据边界：台湾月度营收为未经审计、依当地法规披露的口径，仅含营收，不含制程结构、封装结构、毛利率、稼动率或客户明细；日月光投控的合并数含 EMS 等非封测业务，其自身表格中新台币与美元增速的差异显示汇率会影响美元口径；两份公告均未提及 CoWoS 或 HBM 的具体配置，因此不能据此推断先进封装瓶颈的松紧程度、客户排产或下游需求。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per separate 6-K filings made by TSMC and ASE Technology Holding on 2026-08-10: TSMC's consolidated net revenue for July 2026 was NT$467,580M, up 5.6% from June 2026 (NT$442,680M) and up 44.7% on July 2025 (NT$323,166M), with January-July 2026 totalling NT$2,872,064M, up 37.0% year over year. ASE Technology Holding reported July consolidated net revenues of NT$73,784M (June: NT$65,783M, +12.2% sequentially; July 2025: NT$51,542M, +43.2% year over year), or US$2,309M (+10.4% sequentially, +30.6% year over year); within that, ATM (assembly, testing and materials) net revenues were NT$47,524M (June: NT$43,485M, +9.3% sequentially; July 2025: NT$31,783M, +49.5% year over year), or US$1,487M (+7.6% sequentially, +36.4% year over year).
