This is logged as a chain-layer reading rather than a single-company one: on the same date and under the same disclosure regime, the foundry leg and the third-party OSAT leg both strengthened, so the divergence branch of advanced-packaging-chokepoint — foundry/HBM/ASIC demand staying strong while OSAT and advanced-packaging capacity fail to confirm it — did not appear this month. Evidence limits: Taiwan monthly revenue is unaudited and published to satisfy local regulatory requirements; it reports revenue only, with no node mix, packaging mix, gross margin, utilization or customer detail. ASE's consolidated figure includes EMS and other non-ATM businesses, and the divergence between the NT$ and US$ growth rates in the company's own table shows that FX affects the dollar-denominated comparison. Neither release mentions CoWoS or HBM allocation, so nothing here supports an inference about how tight the advanced-packaging bottleneck is, about customer scheduling, or about downstream demand. This entry carries no investment advice, rating or price target.

title.zh: CoreWeave 新增 $2.6B 延迟提取定期贷款（DDTL 5.5），利率 Term SOFR+5.50%、2031-09-01 到期，用于履行客户合约所需的资本开支
title.en: CoreWeave adds a $2.6B delayed draw term loan (DDTL 5.5) at Term SOFR plus 5.50%, maturing 2031-09-01, to fund capex required to perform customer contracts

detail.zh: 据 CoreWeave 于 2026-08-10 提交、最早事件日为 2026-08-07 的 8-K（Item 1.01）：其间接子公司 CoreWeave Financing DDTL V-V, LLC 作为借款人，与摩根大通银行（行政代理、联席主办与簿记行、银团代理）、美国合众银行信托公司（抵押品代理）、美国合众银行（存管行）、三菱日联银行（联席主办与簿记行、银团代理）及各贷款人签署信贷协议，设立 $2.6B 的延迟提取定期贷款额度（DDTL 5.5）。用途为公司所述“履行若干客户合约所需的资本开支，包括购置 GPU 服务器及相关基础设施”。条款：可在 2026 年 12 月的承诺终止日前分一次或多次提取；到期日 2031 年 9 月 1 日；SOFR 贷款利率为 Term SOFR（下限 0.00%）加 5.50% 年息，基准利率贷款为基准利率（取最优惠利率、联邦基金有效利率加 0.50%、一个月期 Term SOFR 加 1.00% 三者最高值，下限 0.00%）加 4.50% 年息；未提取部分按日均余额收取 0.50% 年息的承诺费，按月后付。担保与抵押：母公司依 2026-08-07 的母公司担保与质押协议提供无条件担保，借款人子公司依抵押品协议提供无条件担保，债务以借款人及其子公司几乎全部资产以及 CW Financing DDTL V-V Holdco, LLC 所持借款人 100% 股权质押作担保。契约：自承诺额降为零与 2026-12-31 两者较早发生之日后的首个完整自然月起，借款人须维持不低于 1.35 倍的偿债备付率；协议另含惯常的负面契约与违约事件，包括交叉违约、控制权变更、破产事件，以及与若干重大合约相关的不利事件。证据边界：该额度截至本次披露为已签署但尚未提取的承诺，不是已发生借款，因此不得计入现有债务余额；8-K 未披露相关客户合约的对手方、金额或期限，未披露该额度是否替换其他融资，也未披露 GPU 服务器的采购量或交付时间；披露为对协议全文的摘要。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per CoreWeave's 8-K filed 2026-08-10 under Item 1.01, with a date of earliest event reported of 2026-08-07: CoreWeave Financing DDTL V-V, LLC, an indirect subsidiary of CoreWeave, Inc., entered into a credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent, joint lead arranger, joint bookrunner and syndication agent, U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association as collateral agent, U.S. Bank National Association as depositary bank, MUFG Bank, Ltd. as joint lead arranger, joint bookrunner and syndication agent, and the lenders party thereto, providing for a $2.6 billion delayed draw term loan facility (the DDTL 5.5 Facility). The filing states the facility was entered into primarily to finance capital expenditures required to perform certain customer contracts, including the acquisition of GPU servers and related infrastructure. Terms: loans are available in one or more draws until a commitment termination date in December 2026; the maturity date is September 1, 2031; SOFR loans bear Term SOFR (0.00% floor) plus an applicable margin of 5.50% per annum, and base rate loans bear the base rate (the highest of the prime rate, the federal funds effective rate plus 0.50%, and one-month Term SOFR plus 1.00%, subject to a 0.00% floor) plus 4.50% per annum; undrawn fees of 0.50% per annum accrue on the average daily undrawn portion and are payable monthly in arrears. Guarantees and security: obligations are unconditionally guaranteed by the parent under a parent guarantee and pledge agreement dated 2026-08-07 and by the borrower's subsidiaries under a collateral agreement, and are secured by substantially all assets of the borrower and its subsidiaries plus a pledge of 100% of the equity interests in the borrower held by CW Financing DDTL V-V Holdco, LLC. Covenants: beginning the first full calendar month after the earlier of the date commitments are reduced to zero and 2026-12-31, the borrower must maintain a debt service coverage ratio of at least 1.35x; the agreement also contains customary negative covenants and events of default including cross-defaults, a change of control, bankruptcy events, and events of default tied to certain adverse events with respect to certain material contracts. Evidence limits: as disclosed this is a signed but undrawn commitment, not borrowings incurred, and it must not be added to the existing debt balance. The 8-K does not identify the counterparties, size or term of the customer contracts it references, does not say whether the facility replaces other financing, and gives no GPU server quantities or delivery dates. The description is expressly a summary qualified by the full agreement. This entry carries no investment advice, rating or price target.

title.zh: Vistra Q2 2026：持续经营调整后 EBITDA $1,767M（同比 +$418M），Texas 分部 $311M（去年同期 $142M），重申 2026 指引并取得 Cogentrix 的 FERC 批准
title.en: Vistra Q2 2026: Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA $1,767M (up $418M YoY), Texas segment $311M against $142M, 2026 guidance reaffirmed and FERC approval received for Cogentrix

detail.zh: 据 Vistra 2026-08-07 以 8-K（Item 2.02）附件 99.1 发布的 2026 年第二季度业绩：营业收入 $4,017M（2025Q2 $4,250M），GAAP 净利润 $305M（$327M），下降主因是衍生品未实现按市值计价损失同比增加 $488M，其中本季包含公司称预计在未来年度结算的 $472M 未实现对冲损失。持续经营调整后 EBITDA $1,767M，同比增加 $418M（逾 30%）；分部为 Texas $311M（$142M）、East $642M（$418M）、Retail $773M（$756M）、West $68M（$49M）。公司重申 2026 年持续经营调整后 EBITDA $6,800-7,600M 与增长前自由现金流 $3,925-4,725M 指引，并重述此前公布的 2027 年持续经营调整后 EBITDA 中值机会区间 $7.4-7.8B；两者均不含待完成的 Cogentrix 收购与已签 Meta PPA 的贡献，公司说明 Meta PPA 中的一部分预计自 2027 年起计入调整后 EBITDA。截至 2026-08-03，公司对 2026 年预计发电量套保约 100%、2027 年约 94%、2028 年约 72%。公司已取得 FERC 对待完成 Cogentrix 收购的批准（交易尚未交割）。新闻稿同时列示公司与 KKR、科威特投资局及 NVIDIA 共同宣布 Helix Digital Infrastructure，Vistra 初始承诺至多 $1.0B 并担任 Helix 的首选电力供应商（Helix 本身由 KKR 于 2026-06-11 公开发布）。资本返还：上半年回购 $709M，自 2021 年 11 月以来累计约 $6.5B，2026-08-03 在外流通股约 3.36 亿股，回购授权余额约 $1.2B。2026-06-30 可用流动性约 $6,295M，含现金 $435M。作为 merchant-power-capacity 读数：核电 PPA 之外的一腿本季获得确认——燃气与容量市场价值同步走强，容量溢价未见回落。证据边界：公司把增幅同时归因于已实现电价/容量价格上升与 Lotus 收购电厂三个月贡献，因此这不是纯有机价格确认；新闻稿不含资产负债表，未披露 Q2 净债务或净债务/EBITDA，截至 2026-08-07 尚未提交 10-Q；Helix 的 $1.0B 为承诺额度而非已投出资本，也非订单或收入；Meta uprates 的容量、价格与监管进度本次未披露。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per Vistra's Q2 2026 results, released 2026-08-07 as Exhibit 99.1 to an 8-K under Item 2.02: operating revenues were $4,017M (Q2 2025: $4,250M) and GAAP net income $305M ($327M), the decline driven primarily by a $488M year-over-year increase in unrealized mark-to-market losses on derivatives, the quarter including a $472M unrealized hedge loss the company says is expected to settle in future years. Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA was $1,767M, up $418M (more than 30%) year over year, by segment Texas $311M ($142M), East $642M ($418M), Retail $773M ($756M) and West $68M ($49M). Vistra reaffirmed 2026 guidance of $6,800-7,600M Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA and $3,925-4,725M Ongoing Operations Adjusted FCFbG, and restated the previously announced 2027 Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA midpoint opportunity range of $7.4-7.8B; both exclude the pending Cogentrix acquisition and the signed Meta power purchase agreements, part of which the company expects to contribute to Adjusted EBITDA in 2027. As of 2026-08-03 the company was hedged about 100% of expected 2026 generation volumes, about 94% for 2027 and about 72% for 2028. Vistra received FERC approval of the pending Cogentrix acquisition, which has not closed. The release also lists the announcement of Helix Digital Infrastructure alongside KKR, the Kuwait Investment Authority and NVIDIA, with an initial commitment from Vistra of up to $1.0 billion and Vistra as Helix's preferred power provider (Helix itself was announced publicly by KKR on 2026-06-11). Capital return: $709M of first-half repurchases, about $6.5B cumulatively since November 2021, about 336 million shares outstanding at 2026-08-03, and about $1.2B of remaining authorization. Total available liquidity was about $6,295M at 2026-06-30, including $435M of cash. As merchant-power-capacity evidence, the non-nuclear leg confirmed this quarter: gas and capacity-market value strengthened alongside, and the capacity premium did not fade. Evidence limits: the company attributes the increase to higher realized energy and capacity prices *and* three months of contribution from the plants acquired from Lotus, so this is not a pure organic-price confirmation; the release carries no balance sheet and discloses no Q2 net debt or net-debt/EBITDA, and no 10-Q had been filed as of 2026-08-07; the Helix $1.0B is a commitment ceiling, not deployed capital, an order, or revenue; and no capacity, price or regulatory detail was given for the Meta uprates. This entry contains no investment advice, rating, or price target.

title.zh: 铠侠 Q1 FY2026：营业利润率 71.9%，H1 指引隐含 Q2 约 79%；6 月末已转净现金
title.en: Kioxia Q1 FY2026: 71.9% operating margin, H1 guide implies about 79% for Q2; June balance sheet reached net cash

detail.zh: 据铠侠控股 2026-07-31 Q1 FY2026 决算短信：营收 ¥1,767,117 百万（同比 +415.5%）、营业利润 ¥1,270,017 百万、归母净利润 ¥842,165 百万；H1 指引为营收 ¥4,157,117 百万、营业利润 ¥3,160,017 百万、归母净利润 ¥2,112,165 百万，隐含 Q2 营收 ¥2.39 万亿、营业利润率约 79%。Q1 同比增长由 ASP 上升、bit 出货增加与汇率共同贡献；公司未量化 bit 贡献。6 月末现金 ¥791,014 百万、债券与借款 ¥634,554 百万，约为 ¥156,460 百万净现金（不含租赁）。同日官方公告为 1 股拆为 3 股及上限 ¥800,000 百万 / 3,000 万股回购框架，实际执行可低于上限或为零。业绩与公司行动均在收盘后披露，不能用于解释当日 +17.7% 涨幅。本条是 memory-cycle 的事实读数，不把第三方供需预测当作公司事实。
detail.en: Kioxia Holdings’ 2026-07-31 Q1 FY2026 filing reported revenue of ¥1,767,117M (+415.5% YoY), operating profit of ¥1,270,017M, and profit attributable to owners of ¥842,165M. H1 guidance is ¥4,157,117M revenue, ¥3,160,017M operating profit, and ¥2,112,165M attributable profit, implying Q2 revenue of ¥2.39T and about 79% operating margin. The year-over-year increase reflected higher ASPs, increased bit shipments, and favorable FX; bit contribution was not quantified. June cash of ¥791,014M less ¥634,554M of bonds and borrowings equals about ¥156,460M net cash before leases. Official same-day disclosures authorize a 3-for-1 split and a buyback facility up to ¥800,000M / 30M shares, with actual purchases potentially below the ceiling or zero. Results and corporate actions were released after the close and cannot explain the same-day 17.7% move. This is a factual memory-cycle reading and does not present third-party supply forecasts as issuer facts.

title.zh: 韩国 7 月正式贸易统计：半导体出口约 410 亿美元、同比约 +179%，连续第二个月突破 400 亿美元
title.en: Korea's official July trade data: semiconductor exports about $41.0B, roughly +179% YoY, above $40B for a second month

detail.zh: 据韩国产业通商部（산업통상부；官方英文站 MOTIR）2026-08-01 发布的《2026 年 7 月进出口动向》：7 月出口 988.9 亿美元（同比 +62.8%）、进口 685.6 亿美元（+26.5%）、贸易顺差 303.2 亿美元；半导体出口 410.1 亿美元（+178.8%），继 6 月之后连续第二个月超过 400 亿美元。日均出口额 41.2 亿美元（+69.6%），连续第三个月超过 40 亿美元。对华出口 216.89 亿美元（+96.2%）；对美出口 174.39 亿美元（+68.7%），官方说明 AI 数据中心投资持续，并同时列举半导体、计算机、电气设备和钢铁等相关品目增长，不能把全部对美增幅归因于 AI。作为国家级高频读数，本条用于交叉验证 memory-cycle 的出口金额与厂商定价、利润及需求叙事。它是正式全月统计，与关税厅 7 月 1–20 日暂定值（korea-semiconductor-exports-2026-07-1-20）属于不同观察窗口。证据边界：该口径是美元出口金额，不是出货量或 bit 数，无法分离价格与数量贡献，因此确认的是出口金额强势而非独立的需求量或毛利率；数据未拆分 HBM、传统 DRAM 与 NAND，也未披露客户或终端应用；自韩国报关出口不等同于终端 sell-through；月度通关数字后续仍可能修订。
detail.en: Korea's Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources (산업통상부; MOTIR) reported on 2026-08-01 that July exports were $98.89B (+62.8% YoY), imports were $68.56B (+26.5%), and the trade surplus was $30.32B. Semiconductor exports were $41.01B (+178.8%), above $40B for a second consecutive month after June. Average daily exports were $4.12B (+69.6%), above $4B for a third month. Exports to China were $21.689B (+96.2%); exports to the United States were $17.439B (+68.7%). The ministry said AI-data-center investment continued and listed growth across semiconductors, computers, electrical equipment and steel, so the whole U.S. increase cannot be attributed to AI. As a country-level high-frequency reading, this signal cross-checks memory-cycle export value against producer pricing, profit and demand narratives. It is the official full-month observation and a different window from the Korea Customs Service 1-20 July provisional already logged as korea-semiconductor-exports-2026-07-1-20. Evidence limits: this is USD export value, not volume or bit shipments, so price and quantity cannot be separated and the reading confirms export-value strength rather than independent demand volume or margins; it provides no HBM / conventional DRAM / NAND, customer or end-application split; customs-cleared exports are not end-customer sell-through; and monthly customs-basis figures may be revised.

title.zh: 三星 2026 Q2 正式财报：DS 分部营业利润 ₩89.2T，内存业务营收与利润创季度新高
title.en: Samsung Q2 2026 full results: DS operating profit KRW 89.2T, Memory Business at quarterly revenue and profit highs

detail.zh: 据三星电子 2026-07-30 官方 Q2 业绩（季度截至 2026-06-30）：合并营收 ₩171.5T、营业利润 ₩89.5T；Device Solutions（DS）分部营收 ₩127.5T、营业利润 ₩89.2T。公司称内存业务季度营收与营业利润均创历史新高、服务器收入占销售组合的比重创新高，HBM4 销售放量并向主要客户交付首批 HBM4E 样品；Device eXperience（DX）销售额环比下降 9%，MX 与 Networks 录得 ₩0.7T 营业亏损。公司预计 H2 的服务器 DRAM、eSSD 与 HBM 需求受 AI 基础设施资本开支和 agentic AI 采用推动。作为 memory-cycle 读数，正式分部拆分表明集团利润高度集中于 DS，并补充了 2026-07-07 初步指引留下的分部归因空白。证据边界：三星没有单独披露内存业务营收、营业利润或利润率的具体数字；“历史新高”是公司定性表述，DS 口径还包含 System LSI 与 Foundry，不能把 ₩89.2T 等同于内存利润，也不能据此断言内存利润率上升。H2 需求和供给约束为公司前瞻指引，不是已实现业绩。本条不推断下游交付、客户份额或终端消化。
detail.en: Samsung Electronics' official Q2 2026 results, released 2026-07-30 for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, reported consolidated revenue of KRW 171.5T and operating profit of KRW 89.5T. The Device Solutions (DS) Division posted KRW 127.5T of revenue and KRW 89.2T of operating profit. Samsung characterized Memory Business quarterly revenue and operating profit as all-time highs, said server revenue reached a record share of the sales mix, scaled HBM4 sales and shipped initial HBM4E samples to major customers. Device eXperience (DX) sales fell 9% QoQ and MX & Networks posted a KRW 0.7T operating loss. The company expects H2 server DRAM, eSSD and HBM demand to be supported by AI-infrastructure capex and agentic-AI adoption. As a memory-cycle reading, the segment disclosure shows group profit was overwhelmingly concentrated in DS and fills the attribution gap left by the 2026-07-07 preliminary signal. Evidence limits: Samsung did not disclose specific Memory Business revenue, operating-profit or margin figures; 'all-time high' is the company's characterization, and DS also includes System LSI and Foundry. KRW 89.2T therefore cannot be treated as memory-only profit, and the release does not establish that memory margins rose. H2 demand and supply-constraint language is forward-looking company guidance, not realized performance. This signal does not infer downstream deliveries, customer share or end demand.

title.zh: Amazon 2026 Q2：AWS +37% 至 $42.232B、分部利润率 39.4%，但 TTM FCF 降至 -$7.604B
title.en: Amazon Q2 2026: AWS +37% to $42.232B at 39.4% segment margin, while TTM FCF fell to -$7.604B

detail.zh: 据 Amazon 官方 2026 Q2 财报 / Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1（2026-07-30，季度截至 2026-06-30）：总营收 $200.606B（同比 +20%），AWS 分部营收 $42.232B（+37%，18 个季度最快）、营业利润 $16.621B、利润率 39.4%；AWS AI 业务与芯片业务各自年化收入均超过 $25B。合并营业利润 $27.461B，TTM 经营现金流 $161.403B，但 PP&E 购置额扣除出售与激励后为 $169.007B，使 TTM FCF 降至 -$7.604B。Q2 净利润 $62.647B 含 $53.415B 其他收益（主要为 Anthropic 投资重估），不能直接代表经营盈利。作为 chip-vs-downstream / buildout-orders 读数，AWS 增速、分部利润和总量 PP&E 现金支出同向增强，支持超大规模建设需求未失速；作为 application-monetization 读数，AWS AI 年化收入超过 $25B 且 AWS 分部有 39.4% 利润率，强于只有吞吐量而无利润的证据。证据边界：官方财报稿未披露上调后的 FY2026 capex 总额、内存涨价归因、供应商级订单或份额，因此本条不采用媒体转述的约 $220B，也不映射 memory-cycle / capacity-resale，且不推断 NVDA/AVGO/VRT/GEV 的交付或并网节奏。Amazon 已由 amzn-2026 覆盖；该报告同步更新 Q2 事实、资产负债表、日期锚定估值与双语审计轨迹，维持谨慎看多，不改变任何链级 taxonomy。
detail.en: Per Amazon's official Q2 2026 release / Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (July 30, 2026; quarter ended June 30), total revenue was $200.606B (+20% YoY); AWS segment revenue was $42.232B (+37%, fastest in 18 quarters), operating income was $16.621B, and segment margin was 39.4%. AWS's AI business and chips business each exceeded a $25B annual revenue run rate. Consolidated operating income was $27.461B and TTM operating cash flow was $161.403B, but $169.007B of PP&E purchases net of proceeds and incentives drove TTM FCF to -$7.604B. Q2 net income of $62.647B included $53.415B of other income, primarily an Anthropic investment mark-up, and is not a clean operating-earnings measure. As chip-vs-downstream / buildout-orders evidence, AWS growth, segment profit, and aggregate PP&E cash use strengthened together, supporting that hyperscaler buildout demand has not stalled. As application-monetization evidence, an AWS AI run rate above $25B alongside a 39.4% AWS segment margin is stronger than throughput without profit. Evidence limits: the official release did not disclose a revised FY2026 capex total, memory-price attribution, supplier-level orders, or supplier share. This entry therefore excludes the media-reported roughly $220B figure, does not map the event to memory-cycle or capacity-resale, and does not infer delivery share or interconnection cadence for NVDA/AVGO/VRT/GEV. Amazon is covered by amzn-2026; that report is updated in parallel for Q2 facts, the balance sheet, dated valuation, and bilingual audit trail while retaining the cautiously bullish stance and adding no chain taxonomy.

title.zh: 2026 年 7 月 AI 基础设施链条同步重定价：覆盖集合中 17 份报告较各自价格锚点跌幅超过 25%
title.en: July 2026 chain-wide AI-infrastructure repricing: 17 covered reports fell more than 25% from their own price anchors

detail.zh: 截至 2026-07-29 收盘（最后一个已完成美股交易日），覆盖集合中有 17 份链条报告较其 priceAsOf 锚点跌幅超过 25%，横跨光模块（AAOI −55.3%、Coherent −33.4%、Corning −43.9%）、存储（SK hynix −52.0%、SanDisk −51.4%、Micron −24.2%）、半导体设备（Lam −28.2%、KLA −27.7%、Applied Materials −27.6%）、电力与设施（Bloom −44.5%、Vertiv −27.3%、Oklo −29.6%、NeoVolta −27.6%）、neocloud（Nebius −30.4%、CoreWeave −29.7%）、定制芯片（Marvell −33.4%）与资源（Almonty −32.4%）。已逐一核实：SK hynix、SanDisk、AAOI、Bloom、Corning、Marvell 在该窗口内均无拆股或其他公司行为，日线为连续下跌而非单日跳空；重跑 update_prices.py 后各报告的 baseDate/basePrice 锚点未变，故 drift 为真实价格变动。同期方向相反的是电力/REIT 一侧（Digital Realty +8.6%、Constellation Energy +7.8%）。按 chain-wide-repricing 规则，这被记为贴现率/风险偏好层面的共同因子：本次复核对高跌幅报告重新锚定了价格、市值与倍数算术，但没有因价格变动本身翻转任何立场——各公司的执行问题既未被证伪也未被解决。注意：这与单一公司财报后的股价波动不同，后者按既有惯例不单独记为信号。
detail.en: As of the 2026-07-29 close (the last completed US session), 17 chain reports in coverage were down more than 25% from their own priceAsOf anchors, spanning optical (AAOI -55.3%, Coherent -33.4%, Corning -43.9%), memory (SK hynix -52.0%, SanDisk -51.4%, Micron -24.2%), semicap (Lam -28.2%, KLA -27.7%, Applied Materials -27.6%), power and facilities (Bloom -44.5%, Vertiv -27.3%, Oklo -29.6%, NeoVolta -27.6%), neocloud (Nebius -30.4%, CoreWeave -29.7%), custom silicon (Marvell -33.4%) and resources (Almonty -32.4%). Verified individually: SK hynix, SanDisk, AAOI, Bloom, Corning and Marvell had no splits or other corporate actions in the window, and the daily series are continuous declines rather than single-day discontinuities; re-running update_prices.py left every baseDate/basePrice anchor unchanged, so the drift is a real price move. Power/REIT names moved the other way over the same window (Digital Realty +8.6%, Constellation Energy +7.8%). Under the chain-wide-repricing rule this is logged as a common discount-rate / risk-appetite factor: this review re-anchored price, market-cap and multiple arithmetic on the high-drift reports but did not flip any stance on the price move alone, since the per-company execution questions were neither disconfirmed nor resolved. Note this is distinct from a single name's post-earnings move, which by existing convention is not logged as a signal.

title.zh: Microsoft FY2026 Q4：营收 $90.0B（+18%）、Azure +43%，季度总 capex $41B、现金 PP&E 支出 $35.8B
title.en: Microsoft Q4 FY2026: revenue $90.0B (+18%), Azure +43%, total quarterly capex $41B and cash PP&E spend $35.8B

detail.zh: 据 Microsoft 官方 FY2026 Q4 财报与电话会（2026-07-29，季度截至 2026-06-30）：总营收 $90.007B（同比 +18%、按固定汇率 +17%），Intelligent Cloud $39.306B（+32%、cc +31%），Azure and other cloud services 收入增长 +43%，Microsoft Cloud $59.3B（+27%）；净利润 $35.766B（GAAP +31%）、摊薄 EPS $4.81（+32%）。电话会披露季度总 capex 为 $41B；现金流量表的 additions to property and equipment 为 $35.802B，后者不能替代总 capex 口径。作为 chip-vs-downstream 与 buildout-orders 读数，资本开支与 Azure 增速同向走强，并与同日 Meta（季度 capex $31.078B）及 07-22 已记录的 Alphabet（季度 capex $44.9B、FY 指引上调）共同支持下游建设需求未失速。管理层还明确称 FY2027 capex 将同比增长、FY2027 Q1 capex 将超过 $50B；但未给出 FY2027 全年具体金额。官方电话会同时说明，日历 2026 预计资本开支因数据中心与办公楼宇可用寿命由 15 年延长至 25 年、部分融资租赁改列经营租赁而从此前约 $190B 重分类为约 $175B，底层投资计划不变。证据边界：$41B 总 capex 与 $35.802B 现金 PP&E 均不是在任何具体在覆盖供应商处的已签订单，无法据此推断 NVDA/AVGO/VRT/GEV 各自份额、交付或并网节奏；+43% 为 Azure and other cloud services 增速，公司未单列 Azure 收入金额。Microsoft 未在本中心覆盖范围内，本条不更新任何在覆盖报告的监测读数、估值或立场，也不构成投资建议或价格目标。
detail.en: Per Microsoft's official Q4 fiscal 2026 results and earnings call (July 29, 2026; quarter ended June 30, 2026), total revenue was $90.007B (+18% YoY, +17% constant currency), Intelligent Cloud was $39.306B (+32%, +31% cc), Azure and other cloud services revenue grew +43%, and Microsoft Cloud was $59.3B (+27%); net income was $35.766B (+31% GAAP) and diluted EPS was $4.81 (+32%). The call disclosed total quarterly capex of $41B; cash-flow-statement additions to property and equipment were $35.802B, which is not a substitute for total capex. As a chip-vs-downstream and buildout-orders reading, capex and Azure growth strengthened together and, alongside same-day Meta (quarterly capex $31.078B) and the Alphabet print logged 07-22 (quarterly capex $44.9B, FY guide raised), support that downstream buildout demand has not stalled. Management also said FY2027 capex would grow year over year and FY2027 Q1 capex would exceed $50B, but gave no specific full-year FY2027 amount. The official call further explained that expected calendar-2026 capex was reclassified from about $190B to about $175B because datacenter and office-building useful lives were extended from 15 to 25 years and some finance leases moved to operating leases, with no change to the underlying investment plan. title.zh: Meta Q2 2026：收入 $60.80B（+28%）但营业利润率降至 31%（去年同期 43%）、净利润 -14%；季度 capex $31.078B、FY2026 指引收窄至 $130-145B
title.en: Meta Q2 2026: revenue $60.80B (+28%) but operating margin fell to 31% (from 43% YoY), net income -14%; quarterly capex $31.078B, FY2026 guide narrowed to $130-145B

detail.zh: 据 Meta 官方 Q2 2026 财报（Meta 投资者关系新闻稿，2026-07-29，季度截至 2026-06-30）：收入 $60.801B（同比 +28%），营业利润 $18.775B、营业利润率 31%（去年同期 43%），净利润 $15.848B（同比 -14%），摊薄 EPS $6.18；总成本费用 $42.026B（同比 +55%，含 $2.40B 法律相关支出与 $1.18B 遣散费）。季度经营现金流 $31.862B（同比 +25%），但资本开支 $31.078B（购置物业及设备 $30.116B + 融资租赁本金 $0.962B）使自由现金流降至 $0.784B（同比 -91%）。管理层把 FY2026 capex 指引收窄至 $130-145B（此前 $125-145B，下限上调、上限不变）。Family daily active people 6 月平均约 36.0 亿（+3%）；员工 75,472（-1%）。作为 chip-vs-downstream / buildout-orders 读数，高位 capex 与上调的指引下限支持超大规模建设需求未失速；作为 application-monetization / ad-ai-roi 读数则是混合信号：收入和经营现金流增长，但营业利润率、净利润与自由现金流恶化，后者主要受 capex 接近翻倍压缩，不能概括为“利润/现金流均未改善”。证据边界：capex 指引含融资租赁本金，与季度 $31.078B 可比；利润率下滑含约 $3.58B 法律与遣散项目，未剔除时不宜直接外推；本次未获得管理层关于 Meta Compute 与 2027 capex 框架的官方电话会细节，capacity-resale-pivot 未更新。本条更新 meta-2026 的 capex-intensity 与 ad-ai-roi、reportedPeriod 和 lastUpdate，但不刷新其 2026-07-06（$600.29）估值快照、股价、年度 EPS、倍数、stance 或 conviction；估值框架前移需单独的当前价格完整复核。
detail.en: Per Meta's official Q2 2026 results (Meta Investor Relations, July 29, 2026; quarter ended June 30, 2026), revenue was $60.801B (+28% YoY), operating income $18.775B at a 31% operating margin (down from 43%), net income $15.848B (-14%), and diluted EPS $6.18; total costs and expenses were $42.026B (+55%, including $2.40B of legal-related charges and $1.18B of severance). Quarterly operating cash flow was $31.862B (+25%), but $31.078B of capex (PP&E purchases $30.116B plus $0.962B finance-lease principal) compressed free cash flow to $0.784B (-91%). Management narrowed FY2026 capex guidance to $130-145B (from $125-145B, low end raised). Family daily active people averaged about 3.60B in June (+3%); headcount was 75,472 (-1%). As a chip-vs-downstream / buildout-orders reading, elevated capex and the higher guide floor support that hyperscaler buildout demand has not stalled. As an application-monetization / ad-ai-roi reading, however, the evidence is mixed: revenue and operating cash flow grew, while operating margin, net income, and free cash flow deteriorated, with FCF primarily compressed by near-doubled capex; it should not be summarized as both profit and cash flow failing to improve. Evidence limits: capex guidance includes finance-lease principal and is comparable to the $31.078B quarterly figure; the margin decline includes about $3.58B of legal and severance items and should not be extrapolated without adjustment; official call detail on Meta Compute and the 2027 capex frame was not obtained, so capacity-resale-pivot was not updated. This entry updates meta-2026's capex-intensity and ad-ai-roi readings, reportedPeriod, and lastUpdate but does not refresh its July 6, 2026 ($600.29) valuation snapshot, share price, annual EPS, multiple, stance, or conviction; moving the valuation frame forward requires a separate current-price full review.

detail.en: Per Lam Research's official Q4 fiscal 2026 results (July 29, 2026; quarter ended June 28, 2026), revenue was $6.722B (+15% sequentially, +30% YoY), with GAAP gross margin 51.7%, operating margin 37.4%, diluted EPS $1.81, and net income $2.277B; non-GAAP gross margin was 52.0%, operating margin 38.4%, and diluted EPS $1.82. Evidence limits: $8.10B is guidance, deferred revenue is not the full order book, and the company did not disaggregate equipment revenue by HBM/DRAM/NAND/logic, so no customer share, delivery, or interconnection cadence can be inferred. title.en: SK hynix Q2 2026: revenue ₩79.32T (+257% YoY), 76% operating margin and record quarterly operating profit, multi-year LTAs with ~10 customers, HBM4 mass shipments begun

detail.zh: 据 SK hynix 官方 Q2 2026 业绩公告（SK hynix newsroom，2026-07-29，季度截至 2026-06-30，公司披露口径）：营收 ₩79.32 万亿（同比 +257%，上年同期 Q2 2025 为 ₩22.232 万亿；Q1 2026 为 ₩52.5763 万亿）、营业利润 ₩60.54 万亿（营业利润率 76%，同比 +557%）、净利润 ₩93.92 万亿（公司称净利率 118%），创季度历史新高；上半年累计营收首次突破 ₩100 万亿。DRAM 与 NAND 价格环比均显著上行；公司于 Q2 开始 HBM4 量产出货、H2 加速，HBM4E 已于上半年完成样品；已与约 10 家客户（含关键战略伙伴）签订多年期长期供货协议（LTA），并称客户需求超过供给能力。期末现金约 ₩88 万亿、净现金约 ₩69.4 万亿。作为 memory-cycle 读数：营业利润率进一步升至 76%（周期峰值区），既是极端定价权/HBM 组合的确认，也把『峰值利润率均值回归』风险抬到更前台；但本季同时伴随需求侧结构性证据（约 10 家客户多年期 LTA、DRAM/NAND 价格环比上行、公司称需求超供给），因此该规则关注的『高margin 但缺乏终端需求确认』条件本季并未单纯满足——供需两侧同时走强，均值回归的时点更取决于 2026H2-2027 的 HBM4 扩产与 ASP。证据边界：以上为公司披露的自报口径；新闻稿未拆分从营业利润 ₩60.54 万亿到净利润 ₩93.92 万亿之间的桥接项（即净利润高于营收的构成未披露），也未披露 LTA 的具体数量、期限与定价；未提供是否达到/低于市场一致预期的口径。本条更新 sk-hynix-2026 的 margin-mean-reversion、hbm4-competition 与 nvidia-lockin 监测读数、reportedPeriod 与 lastUpdate，但按 fail-closed 原则不刷新其 2026-06-25（₩2,917,000）估值快照、股价、盈利估计、估值倍数、stance 或 conviction；鉴于营业利润率进一步升至 76%，sk-hynix-2026 需要一次单独的、估值敏感的完整更新；财报后单纯的股价变动不构成可记录信号。
detail.en: Per SK hynix's official Q2 2026 results (SK hynix newsroom, July 29, 2026; quarter ended June 30, 2026, per company disclosure): revenue was ₩79.32T (+257% YoY vs ₩22.232T in Q2 2025; Q1 2026 was ₩52.5763T), operating profit ₩60.54T (76% operating margin, +557% YoY), and net profit ₩93.92T (company-stated 118% net margin), an all-time quarterly high, with first-half revenue crossing ₩100T for the first time. DRAM and NAND prices both rose significantly QoQ; the company began HBM4 mass shipments in Q2 (ramping in H2), HBM4E completed sample shipments in H1, and it finalized multi-year long-term agreements (LTAs) with about 10 customers (including key strategic partners), stating customer demand exceeds supply capability. Period-end cash was ~₩88T and net cash ~₩69.4T. As a memory-cycle reading: operating margin rising further to 76% (cycle-peak zone) both confirms extreme pricing power / HBM mix and moves 'peak-margin mean reversion' risk more to the fore; but this quarter also carried structural demand-side evidence (multi-year LTAs with ~10 customers, QoQ DRAM/NAND price increases, company statement that demand exceeds supply), so the rule's 'high margin without end-demand confirmation' condition was not straightforwardly met — both supply and demand strengthened, making the timing of mean reversion more dependent on the H2 2026-2027 HBM4 ramp and ASPs. Evidence limits: the above are company self-reported figures; the release did not itemize what bridges the ₩60.54T operating profit to the ₩93.92T net profit (the composition by which net profit exceeds revenue is undisclosed), nor did it disclose LTA volumes, durations, or pricing, or whether results met/missed consensus. Evidence limits: Corning did not disclose a dollar figure for Gen AI product sales (only that they grew “significantly faster”); total Optical Communications YoY growth decelerated from +36% in Q1 to +32% in Q2 even as Enterprise Networks ran +65%, so the mix matters as much as the headline; and the previously announced (May 2026) NVIDIA-linked 10x U.S. optical-connectivity capacity and three-plant plan is a prior capacity commitment reiterated here, not a new order.
