title.zh: KLA FY2026 Q4：营收 $3.658B、Process Control $3.257B，9 月季度指引约 $4.0B
title.en: KLA Q4 FY2026: revenue $3.658B, Process Control $3.257B, September-quarter guide about $4.0B

detail.zh: 据 KLA 官方 FY2026 Q4 财报与拆股公告（KLA 投资者关系，2026-07-28；季度截至 2026-06-30）：总营收 $3,658M（高于指引中值，较 Q3 的 $3,416M 环比约 +7%）。Semiconductor Process Control 收入 $3,257M（Q3 为 $3,084M）、Specialty Semiconductor Process $160M（Q3 $164.0M）、PCB and Component Inspection $241M（Q3 $167.6M）。GAAP 净利润 $1,363M、non-GAAP 净利润 $1,386M。KLA 的 1 拆 10 于 2026-06-11 生效；Q4 财报已追溯调整所有股数与每股数据，GAAP / non-GAAP 摊薄 EPS 为 $1.04 / $1.05，Q3 比较数为 $0.91 / $0.94；4 月原始 Q3 财报的 $9.12 / $9.40 为拆股前口径，并非冲突。季度经营现金流 $906.4M、自由现金流 $817.1M，后者较上年同期 $1.065B 下降约 23%；全年 FY2026 FCF $3.767B，较 FY2025 的 $3.747B 增长约 0.5%；季度分红 $305.3M、回购 $571.0M。管理层给出 9 月季度（FY2027 Q1）指引：营收 $4.0B ± $200M、non-GAAP 摊薄 EPS $1.16 ± $0.10、non-GAAP 毛利率 62.5%。CEO 称需求处于“AI 基础设施扩张的关键路径”，点名 leading-edge foundry/logic、memory 与 advanced packaging。作为 semicap-eda-capex-commitment 与 chip-vs-downstream 读数，process-control 收入随下游 AI capex 同步上行而非背离，$4.0B 前瞻指引延续这一走势。证据边界：财报未给出 Q4 同比营收增速百分比，本条环比对比由上一季数字推导；process-control 需求可能领先或滞后 WFE 支出，一次季度指引不能独立证实 CY2026 WFE 全年强度；分部与营收为公司自定义口径；季度 FCF 同比下降，而全年 FCF 仅小幅增长。本条更新 kla-2026 的 process-control-revenue、ai-growth-vectors、segment-breadth、fcf-capital-return 与 cy2026-outlook 监测读数、reportedPeriod（FY2026 Q3 → FY2026 Q4）与 lastUpdate，但不刷新其 2026-07-02 估值快照（约 22.6x EV/annualized revenue、约 1.3% LTM FCF yield）、stance 或 conviction；财报后单纯的股价变动不构成可记录信号。
detail.en: Per KLA's official Q4 fiscal 2026 results and stock-split announcement (KLA Investor Relations, July 28, 2026; quarter ended June 30, 2026): total revenue was $3,658M (above the guidance midpoint; about +7% sequentially versus Q3's $3,416M). Semiconductor Process Control revenue was $3,257M (Q3 was $3,084M), Specialty Semiconductor Process was $160M (Q3 $164.0M), and PCB and Component Inspection was $241M (Q3 $167.6M). GAAP net income was $1,363M and non-GAAP net income was $1,386M. KLA's ten-for-one split became effective June 11, 2026; the Q4 release retroactively adjusted all share and per-share values, reporting GAAP / non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.04 / $1.05 and Q3 comparatives of $0.91 / $0.94, while the original April Q3 release's $9.12 / $9.40 was pre-split rather than conflicting. Quarterly operating cash flow was $906.4M and free cash flow was $817.1M, with FCF down about 23% from $1.065B a year earlier; full-year FY2026 FCF was $3.767B, about 0.5% above FY2025's $3.747B; the company paid $305.3M of dividends and repurchased $571.0M of stock in the quarter. Management guided the September quarter (fiscal Q1 2027) to revenue of $4.0B +/- $200M, non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.16 +/- $0.10, and non-GAAP gross margin of 62.5%. The CEO framed demand as on “the critical path of AI infrastructure expansion,” citing leading-edge foundry/logic, memory, and advanced packaging. As a semicap-eda-capex-commitment and chip-vs-downstream reading, process-control revenue kept rising alongside downstream AI capex rather than diverging, and the $4.0B forward guide extends that. Evidence limits: the release did not state Q4 YoY revenue growth percentages, so the sequential comparisons here are derived from prior-quarter figures; process-control demand can lead or lag wafer-fab-equipment spending, and one quarterly guide does not by itself confirm sustained CY2026 WFE; segment and revenue figures are company-defined; and quarterly FCF declined YoY while full-year FCF grew only slightly. This entry updates kla-2026's process-control-revenue, ai-growth-vectors, segment-breadth, fcf-capital-return, and cy2026-outlook monitoring readings, reportedPeriod (FY2026 Q3 -> FY2026 Q4), and lastUpdate, but does not refresh its July 2, 2026 valuation snapshot (about 22.6x EV/annualized revenue and about 1.3% LTM FCF yield), stance, or conviction; any post-earnings share-price move alone is not a loggable signal.

title.zh: Cadence Q2 2026：backlog 创纪录 $8.1B、next-12-month RPO $4.2B，上修 FY2026 指引
title.en: Cadence Q2 2026: record $8.1B backlog and $4.2B next-12-month RPO, FY2026 guidance raised

detail.zh: 据 Cadence 官方 Q2 2026 财报（SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.01/99.02，2026-07-27）：Q2 revenue $1,584.5M（同比 +24.2%，Q2 2025 为 $1,275.4M）、GAAP 营业利润率 28.4%、non-GAAP 营业利润率 45.5%、GAAP 摊薄 EPS $1.33、non-GAAP 摊薄 EPS $2.11。季度末 backlog 为公司口径 record $8.1B（环比 Q1 $8.0B 约持平），未来 12 个月预计从 remaining performance obligations 确认收入 $4.2B（Q1 为 $4.0B）。公司披露 Core EDA / Semiconductor IP / System Design & Analysis 收入分别同比 +18% / 超过 +40% / +37%；IP 增长归因于 Star IP、与 Intel 的重要协议及其他领先半导体客户 wins，SDA 增长归因于 PCB、advanced packaging 与 Hexagon D&E 整合。管理层上修 FY2026 指引：revenue 增速展望约 +19% YoY（区间 $6.26-6.34B）、non-GAAP EPS 中值 $8.10（区间 $8.05-8.15）、operating cash flow 约 $2B；Q3 2026 收入指引 $1.595-1.625B。作为 semicap-eda-capex-commitment 的确认性读数，EDA/IP backlog 与 RPO 在下游 capex 上修的同时没有背离，但这只降低、不能消除“预算尚未转成可设计完成供给”的风险。证据边界：backlog 环比约持平，官方未量化 agentic workflow 收入，也未把本季 IP 增长拆分到 HBM、PCIe 或 SerDes；backlog 与 RPO 为公司自定义口径。本条更新 cadence-2026 的 monitoring、reportedPeriod 与已过期 trigger wording，但不刷新其基于当时 Q1 指引的 2026-07-02 估值快照、stance 或 conviction；同层 synopsys-2026 的财政季历与披露节奏不同，本读数不据此更新 SNPS。
detail.en: Per Cadence's official Q2 2026 results (SEC 8-K Exhibits 99.01/99.02, 2026-07-27): Q2 revenue was $1,584.5M (+24.2% YoY vs $1,275.4M in Q2 2025), GAAP operating margin 28.4%, non-GAAP operating margin 45.5%, GAAP diluted EPS $1.33, and non-GAAP diluted EPS $2.11. Quarter-end backlog was a company-stated record $8.1B (roughly flat vs Q1's $8.0B), and revenue expected within 12 months from remaining performance obligations was $4.2B (Q1 was $4.0B). The company reported Core EDA / Semiconductor IP / System Design & Analysis revenue growth of 18% / more than 40% / 37% YoY; it attributed IP growth to Star IP, a significant Intel agreement, and other leading-semiconductor wins, and SDA growth to PCB, advanced packaging, and Hexagon D&E integration. Management raised FY2026 guidance to about 19% YoY revenue growth ($6.26-6.34B), non-GAAP EPS of $8.10 at the midpoint ($8.05-8.15), and about $2B operating cash flow; Q3 2026 revenue guidance is $1.595-1.625B. As a confirmatory semicap-eda-capex-commitment reading, EDA/IP backlog and RPO did not diverge from rising downstream capex, reducing but not eliminating the risk that budgets have yet to become design-complete supply. Evidence limits: total backlog was roughly flat QoQ, the company did not quantify agentic-workflow revenue or split this quarter's IP growth among HBM, PCIe, or SerDes, and backlog/RPO are company-defined measures. This entry updates cadence-2026's monitoring, reportedPeriod, and stale trigger wording but does not refresh its 2026-07-02 valuation snapshot based on the then-current Q1 guide, stance, or conviction; same-layer synopsys-2026 has a different fiscal calendar and disclosure cadence and is not updated on this reading.

title.zh: SK 集团与 NVIDIA 将 AI 基建及内存合作框定为 $500B+ 并签署 LOI；SK Telecom 规划最高 2 GW AI Cloud
title.en: SK Group and NVIDIA frame AI-infrastructure and memory collaboration at $500B+ and sign LOIs; SK Telecom plans up to 2 GW AI Cloud

detail.zh: 据 NVIDIA 2026-07-24 官方发布与 SK Telecom 2026-07-25 官方发布：SK 集团与 NVIDIA 宣布规划一项以「$500-billion-plus（5000 亿美元以上）」表述的综合合作，并签署意向书（LOI），范围从 AI 工厂建设延伸至 AI 内存供应。SK Telecom 规划在韩国建设最高 2 GW 的 AI Cloud，采用 NVIDIA DSX 平台及由 SK hynix HBM4 支持的 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 加速计算，首座 AI 工厂计划于 2027 年上线；NVIDIA 与 SK hynix 的长期 AI 内存合作则以稳定下一代内存供应，并共同研发和优化包括 HBM 在内的下一代方案为目标。作为 memory-cycle 与 chip-vs-downstream 读数，这是一项意向阶段的下游设施与内存需求规划信号，而不是已兑现的订单或交付确认。证据边界：两份官方材料把 $500B+ 称为 initiative/合作框架，未给出可逐项核对的资本开支预算；材料披露的是 LOI，未披露已执行的采购合同、具约束力的支出时间表、订单数量/价格、HBM4 分配或收入确认时点；最高 2 GW 是规划容量，尚未部署；首座工厂仅计划于 2027 年上线。该韩国项目不能外推至美国电网/PJM/ERCOT 标的，也不能据此推断 Micron、SanDisk 或其他未被点名供应商的份额。本条仅记录链条事实，不更新 nvidia-2026 或 sk-hynix-2026 的报告监测读数、估值、立场或确信度。
detail.en: Per NVIDIA's official July 24, 2026 release and SK Telecom's official July 25, 2026 release, SK Group and NVIDIA announced plans for a comprehensive collaboration framed as a "$500-billion-plus" initiative and signed letters of intent spanning AI-factory construction through AI-memory supply. SK Telecom plans an AI Cloud of up to 2 GW in Korea using the NVIDIA DSX platform and NVIDIA Vera Rubin accelerated computing powered by SK hynix HBM4, with the first AI factory planned to come online in 2027. NVIDIA and SK hynix's long-term AI-memory partnership aims to secure stable next-generation memory supply and to codevelop and optimize next-generation solutions including HBM. As a memory-cycle and chip-vs-downstream reading, this is an intent-stage downstream-facility and memory-demand planning signal, not confirmation of booked orders or delivered capacity. Evidence limits: the official materials describe $500B+ as an initiative/collaboration framework without an itemized capex budget; they disclose LOIs but no executed purchase contracts, binding spend schedule, order quantities or pricing, HBM4 allocation, or revenue-recognition timing; up to 2 GW is planned capacity, not deployed capacity; and the first factory is only planned for 2027. The Korea-based project does not read through to U.S. grid/PJM/ERCOT names and cannot establish share for Micron, SanDisk, or other suppliers not named in the releases. This chain-level factual log does not update the monitoring readings, valuation, stance, or conviction of nvidia-2026 or sk-hynix-2026.

title.zh: Digital Realty Q2 2026：backlog 创纪录 $1.9B、开租滞后收窄至 9 个月，上修 Core FFO 指引
title.en: Digital Realty Q2 2026: record $1.9B backlog, commencement lag down to nine months, Core FFO guidance raised

detail.zh: 据 Digital Realty 官方 Q2 2026 财报（SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.1/99.2，2026-07-23）：Core FFO/share（ex net promote）$2.13（Q1 为 $2.04、2Q25 为 $1.87）、cash 口径 renewal 租金涨幅 +25.4%。季度签下 bookings $307M 年化 GAAP base rent（100% share）/ $208M（DLR share），其中 0-1MW + interconnection 贡献 $108M、占 DLR-share bookings 的 52%；季度末 signed-but-not-commenced backlog 为公司口径 record $1.9B（100% share）/ $1.4B（DLR share），但 DLR-share backlog 含约 $380M 来自收购三座北弗吉尼亚数据中心 64% 权益的增量，不能把 record 全部解释为本季有机签约。新签租约加权平均开租滞后从 19 个月收窄至 9 个月；管理层把 2026 Core FFO/share（ex net promote）指引从 $8.00-8.10 上修至 $8.15-8.20、Constant-Currency 口径上修至 $8.10-8.15。Q2 presentation 还把 in-place / future-development IT capacity 更新为约 3GW / 9GW（合计约 12GW）。作为 facility-interconnection-leasing 读数，创纪录的 0-1MW/interconnection bookings 与 renewal spread 支持网络密集型需求并非只有 hyperscale shell；record backlog 本身因收购增量不能单独承担这一结论。证据边界：季度 bookings 环比从 Q1 的 $707M/$423M 明显回落（Q1 为异常大季度），单季 bookings 波动大；backlog 兑现和 9GW future development 仍取决于电力、许可与资本；bookings/backlog 为公司自定义年化 GAAP base rent 口径。本条更新 digital-realty-2026 的 monitoring、reportedPeriod 与已过期 trigger wording，但不刷新其基于当时 Q1 指引的 2026-07-02 估值快照、stance 或 conviction。
detail.en: Per Digital Realty's official Q2 2026 results (SEC 8-K Exhibits 99.1/99.2, 2026-07-23): Core FFO/share (excluding net promote) was $2.13 (Q1 was $2.04; 2Q25 was $1.87) and cash renewal rate increases were +25.4%. The company signed $307M of annualized GAAP base-rent bookings at 100% share / $208M at DLR share, including $108M from 0-1MW plus interconnection, or 52% of DLR-share bookings. Quarter-end signed-but-not-commenced backlog was a company-stated record $1.9B at 100% share / $1.4B at DLR share, but DLR-share backlog included about $380M added by the acquisition of a 64% interest in three Northern Virginia data centers, so the record cannot be read entirely as organic quarterly leasing. The weighted-average commencement lag on new leases narrowed from 19 months to nine months. Management raised 2026 Core FFO/share (excluding net promote) guidance from $8.00-8.10 to $8.15-8.20 and the Constant-Currency measure to $8.10-8.15. The Q2 presentation also updated in-place / future-development IT capacity to about 3GW / 9GW, or about 12GW total. As a facility-interconnection-leasing reading, record 0-1MW/interconnection bookings and renewal spreads support network-dense demand beyond hyperscale shell; the record backlog itself cannot carry that conclusion because of the acquisition increment. Evidence limits: quarterly bookings stepped down materially from Q1's $707M/$423M (Q1 was unusually large), single-quarter bookings are lumpy, backlog commencement and 9GW of future development still depend on power, permitting, and capital, and bookings/backlog are company-defined annualized GAAP base-rent measures. This entry updates digital-realty-2026's monitoring, reportedPeriod, and stale trigger wording but does not refresh its 2026-07-02 valuation snapshot based on the then-current Q1 guide, stance, or conviction.

title.zh: GE Vernova Q2 2026：订单 $24.2B、backlog $176B，燃气 backlog+预留合计 116 GW，FCF 指引上调 $5B
title.en: GE Vernova Q2 2026: orders $24.2B, backlog $176B, gas backlog + reservations total 116 GW, FCF guide raised $5B

detail.zh: 据 GE Vernova 2026-07-22 官方 Q2 2026 业绩发布与 Form 10-Q：Q2 订单 $24.2B（有机 +88%，由 Power 与 Electrification 拉动），收入 $11.1B（+22%、有机 +12%），总 RPO backlog 环比 +$13.0B 至 $176B。燃气设备合计数由 100 GW 增至 116 GW，其中 53 GW 为设备 backlog、63 GW 为 slot reservation agreements；Q2 新签 18 GW slot 预留与 2 GW 订单，将 10 GW 既有预留转为订单并交付 3 GW，年底合计目标由≥110 GW上调至≥125 GW。Electrification 数据中心订单上半年累计超过 $5B，超过 2025 全年总额的两倍。调整后 EBITDA $1.2B、利润率 11.3%（有机 +340bps）；FY2026 收入/FCF 指引升至 $45.5-46.5B/$11.5-12.5B，利润率指引维持 12-14%。Wind Q2 EBITDA 亏损 $275M（上年同期 $165M、Q1 $382M），全年约 $400M 亏损指引维持不变。作为 buildout-orders 与 grid-epc-delivery 读数，订单/backlog 增强确认电力需求已穿透到设备侧，但不验证并网、施工或最终交付。证据边界：63 GW 预留尚未计入设备 backlog，转化率不能由单一时点推导；>$5B 为上半年累计而非单季；Q2 11.3% 仍低于全年指引区间；上半年 FCF 显著受益于营运资金和客户预付款，而全年 FCF 仍是前瞻指引。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标；gevernova-2026 的价格锚点与估值仍为 2026-06-26 快照，本次未重估。
detail.en: Per GE Vernova's official Q2 2026 release and Form 10-Q dated 2026-07-22: Q2 orders were $24.2B (+88% organic, led by Power and Electrification), revenue was $11.1B (+22%, +12% organic), and total RPO backlog rose $13.0B sequentially to $176B. The combined gas-equipment total grew from 100 GW to 116 GW, comprising 53 GW of equipment backlog and 63 GW of slot reservation agreements. In Q2 the company signed 18 GW of new reservations and 2 GW of orders, converted 10 GW of prior reservations to orders, shipped 3 GW, and raised the combined year-end target from >=110 GW to >=125 GW. Electrification data-center orders exceeded $5B YTD, more than twice the full-year 2025 total. Adjusted EBITDA was $1.2B at an 11.3% margin (+340 bps organic); FY2026 revenue/FCF guidance rose to $45.5-46.5B/$11.5-12.5B while the margin guide stayed at 12-14%. Wind Q2 EBITDA loss was $275M (vs $165M a year ago and $382M in Q1), with the approximately $400M full-year loss guide maintained. As a buildout-orders and grid-epc-delivery reading, stronger orders/backlog confirm that power demand is reaching equipment, but do not validate interconnection, construction, or final delivery. Evidence limits: the 63 GW of reservations is not yet equipment backlog and a point-in-time snapshot cannot establish conversion; >$5B is a first-half cumulative figure, not one quarter; Q2's 11.3% margin remains below the full-year guide range; and first-half FCF benefited materially from working capital and customer down payments while full-year FCF remains forward guidance. This is factual monitoring, not investment advice, a rating, or a price target; gevernova-2026's valuation remains the dated 2026-06-26 snapshot and was not re-marked.

title.zh: 韩国关税厅 7 月 1–20 日通关速报：半导体出口 221 亿美元，创 7 月同期历史新高
title.en: Korea Customs 1–20 July provisional data: semiconductor exports $22.1B, a record for the July 1–20 period

detail.zh: 据韩国关税厅（Korea Customs Service）2026-07-21 发布的《2026년 7월 1일 ~ 7월 20일 수출입 현황 [잠정치]》：7 月 1–20 日出口 549.33 亿美元、同比 +52.3%（上年同期 360.58 亿美元），进口 427.15 亿美元、同比 +20.0%，贸易顺差 122 亿美元；其中半导体出口 221 亿美元，为 7 月 1–20 日口径历史最高。该发布同时列示：工作日数由 2025 年的 15.5 日降至 2026 年的 14.5 日，日均出口额由 23.3 亿美元升至 37.9 亿美元、同比 +62.9%；年初至 7 月 20 日累计出口 5,512.81 亿美元、同比 +48.7%。作为高频、国家级读数，这一数据用于交叉验证 memory-cycle：韩国是 HBM/DRAM/NAND 的主要出口地，出口金额可与厂商侧的毛利与定价叙事对照。证据边界：该数据为通关基准“잠정치”（暂定值），后续可能修订；口径为出口“金额”而非出货量或 bit 数，无法据此区分价格与数量贡献；为覆盖全部韩国半导体出口商的国家级合计，未拆分 HBM、传统 DRAM 与 NAND，也未披露客户或终端应用结构；因 2026 年工作日数少于上年，标题 +52.3% 低估了日均口径的实际增速（+62.9%）；数据仅反映自韩国报关出口的金额，不等同于终端客户的实际消化或 sell-through。另需说明：关税厅网页正文未能取到该发布的品目明细表，故本条仅采用可在原始发布中直接核对的数字。
detail.en: Per the Korea Customs Service (관세청) provisional release "2026년 7월 1일 ~ 7월 20일 수출입 현황 [잠정치]", published 2026-07-21: exports for 1–20 July were $54.933B, +52.3% YoY (versus $36.058B in the same period a year earlier); imports were $42.715B, +20.0%; and the trade surplus was $12.2B. Semiconductor exports were $22.1B, a record high for the 1–20 July basis. The same release states that working days fell from 15.5 in 2025 to 14.5 in 2026, that average daily exports rose from $2.33B to $3.79B (+62.9%), and that year-to-date exports through 20 July were $551.281B, +48.7%. As a high-frequency, country-level reading this cross-checks memory-cycle: Korea is a primary export origin for HBM, DRAM and NAND, so export value can be read against producer-side margin and pricing narratives. Evidence limits: the data are customs-clearance-basis provisional figures (잠정치) and may be revised; the measure is export value, not volume or bit shipments, so price and quantity contributions cannot be separated; it is a national aggregate across all Korean semiconductor exporters with no HBM / conventional DRAM / NAND split and no customer or end-application breakdown; because 2026 had fewer working days, the headline +52.3% understates the daily-average pace (+62.9%); and the figures record value shipped out of Korea, which is not the same as end-customer consumption or sell-through. Note also that the item-level product table in this release was not retrievable from the Korea Customs Service web page body, so this entry uses only figures directly verifiable in the primary release.

title.zh: Nebius 签订首笔约 $7.75 亿高级担保融资，为 neocloud 资产级融资提供首个实证
title.en: Nebius enters first ~$775M senior secured facility, providing first evidence of neocloud asset-level funding

detail.zh: 据 Nebius Group 2026-07-17 公司公告，公司签订首笔约 US$775M 高级担保债务融资，以已部署 GPU 基础设施及一家未具名投资级客户合同现金流作支持，2030-10-31 到期、定价 SOFR + 2.50%；公司称交易获显著超额认购，且该 facility 与客户合同现金流合计覆盖标的 GPU 部署资本开支的 100% 以上。这是资产级融资已落地的一个数据点，需与本层融资风险锚 CoreWeave 对照。证据边界：客户未具名，不能将本笔 facility 直接归因于微软或 Meta；Nebius 另称该结构可用于其他长期部署，并以微软、Meta 等客户超过 $400 亿的新增合同收入作为潜在基础，但可复制性与未来类似条款仍是公司预期。约 $7.75 亿仅相当于 $200-250 亿 2026 capex 区间的约 3.1%-3.9%，且公告未披露提款状态、费用、契约或摊还结构。
detail.en: Per Nebius Group's 2026-07-17 company release, Nebius entered its first senior secured debt facility for approximately US$775M, backed by deployed GPU infrastructure and contracted cash flows from an unnamed investment-grade customer, due 2030-10-31 and priced at SOFR + 2.50%. The company says the transaction was significantly oversubscribed and that the facility, together with the customer agreement's cash flows, covers more than 100% of the capex for the underlying GPU deployment. This is one observed datapoint that asset-level financing has been arranged and should be read against CoreWeave as the layer's financing risk anchor. Evidence limits: the customer is unnamed, so the present facility cannot be attributed directly to Microsoft or Meta. Nebius separately says the structure can support other long-term deployments and points to more than $40B of additional contracted revenue from customers such as Microsoft and Meta, but repeatability and similarly attractive future terms remain company expectations. Approximately $775M is only about 3.1%-3.9% of the $20-25B 2026 capex range, and the release does not disclose drawdown status, fees, covenants, or amortization.

title.zh: TSMC Q2 2026 毛利率 67.7% 高于指引，并把 2026 capex 上调至 $60-64B
title.en: TSMC posts 67.7% Q2 gross margin above guidance and raises 2026 capex to $60-64B

detail.zh: TSMC 2026-07-16 官方 Q2 2026 财报与业绩会材料显示：Q2 收入 NT$1,270.38B（同比 +36.0%）、US$40.20B（同比 +33.7%），落在 US$39.0-40.2B 指引区间上沿；毛利率 67.7%（高于 65.5-67.5% 指引）、营业利润率 60.3%、净利润 NT$706.56B（同比 +77.4%）、EPS NT$27.25。晶圆收入中 2nm 首次贡献 3%、3nm 30%、5nm 33%、7nm 11%，7nm 及以下合计 77%（Q1 为 74%）；HPC 收入环比 +20%、占 Q2 收入 66%。管理层把全年收入增速展望上调至略高于 40%，并把 2026 capex 从原 $52-56B 区间上调至 $60-64B；Q3 指引收入 US$44.6-45.8B、毛利率 65-67%、营业利润率 56-58%（按 32 NT$/US$）。该读数确认 foundry 层需求与资本预算同步上行，为 semicap 设备链提供客户侧读数；但官方 Q2 新闻稿、演示稿和管理报告没有量化 CoWoS 排产，因此不能单独证明先进封装瓶颈已经缓解。
detail.en: TSMC's official Q2 2026 results and earnings-conference materials dated 2026-07-16 report revenue of NT$1,270.38B (+36.0% YoY), or US$40.20B (+33.7% YoY), at the top of the US$39.0-40.2B guidance range, with 67.7% gross margin above the 65.5-67.5% guide, 60.3% operating margin, NT$706.56B net income (+77.4% YoY), and NT$27.25 EPS. Within wafer revenue, 2nm contributed 3% for the first time, 3nm 30%, 5nm 33%, and 7nm 11%, putting 7nm-and-below at 77% (74% in Q1); HPC revenue rose 20% QoQ to 66% of Q2 revenue. Management lifted full-year revenue growth to slightly above 40% and raised 2026 capex from the prior $52-56B range to $60-64B, while guiding Q3 to US$44.6-45.8B revenue, 65-67% gross margin, and 56-58% operating margin at NT$32/US$. The reading confirms that foundry-layer demand and capital budgets are rising together, providing a customer-side reading for the semicap equipment chain; but the official Q2 release, presentation, and management report do not quantify CoWoS scheduling, so the reading alone does not prove that the advanced-packaging bottleneck has eased.

title.zh: ASML Q2 2026 二次上调全年指引并计划扩充 EUV/DUV 产能，加强设备侧 capex 确认
title.en: ASML raises FY2026 guidance again and plans more EUV/DUV capacity, strengthening equipment-side capex confirmation

detail.zh: ASML 2026-07-15 Q2 2026 官方业绩显示：Q2 net sales EUR 9.326B、net income EUR 2.918B、gross margin 54.0%，installed-base management sales EUR 2.762B（Q1 为 EUR 2.488B），销售 86 套新光刻系统和 5 套二手系统。Q3 指引为 net sales EUR 11.0-12.0B、gross margin 55-57%；FY2026 指引年内第二次上调至 net sales EUR 43-45B、gross margin 54-56%。管理层称上半年订单流强劲，并计划把 2027 年 low-NA EUV 产能较 2026 年约 65 套增加 30%、DUV immersion 产能较约 130 套增加 30%，同时研究 2028 年再各增加 30%。本次发布未披露季度 net bookings 或 backlog，因此该读数加强 semicap-eda-capex-commitment 的设备侧确认，但不能单独证明客户特定 capex 已全部承诺、backlog 没有取消或延期，或整条 AI 供给已可制造。
detail.en: ASML's official Q2 2026 results dated 2026-07-15 report EUR 9.326B net sales, EUR 2.918B net income, 54.0% gross margin, EUR 2.762B of Installed Base Management sales (EUR 2.488B in Q1), and 86 new plus five used lithography systems sold. Q3 guidance is EUR 11.0-12.0B net sales at 55-57% gross margin; FY2026 guidance was raised for the second time this year to EUR 43-45B net sales at 54-56% gross margin. Management said H1 order intake was strong and plans to add 30% to 2027 low-NA EUV capacity versus about 65 systems in 2026 and 30% to DUV immersion capacity versus about 130, while investigating another 30% for each in 2028. The release disclosed neither quarterly net bookings nor backlog, so the reading strengthens the equipment-side confirmation for semicap-eda-capex-commitment but does not by itself prove that customer-specific capex is fully committed, that backlog has no cancellations or delays, or that the entire AI supply buildout is manufacturable.

title.zh: MiniMax 高增长验证应用需求，但单位经济与融资仍未闭环
title.en: MiniMax validates application demand, but unit economics and funding remain open

detail.zh: MiniMax FY2025 收入 US$79.0M、同比 +158.9%，毛利率由 12.2% 升至 25.4%，但调整后净亏损 US$250.9M、经营现金流流出 US$279.6M。公司于 2026-07-14 完成 35.6M 股配售，净募资约 HK$9.491B。该信号确认基础模型在消费产品和 API 层有真实付费需求，同时表明 token 与收入增长尚未形成自我融资；若毛利率、付费转化和现金消耗不能同步改善，上游 AI 基建需求仍可能由补贴与外部资本放大。
detail.en: MiniMax FY2025 revenue was US$79.0M, up 158.9%, and gross margin improved from 12.2% to 25.4%, but adjusted net loss was US$250.9M and operating cash outflow was US$279.6M. The company completed a 35.6M-share placement on 2026-07-14 for about HK$9.491B of net proceeds. This confirms real paid foundation-model demand across consumer products and APIs, while showing that token and revenue growth are not yet self-funding. If gross margin, paid conversion, and cash burn do not improve together, upstream AI-infrastructure demand may still be amplified by subsidies and external capital.

title.zh: TSMC 6 月收入 NT$442.68B，Q2 按官方指引汇率折算落在区间内
title.en: TSMC posts NT$442.68B June revenue, with Q2 landing within guidance at the official planning FX rate

detail.zh: TSMC 2026-07-13 提交的 SEC 6-K 显示，6 月收入 NT$442.68B（同比 +67.9%），Jan-Jun 合计 NT$2,404.48B（同比 +35.6%）；据月度收入相加，Q2 约 NT$1.270T，按公司 Q1 财报给出的 31.7 NT$/US$ 规划汇率折算约 US$40.1B，落在 US$39.0-40.2B 指引区间内，并非超指引。该读数确认 foundry 收入仍处强劲轨迹，但不能单独证明先进节点利用率、CoWoS 排产或客户结构；这些项目及毛利率需等待 2026-07-16 的完整 Q2 财报。
detail.en: TSMC's SEC 6-K filed on 2026-07-13 reports June revenue of NT$442.68B (+67.9% YoY) and Jan-Jun revenue of NT$2,404.48B (+35.6%). Summing the monthly figures gives roughly NT$1.270T for Q2, or about US$40.1B at the NT$31.7/US$ planning rate in the company's Q1 release—within the US$39.0-40.2B guidance range, not above it. The reading confirms a strong foundry revenue trajectory, but by itself does not establish advanced-node utilization, CoWoS bookings, or customer mix; those items and margins await the full Q2 release on 2026-07-16.

title.zh: Micron 扩大美国供应链承诺，SK hynix 以 ADS 融资支持韩国 fab 与 EUV
title.en: Micron expands U.S. supply-chain commitments as SK hynix funds Korean fabs and EUV through an ADS offering

detail.zh: Micron 2026-07-09 官方公告最多投入 $3B 强化美国半导体供应链，其中拟向 GlobalWafers 提供 $500M 融资并签订 10 年 300mm 原始硅片供应协议；融资与协议仍以最终文件、监管批准等条件为前提。Micron 同期在纽约 fab 浇筑首块混凝土，并重申到 2035 年在美国投入超过 $250B 的计划。SK hynix 2026-07-10 最终 SEC 424B4 则确认以每 ADS $149 发行 177.9M 份 ADS、预计净募资约 $26.2B，拟在 2027 年 12 月前用于韩国生产设施及 EUV 扫描仪。两项资本动作强化 memory 供给响应证据，但尚不等于新增 bit supply 已经上线。
detail.en: Micron's official 2026-07-09 release announced up to $3B to strengthen the U.S. semiconductor supply chain, including proposed $500M financing for GlobalWafers and a 10-year 300mm raw-wafer supply agreement; the financing and agreement remain subject to definitive documents, regulatory approvals, and other conditions. Micron separately poured first concrete at its New York fab and reiterated plans to invest more than $250B in the United States through 2035. SK hynix's final SEC 424B4 dated 2026-07-10 confirms 177.9M ADSs at $149 each and estimated net proceeds of about $26.2B, intended for Korean production facilities and EUV scanners through December 2027. The two capital actions strengthen evidence of a memory supply response, but do not mean incremental bit supply is already online.

title.zh: 三星 Q2 初步营业利润约 ₩89.4T，分部归因待正式财报
title.en: Samsung guides to about KRW 89.4T of preliminary Q2 operating profit, with segment attribution still pending

detail.zh: 三星电子 2026-07-07 官方初步业绩指引给出 Q2 合并销售额约 ₩171T、营业利润约 ₩89.4T。该公告只提供合并预估，尚无 memory、foundry、mobile 等分部拆分，因此在 2026-07-30 正式业绩发布前，不把利润跳升直接归因于 AI memory/HBM。它作为 memory-cycle 的预警读数：若正式分部数据确认 memory 价格与利润率同步走高，将加强周期高景气信号；若利润来自其他分部，则需下调其对 memory 论点的权重。
detail.en: Samsung Electronics' official preliminary earnings guidance on 2026-07-07 puts consolidated Q2 sales at about KRW 171T and operating profit at about KRW 89.4T. The release provides only consolidated estimates, with no split for memory, foundry, mobile, or other segments, so the profit increase is not attributed directly to AI memory or HBM before the full results on 2026-07-30. It is an early memory-cycle reading: confirmation that memory pricing and margins rose together would strengthen the high-cycle signal, while profit concentrated elsewhere would reduce its weight in the memory thesis.

title.zh: ASML/AMAT/LRCX/KLAC/SNPS/CDNS 补齐 AI capex 的设备与 EDA 确认层
title.en: ASML/AMAT/LRCX/KLAC/SNPS/CDNS complete the equipment and EDA confirmation layer for AI capex

detail.zh: P2 新增六个上游确认点：ASML Q4 2025 net bookings EUR 13.158B（EUV EUR 7.4B）和 backlog EUR 38.797B；AMAT Q2 FY2026 revenue $7.91B 且 Q3 指引 $8.95B；LRCX March quarter revenue $5.841B 且 June guide $6.60B；KLAC Q3 Semiconductor Process Control revenue $3.084B；SNPS FY2026 revenue 指引 $9.625-9.705B（含 Ansys）；CDNS backlog $8.0B、next-12-month RPO revenue $4.0B。这个信号用来验证 AI 资本开支是否从芯片/云/数据中心叙事进入工具订单、良率控制、EDA/IP 与设计复杂度；若这些读数降温，上游 capex 可能只是预算或公告，而非已承诺可制造供给。
detail.en: P2 adds six upstream confirmation points: ASML Q4 2025 net bookings of EUR 13.158B (EUR 7.4B EUV) and EUR 38.797B backlog; AMAT Q2 FY2026 revenue of $7.91B and Q3 guidance of $8.95B; LRCX March-quarter revenue of $5.841B and June-quarter guide of $6.60B; KLAC Q3 Semiconductor Process Control revenue of $3.084B; SNPS FY2026 revenue guidance of $9.625-9.705B including Ansys; and CDNS backlog of $8.0B with $4.0B next-12-month RPO revenue. This signal tests whether AI capex has moved from chip/cloud/data-center narrative into tool orders, yield control, EDA/IP, and design complexity; if these readings cool, upstream capex may be budgeted or announced rather than committed manufacturable supply.

title.zh: Meta 筹建云业务，外售过剩 AI 算力
title.en: Meta building a cloud business to sell excess AI compute

detail.zh: 彭博 7 月 1 日报道 Meta 正筹建云业务、对外出售过剩 AI 算力，META 当日涨逾 6%；同日 AI 基建链大面积下跌：MU 跌逾 10%，SNDK/INTC/AMD 跌 6.9%–10.6%，CRWV 跌约 14%，NBIS 跌约 17%；7 月 2 日 SK 海力士领跌韩股。市场首次对「算力供给持续紧张」假设定价出裂缝。
detail.en: Bloomberg reported on Jul 1 that Meta is building a cloud business to sell excess AI compute; META rose 6%+ while the AI-infra chain sold off broadly: MU down 10%+, SNDK/INTC/AMD down 6.9%-10.6%, CRWV down ~14%, NBIS down ~17%; SK hynix led Korean declines on Jul 2. First market-wide crack priced into the compute-scarcity assumption.

title.zh: TSMC Jan-May 收入 +30%，先进制程与封装继续定义 AI 供给上限
title.en: TSMC Jan-May revenue +30% as advanced nodes and packaging define AI supply

detail.zh: TSMC 官方月度收入显示 Jan-May 2026 合计 NT$1.962T（+30.0%），May 收入 NT$416.975B（+30.1%）。结合 2026Q1 $35.90B 收入、66.2% 毛利率、HPC/先进节点高占比和 $52-56B capex，foundry 层仍是 AI accelerator 供给的核心公共约束。该信号用于交叉校验 NVDA/AVGO/AMD/MRVL 设计端收入与 CoWoS/N3/N2 产能是否一致。
detail.en: TSMC's official monthly revenue shows Jan-May 2026 revenue of NT$1.962T (+30.0%) and May revenue of NT$416.975B (+30.1%). Together with 2026Q1 revenue of $35.90B, 66.2% gross margin, high HPC / advanced-node mix, and $52-56B capex, the foundry layer remains the common constraint for AI accelerator supply. This signal cross-checks whether NVDA / AVGO / AMD / MRVL design-side revenue aligns with CoWoS / N3 / N2 capacity.

title.zh: Micron Q3 收入 $41.46B，HBM/DRAM/NAND 共同验证 memory 瓶颈
title.en: Micron Q3 revenue $41.46B as HBM, DRAM, and NAND validate the memory bottleneck

detail.zh: Micron FY2026 Q3 收入 $41.46B、毛利率约 84.6%，Q4 指引收入 $49-51B；公开报道显示 HBM 产能售罄至 2026，16 个 SCA 中 14 个最低合同收入约 $100B，6 月 DRAM/NAND 价格仍上涨。该信号用于检验 AI 需求是否真正穿透到 memory bit/带宽/价格，同时监控周期顶点和估值压缩风险。
detail.en: Micron FY2026 Q3 revenue was $41.46B with about 84.6% gross margin, and Q4 guidance is $49-51B. Public reports indicate HBM capacity is sold out through 2026, 14 of 16 SCAs carry about $100B of minimum contract revenue, and June DRAM / NAND prices were still rising. This signal tests whether AI demand is truly reaching memory bits, bandwidth, and pricing while monitoring cycle-peak and valuation-compression risk.

title.zh: PJM 提前数据中心容量采购，CEG/VST/NRG 电力约束进入市场机制
title.en: PJM accelerates data-center capacity procurement as CEG/VST/NRG move the power constraint into market mechanisms

detail.zh: PJM 将数据中心容量采购提前至 2026-09，CEG/VST/NRG 等电力股随之反应；同时 CEG 通过 Microsoft/Crane restart、Meta 约 1.1GW 核电 PPA 和 Calpine 可调度容量验证长期电力合同化，VST 通过 Meta 核电协议与 Cogentrix 约 5,500MW 燃气容量（约 $4B net purchase price，seller-side 公开报道约 $4.7B total consideration）验证可调度容量价值，NRG 则通过 LS Power 后约 25GW 平台、CPower C&I VPP 和 retail/Vivint 组合验证 AI 负荷是否传导到 merchant/retail power。这个信号测试 AI 电力需求能否从叙事转换为容量价格、PPA/large-load contracts 和现有发电资产重定价。
detail.en: PJM moved data-center capacity procurement up to Sep 2026 and power equities such as CEG/VST/NRG reacted. CEG tests long-term power contracting through Microsoft/Crane restart, Meta's about 1.1GW nuclear PPA, and Calpine dispatchable capacity; VST tests dispatchable-capacity value through Meta nuclear PPAs and the roughly 5,500MW Cogentrix gas-capacity acquisition (about $4B net purchase price, with public seller-side reporting near $4.7B total consideration); and NRG tests whether AI load reaches merchant/retail power through its post-LS-Power about 25GW platform, CPower C&I VPP and retail/Vivint mix. The signal tests whether AI power demand converts from narrative into capacity prices, PPAs / large-load contracts and repricing of existing generation assets.

title.zh: Oracle RPO 升至 $638B，AI capex 与融资压力同步上升
title.en: Oracle RPO rises to $638B as AI capex and financing pressure rise

detail.zh: Oracle FY2026 Q4 RPO 达 $638B（约 +363%，环比 +$85B），OCI 收入 $5.8B（约 +93%），强化 AI 云需求读数；但 FY2026 capex $55.66B、FCF -$23.69B，FY2027 capex 指引 $90-95B，且公司计划约 $40B 债务+股权融资。该信号用于校验 backlog 是否能转化为高回报现金流，而不是简单把大订单当作无风险需求。
detail.en: Oracle FY2026 Q4 RPO reached $638B (about +363%, +$85B sequentially), and OCI revenue was $5.8B (about +93%), strengthening the AI-cloud demand readout. But FY2026 capex was $55.66B, FCF was -$23.69B, FY2027 capex is guided at $90-95B, and the company expects roughly $40B of debt and equity financing. This signal tests whether backlog converts into high-return cash flow rather than treating large orders as risk-free demand.

title.zh: Marvell 上修 FY2027/FY2028 展望，custom ASIC 与光互连进入架构校验位
title.en: Marvell raises FY2027/FY2028 outlook as custom ASIC and optical interconnect enter the architecture check

detail.zh: 公开报道显示 Marvell 将 FY2027/FY2028 收入展望上修至约 $11.5B/$16.5B，数据中心收入约 $1.83B，且 NVIDIA $2B 投资与 NVLink Fusion 合作、Celestial AI 光互连收购共同强化其 AI custom silicon/optical 路线。该信号用于交叉校验 Broadcom 自定义 XPU 叙事是否扩散到更多供应商，以及 optical interconnect 是否成为 AI 集群新瓶颈。
detail.en: Public reports indicate Marvell raised FY2027 / FY2028 revenue outlook to about $11.5B / $16.5B, with data-center revenue around $1.83B. NVIDIA's $2B investment plus NVLink Fusion and the Celestial AI optical-interconnect acquisition strengthen its AI custom silicon / optical path. This signal cross-checks whether Broadcom's custom XPU narrative is spreading to more suppliers and whether optical interconnect is becoming a new AI-cluster bottleneck.

title.zh: NVIDIA 投资 Coherent，AI 光连接从模块叙事进入产能锁定
title.en: NVIDIA invests in Coherent as AI optical connectivity moves from module narrative to capacity lock-up

detail.zh: NVIDIA 宣布向 Coherent 投资 $2B，并包含多年、数十亿美元采购承诺和未来先进激光/光网络产能访问权；Coherent Q3 FY2026 Datacenter & Communications 收入约 $1.362B，占 pro forma 收入约 75%。这个信号把 AAOI/GLW 的 optical 需求、ANET 的开放以太网架构和 NVDA 的下一代 AI factory 光互连路线连接起来：如果收入、产能和 FCF 同步兑现，光连接是实约束；如果只有估值先行，则需警惕 AI optics 过度定价。
detail.en: NVIDIA announced a $2B investment in Coherent with a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar purchase commitment and future access to advanced laser/optical-networking capacity. Coherent's Q3 FY2026 Datacenter & Communications revenue was about $1.362B, roughly 75% of pro forma revenue. This signal links AAOI/GLW optical demand, ANET's open-Ethernet architecture check and NVDA's next-generation AI-factory optical-interconnect roadmap: if revenue, capacity and FCF validate together, optics is a real constraint; if valuation moves first, AI optics may be overpricing the cycle.

title.zh: DLR/EQIX 租约、backlog 与互联指标验证 AI 数据中心落地需求
title.en: DLR/EQIX leasing, backlog and interconnection metrics validate AI data-center deployment demand

detail.zh: DLR Q1 2026 签下 $707M 年化 GAAP base rent bookings（100% share）和 $1.8B signed-but-not-commenced backlog，0-1MW + interconnection bookings 达 $98M、同比 +42%，并披露约 9GW 总 IT capacity；EQIX Q1 2026 则披露 revenue $2.444B、interconnection revenue $446M、AFFO/share $10.79、MRR +12% reported、annualized gross bookings $378M，且 largest deals 约 60% AI-related。这个信号用于交叉验证：芯片/neocloud 的需求是否真的落到租约、互联、零售托管、xScale 和开发容量；如果 backlog commence、power/capex 或 MRR/cabinet yield 变弱，则上游订单可能领先真实部署太多。
detail.en: DLR signed $707M of annualized GAAP base-rent bookings at 100% share and ended Q1 2026 with $1.8B of signed-but-not-commenced backlog. 0-1MW plus interconnection bookings reached $98M, +42% YoY, and total IT capacity was about 9GW. EQIX Q1 2026 added a second facility readout: revenue $2.444B, interconnection revenue $446M, AFFO/share $10.79, MRR +12% reported, annualized gross bookings $378M, and about 60% of largest deals AI-related. This signal cross-checks whether chip/neocloud demand is landing in leases, interconnection, retail colocation, xScale and development capacity; if backlog commencement, power/capex or MRR/cabinet yield weakens, upstream orders may be running too far ahead of physical deployment.

title.zh: Alphabet Q2 2026：季度资本开支 $44.9B（同比约翻倍），FY2026 capex 指引上调至 $195-205B，Google Cloud +82% 至 $24.8B
title.en: Alphabet Q2 2026: quarterly capex $44.9B (about doubled YoY), FY2026 capex guide raised to $195-205B, Google Cloud +82% to $24.8B

detail.zh: 据 Alphabet 2026-07-22 官方 Q2 2026 业绩发布（SEC 8-K 附件 99.1，报告期为截至 2026-06-30 的季度）与同日财报电话会：季度总收入 $119.8B（同比 +24%、按固定汇率 +23%），其中 Google Services $94.5B（+15%）、Google Cloud 分部收入 $24.8B（+82%，管理层称主要由 GCP 驱动，核心 GCP、企业级 AI 解决方案与 AI 基础设施均为重要驱动）；Google Cloud 经营利润 $8.8B、经营利润率 35.6%（去年同期 20.7%），合并经营利润 $40.8B、经营利润率 34%（同比 +2 个百分点、+30%）。现金流量表口径的季度资本开支（购置物业及设备）由去年同期 $22.4B 升至 $44.9B（约 +100%），上半年累计 $80.6B（去年同期 $39.6B）；同期经营现金流 $39.1B，扣除资本开支后的自由现金流为 -$5.9B。在电话会上，CFO Anat Ashkenazi 将 FY2026 资本开支指引由此前的 $180-190B 上调至 $195-205B，并称上调主要由于加快交付产能以满足增长中的需求；本季技术基础设施投资约 60% 用于服务器、40% 用于数据中心与网络设备。作为 chip-vs-downstream 与 application-monetization 读数，这是超大规模厂商资本开支与云货币化同时走强的确认信号：需求侧（算力采购、服务器占比）在加速，Cloud +82% 与分部经营利润率扩张同向，但集团自由现金流已经转负。证据边界：$44.9B 为 PP&E 现金支出，并非在任何具体在覆盖供应商处的已签订单，无法据此推断 NVDA/AVGO/VRT/GEV 各自的份额、交付或并网节奏；$195-205B 为前瞻指引而非已实现数；本季稀释每股收益 $9.11、归母净利润 $112.1B 受约 $98.0B 权益证券未实现收益（其他收益）显著抬高，不代表经营盈利能力；+82% 是 Google Cloud 分部收入增速，本次披露未单列 GCP 子业务的收入或利润率；公司在 6 月通过普通股与强制可转换优先股募得净额约 $49.6B，所得用于一般公司用途（包括扩张 AI 基础设施与全球算力）；另签订最高 $40B 的 ATM 股票分销协议，但截至 6 月 30 日尚未据此售股，且该 ATM 所得主要拟用于员工股权授予相关税款。本条为事实性监测，不含投资建议、评级或价格目标；Alphabet 未在覆盖范围内，本条不更新任何在覆盖报告的监测读数、估值或立场。
detail.en: Per Alphabet's official Q2 2026 results dated 2026-07-22 (SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.1, quarter ended 2026-06-30) and the same-day earnings call: quarterly total revenues were $119.8B (+24% YoY, +23% constant currency), with Google Services $94.5B (+15%) and Google Cloud segment revenue $24.8B (+82%, driven primarily by GCP, with core GCP, enterprise AI solutions, and AI infrastructure all important drivers). Google Cloud operating income was $8.8B at a 35.6% operating margin (20.7% a year ago), while consolidated operating income was $40.8B at a 34% margin (+2 percentage points YoY, +30%). Cash-flow-statement quarterly capital expenditures (purchases of property and equipment) rose from $22.4B a year ago to $44.9B (about +100%), with first-half capex of $80.6B (vs $39.6B a year ago); quarterly operating cash flow was $39.1B and free cash flow after capex was -$5.9B. On the call, CFO Anat Ashkenazi raised FY2026 capex guidance to $195-205B from $180-190B, saying the increase was primarily due to accelerated delivery of capacity to meet growing demand; approximately 60% of the quarter's technical-infrastructure investment was in servers and 40% in data centers and networking equipment. As a chip-vs-downstream and application-monetization reading, this confirms hyperscaler capex and cloud monetization strengthening together: the demand side (compute purchasing, server mix) is accelerating, and Cloud's +82% growth came with segment operating-margin expansion, although consolidated free cash flow turned negative. Evidence limits: the $44.9B is PP&E cash spend, not a booked order at any specific covered supplier, so it cannot establish the share, delivery, or interconnection cadence captured by NVDA/AVGO/VRT/GEV; the $195-205B is forward guidance, not actuals; the quarter's $9.11 diluted EPS and $112.1B net income are materially inflated by about $98.0B of unrealized gains on equity securities in other income and do not represent operating profitability; the +82% is Google Cloud segment revenue growth, while the disclosure does not separately provide GCP sub-business revenue or margin; in June the company raised about $49.6B of net proceeds through common and mandatory convertible preferred stock for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures to scale AI infrastructure and global compute. Separately, it entered an at-the-market equity distribution agreement for up to $40B, but had sold no shares under it as of June 30 and primarily intends those proceeds for tax obligations associated with employee equity grants. This is factual monitoring, not investment advice, a rating, or a price target; Alphabet is not in coverage, and this entry does not update any covered report's monitoring reading, valuation, or stance.

title.zh: Palantir Q2 2026：收入 +93% 至 $1.94B、美国商业 +149%，GAAP 营业利润率 47%、调整后 FCF 利润率 63%，FY2026 指引上调至 +82%
title.en: Palantir Q2 2026: revenue +93% to $1.94B with US commercial +149%, a 47% GAAP operating margin and 63% adjusted FCF margin, FY2026 guidance raised to +82%

detail.zh: 据 Palantir 2026-08-03 盘后发布的 2026 Q2 业绩（季度截至 2026-06-30）：季度收入 $1,935.464M（同比 +93%、环比 +19%），其中美国收入 $1,573M（+115%，占总收入 81%）、美国商业 $764M（+149%、环比 +28%）、美国政府 $809M（+90%、环比 +18%）；GAAP 营业利润 $912.004M、GAAP 营业利润率 47%（2025 Q2 为 26.8%），调整后营业利润 $1,194.472M、利润率 62%（一年前 46%）；GAAP 净利润 $1,061.890M、GAAP 稀释每股收益 $0.41；经营现金流 $1,216.167M、调整后自由现金流 $1,220.359M（利润率 63%）；现金及短期国债 $9.2B，总债务约 $212M；季度 TCV 签约 $3,373M（+49%），其中美国商业 TCV $2,132M（+153%，公司称创纪录），美国商业剩余合同价值 $6,238M（同比 +124%、环比 +27%）；≥$1M 成交 220 笔、≥$5M 98 笔、≥$10M 73 笔；美国商业客户数同比 +35%；Rule of 40 为 155%。公司同时上调 FY2026 指引：收入 $8,150–8,158M（+82%）、美国商业收入 ≥$3,424M（+134%）、调整后营业利润 $4,889–4,897M、调整后自由现金流 $4,500–4,700M。作为 application-monetization 读数，这是该规则要求的确认信号中最强的一次：收入高速增长的同时，利润率与经营现金流同向改善，而不是靠补贴或循环融资撑起的用量增长——收入 +93%、GAAP 营业利润率扩张约 20 个百分点、经营现金流利润率 63%，三者同时成立；订单侧（美国商业 TCV +153%）还快于收入侧（+149%），说明确认并非仅来自已确认收入的时点效应。证据边界：Palantir FY2026 收入指引约 $8.15B，仅约相当于超大规模厂商年度资本开支的 1.5%，因此本条确认的是应用层单位经济成立，不能据此认定应用层收入总量已足以支撑上游基础设施开支；美国政府收入占比 42%，其需求由联邦拨款驱动而非按 AI 投资回报审批，与 AI capex 周期不同源；国际收入约 $362M（约占 19%、同比约 +33%）为总收入减披露美国收入的推算值，非公司披露；调整后自由现金流 $1,220.359M 高于经营现金流 $1,216.167M，系非 GAAP 定义中的加回项所致，且两者均未扣除当季 $265.209M 的股权激励费用（占收入 13.7%）；追溯有效税率约 1.3%，美英递延所得税资产仍计提全额估值备抵，GAAP 盈利在税率常态化前不可直接与已纳税同业比较。本条为事实性监测，不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per Palantir's Q2 2026 results released after the close on 2026-08-03 (quarter ended 2026-06-30): quarterly revenue was $1,935.464M (+93% YoY, +19% QoQ), comprising US revenue of $1,573M (+115%, 81% of total), US commercial revenue of $764M (+149%, +28% QoQ), and US government revenue of $809M (+90%, +18% QoQ). GAAP income from operations was $912.004M at a 47% GAAP operating margin (26.8% in Q2 2025), and adjusted income from operations was $1,194.472M at a 62% margin (46% a year ago). GAAP net income was $1,061.890M with GAAP diluted EPS of $0.41; cash from operations was $1,216.167M and adjusted free cash flow $1,220.359M (63% margin). Cash and short-term treasuries stood at $9.2B against roughly $212M of total debt. Quarterly TCV booked was $3,373M (+49%), including US commercial TCV of $2,132M (+153%, described by the company as a record), and US commercial remaining deal value reached $6,238M (+124% YoY, +27% QoQ). The company closed 220 deals of at least $1M, 98 of at least $5M, and 73 of at least $10M, with US commercial customer count up 35% YoY and a Rule of 40 score of 155%. FY2026 guidance was raised to revenue of $8,150-8,158M (+82%), US commercial revenue of at least $3,424M (+134%), adjusted income from operations of $4,889-4,897M, and adjusted free cash flow of $4,500-4,700M. As an application-monetization reading, this is the strongest confirmation that rule has recorded: revenue growth, margin, and operating cash flow improved together rather than usage growth being carried by subsidy or circular financing - revenue +93%, GAAP operating margin expanding about 20 points, and a 63% operating-cash-flow margin all hold simultaneously, and the bookings side (US commercial TCV +153%) is running ahead of the revenue side (+149%), so the confirmation is not merely a recognition-timing effect. Evidence limits: Palantir's FY2026 revenue guide of about $8.15B is only roughly 1.5% of annual hyperscaler capex, so this entry confirms that application-layer unit economics work and cannot establish that application-layer revenue is yet large enough to underwrite upstream infrastructure spending. US government revenue is 42% of the total and is appropriations-driven rather than budgeted against AI ROI, so it does not share the AI-capex cycle. International revenue of about $362M (roughly 19% of total, about +33% YoY) is derived as total less disclosed US revenue and is not a company disclosure. Adjusted free cash flow of $1,220.359M exceeds operating cash flow of $1,216.167M because of add-backs in the non-GAAP definition, and neither figure charges the quarter's $265.209M of stock-based compensation (13.7% of revenue). The trailing effective tax rate is about 1.3% with a full valuation allowance still carried against US and UK deferred tax assets, so GAAP earnings are not directly comparable with fully taxed peers until the rate normalizes. This is factual monitoring, not investment advice, a rating, or a price target.

title.en: AMD Q2 2026: revenue $11.5B (+50%) with Data Center $6.7B (+107%, about 58% of revenue), non-GAAP EPS $1.66, and Q3 guided to about $13B (±$300M)

detail.zh: 据 AMD 投资者关系 2026-08-04 发布的 2026 Q2 业绩（季度截至 2026-06-27）：季度收入 $11.5B（同比 +50%，GAAP），其中数据中心分部 $6.7B（同比 +107%），约占总收入 58%；GAAP 毛利率 54%、非 GAAP 56%；GAAP 稀释每股收益 $1.38、非 GAAP $1.66。公司对 Q3 2026 指引收入约 $13B（±$300M，即约 $12.7–13.3B）、非 GAAP 毛利率约 56%。新闻稿称 Helios 正被 Anthropic、Cirrascale、HUMAIN、Meta、Microsoft、OpenAI、Oracle、Tensorwave、Vultr 等部署，与 Anthropic 的合作提及最多 2GW 的 MI450。作为 chip-vs-downstream 读数，本次只获得局部交叉确认：同日 Arista 网络收入 +37.7%、Astera Labs 互连初步收入 +104%，但没有新的光模块或机房订单读数，不能据此上修整条链的长期需求假设。证据边界：+50%/+107% 是美元金额增速，不是出货量；发行人材料没有支持把增速归因于 HBM 成本转嫁。Helios/MI450 客户名单是已宣布的部署计划，不是出货或订单确认；新闻稿未披露分客户出货量或 backlog。本条为事实性监测，不含估值、股价反应或投资建议。
detail.en: Per AMD Investor Relations' Q2 2026 results released 2026-08-04 (quarter ended 2026-06-27), quarterly revenue was $11.5B (+50% YoY, GAAP), with Data Center at $6.7B (+107%), about 58% of total revenue; GAAP gross margin was 54% and non-GAAP 56%; GAAP diluted EPS was $1.38 and non-GAAP $1.66. Q3 revenue was guided to about $13B (±$300M, roughly $12.7-13.3B) with non-GAAP gross margin of about 56%. The release said Helios is being deployed by Anthropic, Cirrascale, HUMAIN, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Oracle, Tensorwave, Vultr and others, and referenced up to 2GW of MI450 with Anthropic. As a chip-vs-downstream reading, this is only partial cross-confirmation: same-day Arista networking revenue rose 37.7% and Astera Labs preliminary interconnect revenue rose 104%, but there is no refreshed optical-module or facility-order reading, so the whole chain's long-term demand assumptions cannot be raised from this event. Evidence limits: +50%/+107% are dollar-value growth, not unit shipments; issuer materials do not support attributing growth to HBM-cost pass-through. The Helios/MI450 customer list is announced deployment plans, not shipment or booking confirmation, and the release provides neither customer shipment volumes nor backlog. This is factual monitoring without valuation, price reaction, or investment advice.

title.zh: Arista Q2 2026：收入 $3.036B（+37.7%）、首次单季破 $30 亿，非 GAAP 营业利润率 49.9%、每股收益 $1.02，Q3 指引约 $3.3B
title.en: Arista Q2 2026: revenue $3.036B (+37.7%), its first quarter above $3B, non-GAAP operating margin 49.9% and EPS $1.02, with Q3 guided to about $3.3B

detail.zh: 据 Arista Networks 2026-08-04 发布的 2026 Q2 业绩（季度截至 2026-06-30）：收入 $3.036B（同比 +37.7%），为公司首个单季突破 $30 亿；GAAP 毛利率 62.9%、非 GAAP 63.4%；GAAP 营业利润率 45.4%、非 GAAP 49.9%；GAAP 稀释每股收益 $0.95、非 GAAP $1.02。对 Q3 2026 指引收入约 $3.3B、非 GAAP 营业利润率 48–49%、非 GAAP 每股收益 $1.06–1.08。CEO Jayshree Ullal 称网络是『从客户端到园区、再到数据与 AI 中心的基础设施中枢神经』。作为 custom-silicon-ethernet 读数：该规则称，若 Broadcom 定制芯片与 Arista 的开放以太网生态同步走强，则需对 NVIDIA 一体化栈的增长与利润率假设做更严的架构压力测试——本次 Arista 一侧得到确认（收入、利润率与指引同向走强），而 Broadcom 一侧本周期尚未复核（AVGO 于 9 月披露）。同时作为 chip-vs-downstream 的网络确认腿：与同日 AMD 数据中心 +107% 的加速相互印证，说明芯片侧加速有下游网络订单同步。证据边界：本次发布（就所核对的摘要）未给出更新的两大匿名客户集中度（此前约合计 42%）数据，客户集中度须以 10-Q 单独跟踪；指引为管理层指引而非在手积压订单；本条确认的是开放以太网收入与利润率的强势，而非其相对 NVIDIA Spectrum-X/InfiniBand/NVLink 的独立 AI 后端份额（份额需要发布中未含的数据）；不含估值倍数与股价反应，为事实性监测，不含投资建议。
detail.en: Per Arista Networks' Q2 2026 results released 2026-08-04 (quarter ended 2026-06-30): revenue was $3.036B (+37.7% YoY), the company's first quarter above $3B; GAAP gross margin was 62.9% and non-GAAP 63.4%; GAAP operating margin was 45.4% and non-GAAP 49.9%; GAAP diluted EPS was $0.95 and non-GAAP $1.02. The company guided Q3 2026 to revenue of about $3.3B, non-GAAP operating margin of 48-49%, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.06-1.08. CEO Jayshree Ullal described networking as 'the central nervous system for infrastructure from the client to campus to data and AI centers.' As a custom-silicon-ethernet reading: the rule says that if Broadcom custom silicon and Arista's open-Ethernet ecosystem strengthen together, NVIDIA's integrated-stack growth and margin assumptions need a stricter architecture stress test - here the Arista leg is confirmed (revenue, margin and guidance strengthening together), while the Broadcom leg has not been re-read this cycle (AVGO reports in September). It also serves as the networking-confirmation leg for chip-vs-downstream, corroborating the same-day AMD Data Center acceleration (+107%) with matching downstream networking demand. Evidence limits: this release (in the excerpt reviewed) did not restate the updated two-anonymous-customer concentration (previously about 42% combined), which must be tracked separately via the 10-Q; the guidance is management guidance rather than booked backlog; the reading confirms open-Ethernet revenue and margin strength but not its standalone AI-back-end share versus NVIDIA Spectrum-X/InfiniBand/NVLink (share requires data not in the release); it excludes valuation multiples and price reaction, and is factual monitoring, not investment advice.

title.zh: Astera Labs Q2 2026 初步业绩：收入 $392.4M（同比 +104%、环比 +27%），非 GAAP 每股收益 $0.80，Q3 指引 $540–560M；Scorpio fabric 交换机预计提前一季成为最大产品线
title.en: Astera Labs preliminary Q2 2026 results: revenue $392.4M (+104% YoY, +27% QoQ), non-GAAP EPS $0.80, Q3 guided to $540-560M, with Scorpio fabric switches expected to become the largest product family a quarter early

detail.zh: 据 Astera Labs 2026-08-04 披露的 2026 Q2 初步业绩（季度截至 2026-06-30）：收入 $392.4M（同比 +104%、环比 +27%），高于此前 $355–365M 指引；GAAP 毛利率 73.3%、非 GAAP 73.7%；GAAP 稀释每股收益 $0.83、非 GAAP $0.80；Q3 收入指引 $540–560M。公司预计 Scorpio fabric 交换机在 Q3 成为最大产品线，较此前预期提前一季；Aries 创公司自身单季收入纪录。作为 interconnect-fanout-constraint 读数，这确认互连侧收入与同日 AMD、Arista 同向增长，但没有新的光互连读数，不能据此宣称 GPU、网络、互连与光连接全链同步。证据边界：本次数字明确标为 preliminary；Scorpio 产品结构是 Q3 前瞻，不是 Q2 既成事实；发布未重述客户集中度或认股权证冲减收入金额；增速基数约为单季 $392M。本条为事实性监测，不含估值、股价反应或投资建议。
detail.en: Per Astera Labs' preliminary Q2 2026 results disclosed 2026-08-04 (quarter ended 2026-06-30), revenue was $392.4M (+104% YoY, +27% QoQ), above the prior $355-365M guide; GAAP gross margin was 73.3% and non-GAAP 73.7%; GAAP diluted EPS was $0.83 and non-GAAP $0.80; Q3 revenue was guided to $540-560M. The company expects Scorpio fabric switches to become the largest product family in Q3, one quarter early, while Aries set a company quarterly revenue record. As an interconnect-fanout-constraint reading, this confirms interconnect revenue grew alongside same-day AMD and Arista readings, but there is no refreshed optical-connectivity reading, so it does not establish synchronization across the full GPU, networking, interconnect, and optical chain. Evidence limits: the figures are explicitly preliminary; Scorpio mix is a Q3 forward statement, not a Q2 fact; the release did not restate customer concentration or warrant contra-revenue; and growth is off a roughly $392M quarterly base. This is factual monitoring without valuation, price reaction, or investment advice.

title.zh: NRG Q2 2026：调整后 EBITDA $1,217M（同比 +34%），并披露与未具名超大规模厂商就 1.2GW 得州燃气项目达成主要商业条款（尚待最终文件）
title.en: NRG Q2 2026: adjusted EBITDA $1,217M (+34% YoY), and disclosure that principal commercial terms are aligned with an unnamed hyperscaler for a 1.2 GW Texas gas project (subject to final documentation)

detail.zh: 据 NRG Energy 2026-08-04 发布的 2026 Q2 业绩：季度调整后 EBITDA $1,217M（较 2025 Q2 的 $909M 增加 $308M，约 +34%）、GAAP 净利润 $506M、调整后每股收益 $1.49、收入 $7,481M、增长前自由现金流 $1,025M；公司重申 2026 全年指引（调整后 EBITDA $5,325–5,825M、调整后每股收益 $7.90–9.90、增长前自由现金流 $2,800–3,300M）。公司计划 2026 年通过回购返还 $1.0B，截至 2026-07-31 已完成 $932M；这不是『至少 $1B 年度回购』的长期承诺。NRG 同时披露，各方就在得州开发 1.2GW 联合循环天然气发电设施达成主要商业条款，对手方仅描述为全球领先的云与 AI 超大规模厂商，且仍需最终文件与批准。作为 merchant-power-capacity 读数，这是燃气容量项目的前瞻性局部证据；作为 grid-epc-delivery 读数，它尚未形成施工、交付或并网确认。证据边界：这不是已签订/有约束力的合同、收入或已承诺资本开支；对手方未具名；官方新闻稿未披露投资额、投产时间、EBITDA/FCF 贡献或扩展性，二手转述的数字不采信；nrg-2026 要求具名成交的触发条件仍未满足。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per NRG Energy's Q2 2026 results released 2026-08-04, quarterly adjusted EBITDA was $1,217M (up $308M, about 34%, from $909M), GAAP net income $506M, adjusted EPS $1.49, revenue $7,481M, and free cash flow before growth $1,025M; 2026 guidance was reaffirmed at adjusted EBITDA of $5,325-5,825M, adjusted EPS of $7.90-9.90, and free cash flow before growth of $2,800-3,300M. The company plans to return $1.0B through repurchases in 2026 and had completed $932M through 2026-07-31; this is not a recurring 'at least $1B annual buyback' commitment. NRG also disclosed alignment on principal commercial terms to develop a 1.2 GW Texas combined-cycle gas facility with an unnamed leading global cloud and AI hyperscaler, subject to final documentation and approvals. As merchant-power-capacity evidence, this is prospective, partial evidence for a gas-capacity project; as grid-epc-delivery evidence, it does not yet confirm construction, delivery, or interconnection. Evidence limits: this is not a signed/binding contract, revenue, or committed capex; the counterparty is unnamed; the official release gives no investment size, commercial-operation date, EBITDA/FCF contribution, or expandability, so secondary figures are excluded; and nrg-2026's named-win trigger is still unmet. This entry contains no investment advice, rating, or price target.

title.zh: Sandisk Q4 FY2026：收入 $8,965M（环比 +51%）、毛利率 84.6% 高于 79-81% 指引，本季新增五份 NBM 协议
title.en: Sandisk Q4 FY2026: revenue of $8,965M (up 51% Q/Q), 84.6% gross margin above the 79-81% guide, and five additional NBM agreements

detail.zh: 据 Sandisk 2026-08-05 发布的 Q4 FY2026 业绩新闻稿（季度截至 2026-07-03）：季度收入 $8,965M（环比 +51%、同比 +372%），GAAP 与非 GAAP 毛利率同为 84.6%（Q3 为 78.4%，+6.2 个百分点），高于此前 79-81% 的指引区间；GAAP 营业利润 $7,037M、非 GAAP $7,104M；GAAP 摊薄每股收益 $43.97、非 GAAP $39.25。公司称环比收入增长约三分之一来自出货量、约三分之二来自价格。数据中心收入 $2,977M（环比 +103%、同比 +1,298%），Edge $5,432M（环比 +48%），消费 $556M（环比 −32%）；FY2026 全年收入 $20,248M（同比 +175%），其中数据中心 $5,153M（同比 +437%）。公司同时披露本季新增五份 NBM 协议，其中三家为新客户、两份为既有协议扩展，使已公布协议总数达到十份；新闻稿未披露最低合同收入、RPO、担保或 bit 覆盖，故不据此确认旧报告约 $42B 管理层口径。现金流方面，经营现金流 $7,126M、自由现金流 $7,083M、公司口径调整后自由现金流 $5,035M（剔除 $1,938M NBM 预付款与保证金）；本季回购 $4,524M，新增 $14B 授权后剩余授权 $15.5B。Q1 FY2027 指引为收入 $10,300-10,800M、GAAP 毛利率 83.0-84.9%、非 GAAP 83.0-85.0%、非 GAAP 摊薄每股收益 $44.00-46.00。证据边界：全部为卖方披露；GAAP EPS 含 $804M 权益证券非经营性收益；调整后自由现金流为公司自定义口径；公司称结果为初步数据，可能与 10-K 不同。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标；sandisk-2026 的估值与立场仍锚定 2026-07-30，需另行完整更新后重新裁定。
detail.en: Per Sandisk's Q4 FY2026 earnings release issued 2026-08-05 for the quarter ended 2026-07-03: revenue was $8,965M (up 51% Q/Q and 372% Y/Y), with GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin both 84.6% (Q3: 78.4%, up 6.2 ppt), above the prior 79-81% guide; GAAP operating income was $7,037M, non-GAAP operating income $7,104M, GAAP diluted EPS $43.97 and non-GAAP diluted EPS $39.25. The company said roughly one-third of sequential revenue growth came from volume and two-thirds from pricing. Datacenter revenue was $2,977M (up 103% Q/Q and 1,298% Y/Y), Edge $5,432M (up 48% Q/Q), and Consumer $556M (down 32% Q/Q); FY2026 revenue was $20,248M (up 175%), including $5,153M of Datacenter revenue (up 437%). The company also disclosed five additional NBM agreements in the quarter - three with new customers and two expansions - bringing the announced total to ten. The release does not disclose minimum contracted revenue, RPO, guarantees, or committed-bit coverage, so it does not independently confirm the old report's roughly $42B management framing. Operating cash flow was $7,126M, free cash flow $7,083M, and company-defined adjusted free cash flow $5,035M after excluding $1,938M of NBM prepayments and deposits. Repurchases were $4,524M, and an additional $14B authorization brought remaining authority to $15.5B. Q1 FY2027 guidance is revenue of $10,300-10,800M, GAAP gross margin of 83.0-84.9%, non-GAAP gross margin of 83.0-85.0%, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $44.00-46.00. Evidence limits: all evidence is supplier-side; GAAP EPS includes an $804M non-operating gain on equity securities; adjusted free cash flow is company-defined; and the company calls the results preliminary and potentially different from the 10-K. This entry contains no investment advice, rating or price target; sandisk-2026's valuation and stance remain anchored to 2026-07-30 and require a separate full update to re-adjudicate.

title.zh: Constellation Q2 2026：新增 920MW 长期 PPA（15-20 年，2029-2032 年起供），FERC 批准 Crane 并网容量权转移、NRC 批准其燃料许可，全年调整后运营每股收益指引上调至 $11.50-12.50
title.en: Constellation Q2 2026: 920 MW of additional long-term PPAs (15-20 years, deliveries starting 2029-2032), FERC grants the Crane interconnection-rights transfer and the NRC approves its fuel licence, and full-year adjusted operating EPS guidance is raised to $11.50-12.50

detail.zh: 据 Constellation Energy 于 2026-08-06 盘前发布的 2026 Q2 业绩（当日 8-K 附件 99.1）：GAAP 归属普通股东每股净利润 $1.42（2025 Q2 为 $2.67），调整后（非 GAAP）运营每股收益 $2.55（2025 Q2 为 $1.91），对应调整后运营利润 $920M（2025 Q2 为 $599M）；公司将 2026 全年调整后运营每股收益指引区间上调至 $11.50-12.50。公司披露新增签署 920MW 长期购电协议，期限 15-20 年、供电起始时间分布在 2029 至 2032 年，对手方仅描述为「一组多元化的投资级客户」，其中唯一具名的是 176MW 的沃尔玛协议，该协议将带动 Dresden 核电站 30MW 扩容。监管方面：FERC 批准将宾州 Eddystone 3、4 号双燃料机组的现有并网容量权（Capacity Interconnection Rights）转移至 Crane Clean Energy Center 的豁免申请，公司称此举扫清了重启的关键监管障碍；NRC 批准了 Crane 的燃料许可修订申请；公司维持 2027 年重启目标，并另就 Ginna 与 Nine Mile Point 1 号机组向 NRC 提交延寿至 2049 年的许可更新申请。公司还于 2026 年 8 月与 LS Power 签约，以 $860M（未计交割调整）出售位于 ERCOT 的 606MW 燃气电厂 Brazos Valley Energy Center，为 Calpine 收购监管承诺项下最后一项资产出售，交割尚待 DOJ 批准，预计年内完成。运营数据：核电机组（含 Salem 与 STP 权益产量）Q2 发电 44,160GWh（2025 Q2 为 45,170GWh）；不含 Salem 与 STP 的核电容量因子 93.0%（2025 Q2 为 94.8%），计划换料停堆 86 天（2025 Q2 为 41 天）；天然气、燃油与抽水蓄能机组的等效强迫停运率为 6.2%（2026 年起新增指标，无同比）。证据边界：920MW 的价格条款未披露，公司未说明其中是否包含超大规模厂商客户，且供电最早 2029 年才开始，属已签协议而非当期收入；FERC 与 NRC 的批准是监管里程碑，不等于重启完成或并网发电；Brazos Valley 出售尚未交割。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per Constellation Energy's Q2 2026 results, released before the open on 2026-08-06 (Exhibit 99.1 to the same day's 8-K): GAAP net income attributable to common shareholders was $1.42 per share (Q2 2025: $2.67) and adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings were $2.55 per share (Q2 2025: $1.91), or $920M of adjusted operating earnings against $599M a year earlier; the company raised its full-year 2026 adjusted operating earnings guidance range to $11.50-12.50 per share. It disclosed an additional 920 MW of long-term power purchase agreements, 15-20 years in duration with deliveries starting between 2029 and 2032, to counterparties described only as 'a diverse set of investment grade customers'; the sole named counterparty is a 176 MW agreement with Walmart that will enable a 30 MW capacity expansion at the Dresden Clean Energy Center. On the regulatory side, FERC approved the company's waiver request to transfer existing Capacity Interconnection Rights from the dual-fuel Eddystone Units 3 and 4 in Pennsylvania to the Crane Clean Energy Center, which the company describes as clearing a critical regulatory hurdle for the restart; the NRC approved a fuel license amendment request for Crane; the 2027 restart target is unchanged; and the company filed NRC licence renewal applications to extend the Ginna Clean Energy Center and Nine Mile Point Unit 1 to 2049. Separately, in August 2026 the company agreed to sell the 606 MW gas-fired Brazos Valley Energy Center in ERCOT to LS Power for $860M before closing adjustments, the last asset sale required by its Calpine regulatory commitments, subject to DOJ approval and expected to close by year-end. Operating data: the nuclear fleet including owned output from Salem and STP produced 44,160 GWh in the quarter (Q2 2025: 45,170 GWh); excluding Salem and STP the capacity factor was 93.0% (Q2 2025: 94.8%) with 86 planned refuelling outage days against 41; the equivalent forced outage factor for the gas, oil and pumped-storage fleet was 6.2% (a new metric from 2026, with no prior-year comparison). Evidence limits: no price terms were disclosed for the 920 MW, the company did not say whether any of it is hyperscaler volume, and deliveries do not begin until 2029, so this is contracted capacity rather than current revenue; the FERC and NRC approvals are regulatory milestones, not a completed restart or power delivery; and the Brazos Valley sale has not closed. This entry contains no investment advice, rating, or price target.

title.zh: AAOI Q2 2026：收入 $191.9M 落在 $180-198M 指引区间内，数据中心收入 $107.7M（同比 +140%），Q3 指引 $255-290M；公司称需求将持续超过其产能至 2027 年中
title.en: AAOI Q2 2026: revenue of $191.9M lands inside the $180-198M guide, datacenter revenue $107.7M (+140% YoY) and Q3 guided to $255-290M, with the company saying demand will outpace its production capacity through mid-2027

detail.zh: 据 Applied Optoelectronics 于 2026-08-06 盘后发布的 2026 Q2 业绩（当日 8-K 附件 99.1）与同日提交的 Q2 10-Q：GAAP 收入 $191.922M（2025 Q2 $102.952M，2026 Q1 $151.1M），落在 $180-198M 指引区间内；按市场拆分，数据中心 $107.662M（2025 Q2 $44.791M，同比 +140%）、CATV $80.578M、电信 $3.411M。GAAP 毛利率 27.7%（2025 Q2 30.3%，2026 Q1 29.1%），非 GAAP 毛利率 29.8%；GAAP 净亏损 $22.781M，非 GAAP 净利润 $5.475M，调整后 EBITDA −$0.543M。Q3 指引：收入 $255-290M、非 GAAP 毛利率 29%-30.5%、非 GAAP 净利润 $10.1-24.0M（按约 9,280 万股计）。产能与需求表述：公司称 800G 出货量环比翻倍以上（未量化只数），总制造产能接近每月 20 万只，并预计到 2026 年底具备每月约 65 万只 800G 与 1.6T 产品的生产能力，且「预计需求将持续超过我们的产能至 2027 年中」。现金流与融资（取自 10-Q）：2026 上半年经营活动净现金流出 $73.781M（2025 上半年流出 $116.389M）；2026 Q1 10-Q 记录上季为流出 $85.353M，两份已提交报表相减得出 Q2 单季经营现金流约 +$11.6M（本条推导，非单独披露）。2026 上半年普通股发行净得 $1,028.207M（2025 上半年 $195.770M），上半年资本开支 $335.132M（美国 $169.0M、台湾 $62.8M、中国 $103.3M），另有设备预付款 $289.744M。集中度披露（10-Q）：截至 2026-06-30，Digicomm 占应收账款总额约 67.2%；2026 上半年来自 Digicomm 的收入约 $147.0M、占合并收入约 42.8%，主要为 CATV 产品，公司称已向其提供长于常规的付款条件。证据边界：Q3 的 $255-290M 是指引而非已实现收入；每月 65 万只是公司陈述的年底产能计划，既非已安装产能也非已订订单；「需求超过产能至 2027 年中」为管理层评论，未附订单、积压或合同量化；公司不按客户披露数据中心收入，因此不能从数据中心分部同比 +140% 推断任何单一超大规模客户的订单节奏；Q2 单季经营现金流为两份 10-Q 相减所得。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per Applied Optoelectronics' Q2 2026 results, released after the close on 2026-08-06 (Exhibit 99.1 to the same day's 8-K), and the Q2 10-Q filed the same day: GAAP revenue was $191.922M (Q2 2025: $102.952M; Q1 2026: $151.1M), inside the $180-198M guide, split by market into datacenter $107.662M (Q2 2025: $44.791M, +140% YoY), CATV $80.578M and telecom $3.411M. GAAP gross margin was 27.7% (Q2 2025: 30.3%; Q1 2026: 29.1%) and non-GAAP gross margin 29.8%; GAAP net loss was $22.781M, non-GAAP net income $5.475M and adjusted EBITDA -$0.543M. Q3 2026 is guided to revenue of $255-290M, a 29%-30.5% non-GAAP gross margin and non-GAAP net income of $10.1-24.0M on approximately 92.8M shares. On capacity and demand, the company says 800G shipment volume more than doubled sequentially (units not quantified), that total manufacturing capacity is approaching 200,000 units per month, that it expects to be capable of producing around 650,000 pieces per month of 800G and 1.6T product by the end of this year, and that it forecasts demand will continue to outpace its production capacity through mid-2027. On cash flow and funding, from the 10-Q: net cash used in operating activities was $73.781M for the six months ended 2026-06-30 (H1 2025: $116.389M used); the Q1 2026 10-Q reported $85.353M used for the prior quarter, so subtracting the two filed statements gives approximately +$11.6M of operating cash flow for Q2 alone (derived here, not separately disclosed). Net proceeds from common stock offerings were $1,028.207M in H1 2026 (H1 2025: $195.770M), against H1 capital expenditure of $335.132M ($169.0M in the US, $62.8M in Taiwan, $103.3M in China) plus $289.744M of equipment prepayments. On concentration, the 10-Q discloses that Digicomm represented approximately 67.2% of total accounts receivable at 2026-06-30, and that H1 2026 revenue from Digicomm was approximately $147.0M, about 42.8% of consolidated revenue, primarily CATV product, with the company noting it has extended longer than typical payment terms to Digicomm. Evidence limits: the $255-290M Q3 figure is guidance, not realised revenue; the 650,000 pieces per month figure is a stated year-end capability plan rather than installed capacity or booked orders; 'demand outpacing capacity through mid-2027' is management commentary with no order, backlog or contract quantification; the company does not disclose datacenter revenue by customer, so no single hyperscaler's order cadence can be inferred from the +140% datacenter growth; and the single-quarter operating cash flow figure is derived by subtracting two filed 10-Qs. This entry contains no investment advice, rating, or price target.

title.zh: MP Materials Q2 2026：价格保护收入由 $42.3M 降至 $17.6M，Materials 分部剔除 PPA 后的调整后 EBITDA 由 −$5.5M 转为 +$14.9M，但合并调整后 EBITDA $28.5M 低于 2026 Q1 的 $36.6M
title.en: MP Materials Q2 2026: price-protection income falls from $42.3M to $17.6M and Materials-segment adjusted EBITDA excluding PPA swings from -$5.5M to +$14.9M, but consolidated adjusted EBITDA of $28.5M lands below Q1 2026's $36.6M

detail.zh: 据 MP Materials 于 2026-08-06 盘后发布的 2026 Q2 业绩（当日 8-K 附件 99.1，季度截至 2026-06-30）：收入 $108.490M（同比 +89%），价格保护协议（PPA）收入 $17.580M（2026 Q1 为 $42.273M，2025 Q2 为零），合并调整后 EBITDA $28.493M（2026 Q1 $36.6M，2025 Q2 −$12.535M），净亏损 $20.296M。Materials 分部收入 $95.629M（同比 +155%），其中 NdPr 氧化物与金属 $94.434M、稀土精矿为零（2025 年 7 月起停售）；分部调整后 EBITDA $32.505M，剔除 $17.580M 的 PPA 收入后为 +$14.925M（2026 Q1 同口径为 −$5.5M）。产销量：NdPr 产量 840 吨（同比 +41%）、NdPr 销量 1,006 吨（同比 +127%，与 2026 Q1 的 1,006 吨相同，已对照 Q1 的 8-K 独立核实）、REO 产量 11,072 吨（同比 −16%）。磁材分部收入 $16.524M（同比 −17%），仍整体列示为磁材前驱体产品收入，分部调整后 EBITDA $7.532M；公司称 Independence 的磁体资格认证通过面向客户认证与法规测试的追加交付而推进，10X 工厂建设加速。2026-06-30 现金 $429.075M 加短期投资 $1,023.564M 合计 $1,452.6M（2025-12-31 为 $1,830.3M）；2026 上半年经营活动净现金流入 $4.939M、购建固定资产 $307.711M，融资活动中无股权发行。公司另披露与一家新的美国航空航天与国防客户签署分离钆的长期承购协议（未量化金额与数量），并启动旨在聚合无人机行业需求、统一规格的 Project Swarm。链条读数：把 mp-2026 报告 §9 已发布的推导方法套用到本季，NdPr 氧化物与金属收入 $94.434M ÷ 1,006 吨得推导实现价约 $93.87/公斤，PPA 收入 $17.580M ÷ 同一销量得推导 $17.48/公斤，合计约 $111.35/公斤，对应协议 $110/公斤 floor（2026 Q1 为 $70.71 + $42.02 = $112.73/公斤）——即隐含参考价格较 Q1 明显上行但仍在 floor 之下。证据边界：MP 不披露每公斤实现价，上述每公斤数字为推导值，并沿用 §9 的同一保留意见——PPA 按「指定」数量而非销售数量支付，两者未被证明相等；合并调整后 EBITDA 的环比下滑并非产品端恶化所致，而是 floor 收入减少 $24.7M 叠加公司层级成本上升（corporate and other 由上年同期 −$7.946M 增至 −$10.983M），同期 Materials 剔除 PPA 后改善 $20.4M；本次发布未确认已确认成品磁体收入，也未重申 2026 下半年首批磁体收入时间表或 2026 年 $5.0-6.0 亿资本开支指引；钆承购协议与 Project Swarm 均未量化收入。截至本条记录，Q2 10-Q 尚未提交；mp-2026 报告本身在本次运行中未被更新——其 q2-2026-ppa-income 监测项的评级需与立场重新裁定一并由评审裁决，故本条不带 reportIds 与 monitoringRefs。本条不含投资建议、评级或价格目标。
detail.en: Per MP Materials' Q2 2026 results, released after the close on 2026-08-06 (Exhibit 99.1 to the same day's 8-K, quarter ended 2026-06-30): revenue was $108.490M (+89% YoY), price protection agreement (PPA) income $17.580M (Q1 2026: $42.273M; Q2 2025: nil), consolidated adjusted EBITDA $28.493M (Q1 2026: $36.6M; Q2 2025: -$12.535M) and net loss $20.296M. Materials segment revenue was $95.629M (+155% YoY), of which NdPr oxide and metal was $94.434M and rare earth concentrate nil following the cessation of concentrate sales in July 2025; segment adjusted EBITDA was $32.505M, which excluding the $17.580M of PPA income is +$14.925M (the same calculation gave -$5.5M in Q1 2026). On volumes, NdPr production was 840 MT (+41% YoY), NdPr sales 1,006 MT (+127% YoY, the same tonnage as Q1 2026, verified independently against the Q1 8-K) and REO production 11,072 MT (-16% YoY). Magnetics segment revenue was $16.524M (-17% YoY), still presented in full as magnetic precursor products revenue, on $7.532M of segment adjusted EBITDA; the company describes magnet qualification at Independence as advancing through additional deliveries for customer qualification and regulatory testing, with 10X construction accelerating. Cash of $429.075M plus short-term investments of $1,023.564M gave $1,452.6M at 2026-06-30 (2025-12-31: $1,830.3M); H1 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $4.939M against $307.711M of property, plant and equipment additions, and financing activities contain no equity issuance. The company also disclosed a long-term offtake agreement for separated gadolinium with a new US aerospace and defense customer (amount and volumes not quantified) and the launch of 'Project Swarm' to aggregate drone-industry demand and standardise specifications. Chain reading: applying the derivation method published in §9 of the mp-2026 report to this quarter, NdPr oxide and metal revenue of $94.434M over 1,006 MT gives a derived realised price of about US$93.87/kg, and $17.580M of PPA income over the same volume gives about US$17.48/kg, combining to roughly US$111.35/kg against the agreement's US$110/kg floor (Q1 2026: $70.71 + $42.02 = $112.73/kg) - an implied benchmark clearly higher than Q1's but still below the floor. Evidence limits: MP does not disclose a realised price per kilogram, so the per-kilogram figures above are derived and carry the same caveat as §9, namely that the PPA pays on *designated* volume, which is not established as equal to sales volume; the sequential decline in consolidated adjusted EBITDA is not product-side deterioration but a $24.7M fall in floor income combined with higher corporate cost (corporate and other moved to -$10.983M from -$7.946M a year earlier) against a $20.4M improvement in Materials excluding PPA; the release neither confirms recognised finished-magnet revenue nor restates the H2 2026 first-magnet-revenue timeline or the US$500-600M 2026 capex guide; and neither the gadolinium offtake nor Project Swarm carries quantified revenue. No Q2 10-Q had been filed as of this entry, and the mp-2026 report itself was not updated in this run - grading its q2-2026-ppa-income item requires a stance re-adjudication that only the reviewer can make, so this entry deliberately carries no reportIds and no monitoringRefs. This entry contains no investment advice, rating, or price target.

title.zh: Amkor Q2 2026：全网稼动率升至 70% 区间，但无实质 backlog，先进封装仍未形成独立约束读数
title.en: Amkor Q2 2026: network utilization rises into the 70% range, but no material backlog leaves advanced packaging without a standalone constraint read

detail.zh: 据 Amkor 2026-07-27 发布的 Q2 业绩与 2026-07-28 提交的 10-Q：季度收入 $1,897.965M（同比 +25.6%），毛利率 16.8%，Q3 收入指引 $1.95-2.05B，对 2025 Q3 实绩为同比 -1.9% 至 +3.2%；管理层称全网稼动率由 50% 区间升至 70% 区间、若干技术平台满产，但没有点名相关平台。10-Q 同时说明业务通常没有实质在手订单，客户不提供具约束力的预测且可能重复下单；Q3 通信收入下滑还被归因于安卓销量因内存供应约束下降约 20%。这些事实确认 Amkor 可读到第三方 OSAT 的利用率、收入结构与资本开支，却没有确认第三方持有可独立定价的 CoWoS 级份额，也没有证明封装而非内存或台积电内部排产是当前交付约束。因此本事件支持先进封装层的归属读数，而不是把它升级为约束读数。
detail.en: Per Amkor's Q2 results released 2026-07-27 and its 10-Q filed 2026-07-28, quarterly revenue was $1,897.965M (+25.6% YoY), gross margin was 16.8%, and Q3 revenue was guided to $1.95-2.05B, or -1.9% to +3.2% against Q3 2025 actual. Management said network utilization improved from the 50% range into the 70% range and that several technology platforms were full, without naming those platforms. The 10-Q also states that the business typically carries no material backlog, customers provide no binding forecasts and double booking can occur; the guided Q3 decline in communications was attributed to Android volumes falling about 20% on memory supply constraints. The facts make third-party OSAT utilization, mix and capex observable, but do not establish independently-priceable third-party CoWoS-class share or show that packaging rather than memory or foundry-internal scheduling is the current delivery constraint. The event therefore supports an ownership reading for the advanced-packaging layer without upgrading it to a constraint reading.

title.zh: Applied Materials FY2026 Q3：收入 $9,115M 超指引中点，Semiconductor Systems $7,040M、DRAM 占比同比升至 26%，中国为唯一同比下降地区
title.en: Applied Materials Q3 FY2026: revenue $9,115M beats the guidance midpoint, Semiconductor Systems $7,040M with DRAM mix up to 26% year over year, and China the only region to decline

detail.zh: 据 Applied Materials 于 2026-08-13 盘后提交的 8-K 及 Exhibit 99.1 业绩公告（财季截至 2026-07-26）：收入 $9,115M（同比 +25%），高于此前 $8,950M 指引中点；GAAP gross margin 50.3%、non-GAAP 50.4%（去年同期 48.8% / 48.9%）；GAAP EPS $3.17、non-GAAP EPS $3.50，高于 $3.36 指引中点；经营现金流 $3.04B，non-GAAP 自由现金流 $2,330M。Semiconductor Systems 收入 $7,040M（去年同期 $5,564M），GAAP operating margin 37.7%、non-GAAP 38.0%（去年同期 33.0% / 33.2%）；分部结构 foundry/logic/other 67%、DRAM 26%、Flash 7%，去年同期为 69% / 22% / 9%。Q4 FY2026 指引收入 $10,250M +/- $500M、non-GAAP EPS $4.02 +/- $0.20。管理层称已上调 2026 日历年 Semiconductor Systems 收入预期，并预计下半年增长以 DRAM、先进逻辑代工与先进封装为主。地区收入：中国 $2,506M（占比 28%，去年同期 $2,548M / 35%）、台湾 $2,025M（22%，去年同期 $1,843M / 25%）、韩国 $1,521M（17%）、美国 $1,367M（15%）。证据限制：中国是本季唯一同比收入下降的地区，但公告未就此作出任何归因，既未提及出口管制也未提及客户节奏；公告不披露订单或在手订单，因此上述读数确认的是已实现收入与设备分部结构，而非已承诺订单；HBM 收入未单独披露，DRAM 仅以分部占比形式给出；存货 $6,564M 的比较基准是 2025-10-26 财年末（$5,915M）而非上一季度，因本次公告不含 Q2 资产负债表；同期应收账款由 $5,185M 增至 $7,691M，快于收入增速。
detail.en: Per Applied Materials' Form 8-K and Exhibit 99.1 earnings release furnished after the close on 2026-08-13 for the fiscal quarter ended 2026-07-26: revenue was $9,115M, up 25% year over year and above the prior $8,950M guidance midpoint; GAAP gross margin was 50.3% and non-GAAP 50.4% (48.8% and 48.9% a year earlier); GAAP EPS was $3.17 and non-GAAP EPS $3.50, above the $3.36 guided midpoint; cash from operations was $3.04B and non-GAAP free cash flow $2,330M. Semiconductor Systems revenue was $7,040M against $5,564M a year earlier, with GAAP operating margin 37.7% and non-GAAP 38.0% against 33.0% and 33.2%; segment mix was foundry/logic/other 67%, DRAM 26% and flash 7%, against 69%, 22% and 9% a year earlier. Q4 FY2026 guidance is revenue of $10,250M +/- $500M and non-GAAP EPS of $4.02 +/- $0.20. Management said it raised its calendar-2026 Semiconductor Systems revenue expectations and expects second-half growth led by DRAM, leading-edge foundry-logic and advanced packaging. Revenue by geography: China $2,506M (28% of total, against $2,548M and 35%), Taiwan $2,025M (22%, against $1,843M and 25%), Korea $1,521M (17%) and the United States $1,367M (15%). Evidence limits: China was the only region whose revenue declined year over year this quarter, and the release offers no attribution for it, naming neither export controls nor customer timing; Applied discloses neither orders nor backlog, so these readings confirm realized revenue and equipment segment mix rather than committed orders; no HBM-specific revenue is disclosed and DRAM appears only as a segment share; the inventory figure of $6,564M is compared against fiscal year-end 2025-10-26 ($5,915M) rather than the prior quarter because this release carries no Q2 balance sheet; over the same span accounts receivable rose from $5,185M to $7,691M, faster than revenue.

title.zh: AAOI 新设最高 $600M ATM；5 月 ATM 在 6 月 30 日后已售出 332,428 股
title.en: AAOI establishes up to $600M of new ATM capacity as the May ATM sells 332,428 shares after June 30

detail.zh: 据 Applied Optoelectronics 2026-08-21 提交的 Form 8-K（accession 0001104659-26-099688）、Equity Distribution Agreement 附件及 Form 424B5（accession 0001104659-26-099685）：公司可不时通过 Raymond James 与 Needham 出售最高 $600M 普通股，代理佣金最高为总售价的 2.0%；只有公司发出 placement notice 后才产生具体配售义务，公司可暂停销售或终止协议，因此未用额度不是已执行稀释。424B5 另披露，5 月 ATM 在 2026-06-30 后已售出 332,428 股、总收款约 $49.2M；2026-08-20 流通股为 84,906,289 股。文件按 $129.10 假设价计算的全额 $600M 发行对应约 4.65M 股、约为当前流通股的 5.5%，但这是全额使用假设，不是已发行股份。该读数进一步确认 AAOI 的融资与稀释腿仍在扩张，却不证明新额度会被使用，也不证明新增产能已有订单或经营现金流支持；`cash-burn-dilution` 因 H1 现金流为负、推导 Q2 单季为正而维持 `unclear`，立场与确信度不变。
detail.en: Per Applied Optoelectronics' Form 8-K filed August 21, 2026 (accession 0001104659-26-099688), the attached Equity Distribution Agreement and Form 424B5 (accession 0001104659-26-099685), the company may sell up to $600M of common stock from time to time through Raymond James and Needham at commissions of up to 2.0% of gross sales. A particular placement obligation arises only after the company delivers a placement notice, and the company may suspend sales or terminate the agreement, so unused capacity is not executed dilution. The 424B5 separately discloses that the May ATM sold 332,428 shares after June 30 for about $49.2M of gross proceeds and that 84,906,289 shares were outstanding on August 20. Full use of $600M at the filing's assumed $129.10 price equates to about 4.65M shares, roughly 5.5% of current shares, but that is a full-utilization assumption rather than issued stock. The reading further confirms AAOI's financing-and-dilution leg is expanding, but does not establish that the new capacity will be used or that capacity additions are supported by orders or operating cash flow. `cash-burn-dilution` remains `unclear` because H1 cash flow was negative while derived Q2-only cash flow was positive; stance and conviction are unchanged.
